Here you’ll be part of the Entry\-Level Talent Recruiting (ETR) Team, sourcing top talent for Cisco across various functions.
  
  

Meet the Team
  
  

You will be part of the India Entry\-Level Talent Recruiting (ETR) team at Cisco. In your role you will work with ETR team, Join\& Connect (Talent Acquisition team), P (Human Resources team) and business leaders.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

You will drive strategic talent sourcing and pipelining initiatives in partnership with ETR Leads, Recruiters, hiring leaders, and cross\-functional teams, translating evolving business needs and emerging talent demands into actionable recruitment strategies. You will develop and execute scalable, cost\-effective sourcing and channel strategies, identify and cultivate new talent channels, and design high\-impact external engagement programs to attract rising and transformative talent.
  
  

**Key Responsibilites:**  

* Ensure exceptional candidate and hiring leader experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle while adhering to compliance protocols and maintain integrity of recruitment processes.
* Deepen knowledge of Cisco’s recruiting policies, processes, and employee value proposition and upholding strict confidentiality in handling candidate and organizational data.
* Collaborate across teams to enhance operational efficiency and process excellence.
* Design and implement high\-impact programs to engage and attract external emerging talent.
* Coach junior members on team, have the ability to influence in a matrixed environment.
* Help implementing external engagement programs and evaluate return on investment on channel partnerships.
* Provide regular insights on market trends, channel performance, and competitive intelligence.


Minimum Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree or equivalent experience in a relevant or allied specialization.
* Shown expertise in Talent Acquisition with a focus on high\-volume, early\-in\-career, and tech hiring.
* Strong background in both in\-house and agency recruitment models.
* Skilled in market mapping and quality pipeline development for niche tech roles.
* Proficient in data\-driven recruitment operations, reporting, and analytics.
* Proficient with ATS platforms, email tools, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Report and analyse data for enhanced delivery and strategy
* Deep understanding of tech talent landscape and sourcing channels.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across dynamic, cross\-functional teams.
* Capable of building and sustaining channel relationships to support recruitment goals.
* Willing to travel for campus engagement and key hiring events.
* Ability to navigate and use AI tools for faster recruitment delivery


Preferred Qualification
  
  

Expertise in Early in Career, University and Apprentice Hiring
  
Excellent communication, articulation and strategic\-planning skills, while being self\-motivated with a focus on execution and Innovative / Creative, loves to challenge the status quo.
  
  

Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  

Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx


Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

Zoho \& HR Platforms

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist – NGO / Social Impact | Pune
description:
**Find the People Who Will Help Change Lives.**

**What if recruitment wasn't just about filling positions?**

**At Lighthouse Communities Foundation, every person who joins our team contributes to creating better opportunities for young people from underserved communities.**

We are looking for a **Talent Acquisition Executive** who can own the recruitment journey end\-to\-end — from finding the right talent and conducting interviews to building a strong candidate experience and helping new team members begin their journey with Lighthouse.

If you're someone who enjoys connecting with people, spotting potential, building relationships, and wants your recruitment work to contribute to meaningful social impact, we'd love to hear from you.

About Lighthouse Communities Foundation

Lighthouse Communities Foundation works in the area of **skilling and livelihoods for underserved youth**, with a vision of enabling socio\-economic transformation.

Our Lighthouse model is built on a pioneering **Public\-Private Partnership (PPP)** approach that brings together:

**Government \+ Corporates \+ NGOs \+ Citizens \+ Communities**

The Government supports the Lighthouse centres through location and capital expenditure. Corporates contribute through CSR funding to support operational expenses, while NGOs and other partners contribute skilling and livelihood opportunities for young people.

With a strong presence across more than **400 of Pune's approximately 500 slum communities**, the Lighthouse program has expanded to **PCMC, Dombivali, Aurangabad, Delhi, Odisha, and Hyderabad**.

Our work is driven by four core values:

**Empathy \| Inclusion \| Integrity \| Courage**

About the Role

As a **Talent Acquisition Executive**, you will play a critical role in building the team that powers our mission.

You'll partner with hiring managers and internal teams to understand talent needs, source candidates, assess potential, coordinate interviews, support hiring decisions, and ensure a smooth onboarding experience.

You'll work across a range of roles and interact with candidates from diverse professional and social backgrounds.

The role requires someone who can balance:

**Speed \+ Quality \| Process \+ People \| Hiring Needs \+ Mission Fit**

We are looking for a recruiter who doesn't simply ask:

**"Can this person do the job?"**

But also asks:

**"Will this person connect with our mission, values, and the communities we serve?"**

**What You'll Do**

**Own Talent Acquisition End\-to\-End**

**Take ownership of the recruitment lifecycle for positions across the organization.**

**You will**:

* Understand hiring requirements from managers and teams.
* Clarify role expectations, competencies, and candidate profiles.
* Develop appropriate sourcing strategies for different roles.
* Source and engage potential candidates.
* Screen applications and shortlist relevant profiles.
* Conduct initial phone/video screenings and interviews.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and interview panels.
* Track candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Follow up with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Support offer discussions and closure.
* Ensure positions are filled within agreed timelines while maintaining hiring quality.

**Job Posting \& Candidate Sourcing**

**Think beyond simply posting a vacancy.**

**You will:**

* Post job openings across relevant job portals and platforms.
* Leverage social media and professional networks for sourcing.
* Explore NGO and social\-sector specific recruitment networks.
* Identify new and creative sourcing channels.
* Build and maintain relevant candidate pipelines.
* Proactively reach out to potential candidates.
* Engage passive candidates where appropriate.
* Experiment with different approaches to attract quality talent.

Your goal is to ensure that the right candidates **discover Lighthouse — and want to be part of the journey.**

**Screening \& Interviewing**

**Be the first meaningful point of contact between many candidates and Lighthouse.**

**You will:**

* Conduct initial phone screenings.
* Evaluate candidates against role requirements.
* Assess relevant experience, skills, communication, and motivation.
* Understand candidates' career aspirations and expectations.
* Assess alignment with Lighthouse's values and mission.
* Share structured feedback with hiring managers.
* Help ensure a fair, consistent, and candidate\-friendly selection process.

We believe recruitment should be about **understanding potential, not just matching keywords on a CV.**

**Create a Great Candidate Experience**

**Every interaction with a candidate shapes how they see the organisation.**

**You will:**

* Communicate clearly and professionally with candidates.
* Keep candidates informed about interview stages and timelines.
* Respond to candidate queries.
* Ensure a respectful and inclusive recruitment experience.
* Maintain professionalism even when candidates are not selected.
* Build positive relationships with potential future candidates.

Because even when someone doesn't join us today, **they should leave the process with a positive impression of Lighthouse.**

**Support Onboarding**

**Your responsibility doesn't end when a candidate accepts an offer.**

**You will:**

* Support the onboarding process for new hires.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure joining formalities are completed.
* Help new employees understand the organisation and their next steps.
* Ensure new team members feel welcomed and supported.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to enable a smooth transition into the organisation.

**Manage Recruitment Data**

**Good recruitment also requires good data.**

**You will:**

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date recruitment records.
* Track candidate pipelines and hiring status.
* Update recruitment systems and trackers.
* Maintain candidate information systematically.
* Support recruitment reporting and hiring dashboards.
* Ensure appropriate handling of candidate information.
* Follow data privacy and confidentiality practices.

You should be comfortable working with recruitment data and using it to identify bottlenecks and improve hiring effectiveness.

**Champion Diversity \& Inclusion**

**Lighthouse works with diverse communities — and our teams should reflect that diversity.**

**You will:**

* Promote fairness and inclusion throughout the recruitment process.
* Proactively explore diverse talent pools.
* Encourage applications from candidates with different backgrounds and perspectives.
* Help reduce unconscious bias in the hiring process.
* Ensure candidates are evaluated fairly against role requirements and organisational values.

**Build the Lighthouse Employer Brand**

**Help candidates understand why Lighthouse is a place worth joining.**

**You will:**

* Communicate the LCF mission, values, culture, and impact through recruitment.
* Support recruitment campaigns and employer\-branding initiatives.
* Create compelling job\-posting and candidate communication approaches.
* Highlight the opportunities for learning, growth, and social impact at Lighthouse.
* Help strengthen Lighthouse's presence across relevant talent communities.

**We want candidates to understand not just what the job is, but why the work matters.**

**Who We're Looking For**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in:
* Human Resources
* Social Sciences
* Business Administration
* or a related discipline.
* **Relevant HR or Recruitment certifications will be an advantage.**

**Experience**

* **2\+ years of experience in recruitment / talent acquisition** preferred.
* Experience in the nonprofit, NGO, development, education, skilling, or social\-impact sector will be an advantage.
* Experience working with volunteers or mission\-driven organisations will be a plus.

**Skills We're Looking For**

**Recruitment Expertise**

* Strong understanding of recruitment processes and best practices.
* Experience managing multiple positions simultaneously.
* Strong sourcing and screening capabilities.
* Ability to assess candidate suitability against role requirements.
* Understanding of structured interviewing and candidate evaluation.

Communication

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with candidates, hiring managers, and internal teams.
* Confidence conducting screening and interview conversations.

**Organisation \& Execution**

* Strong organisational skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.

**People \& Relationship Building**

* Ability to build trust and positive relationships.
* Empathy and active listening.
* Candidate\-centric approach.
* Ability to interact comfortably with people from diverse backgrounds.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If You Are...**

* Curious about people and what motivates them.
* Someone who enjoys discovering talent rather than simply processing applications.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and evolving environment.
* Proactive and self\-motivated.
* Comfortable managing multiple hiring requirements at the same time.
* Empathetic but also focused on timelines and outcomes.
* Someone who believes diversity makes organisations stronger.
* Passionate about social causes and community transformation.
* Excited by the idea of building teams that create social impact.
* Someone who takes ownership and follows through.

**Why Join Lighthouse Communities Foundation?**

**Your Hiring Decisions Can Create Impact**

The people you bring into Lighthouse will work directly or indirectly towards creating better opportunities for underserved youth.

Your work will help build the teams that make this transformation possible.

**Learn Beyond Recruitment**

**You'll gain exposure to:**

* Talent acquisition.
* Employer branding.
* People management.
* Organisational development.
* Social\-sector talent ecosystems.
* Diversity and inclusion.
* Mission\-driven recruitment.

**Work With Purpose**

Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and purpose\-driven organisation where people and impact matter.

**Grow Your Career**

At Lighthouse, you'll have opportunities to learn, experiment, take ownership, and grow your recruitment capabilities while contributing to a larger mission.

**What Success Looks Like**

**You'll know you're making an impact when:**

* The right people are joining the right roles.
* Hiring managers trust you as a talent partner.
* Candidates have a positive experience with Lighthouse.
* Recruitment pipelines are healthy and diverse.
* Positions move efficiently through the hiring process.
* New employees feel welcomed from day one.
* Recruitment data helps the organisation make better hiring decisions.
* The teams you help build are stronger, more capable, and aligned with Lighthouse's mission.

description:
**People Are at the Heart of Impact.**

**At Lighthouse Communities Foundation, our work is about creating opportunities for young people.**

**But sustainable impact doesn't happen without the people behind it.**

Great Centre Heads.  
Committed facilitators.  
Passionate outreach teams.  
Strong program leaders.  
People who show up every day because they believe the work matters.

**We're looking for an HR Business Partner who can help these people thrive.**

This is a hands\-on, field\-facing HR role where you'll work closely with leaders and teams across Hyderabad, understand what is happening on the ground, solve people challenges, strengthen HR practices, and help build a culture where employees can do their best work.

If you see HR as more than policies and processes — and believe that **strong people practices create stronger social impact** — this could be your opportunity.

**About Lighthouse Communities Foundation**

**Lighthouse Communities Foundation (LCF)** works in the areas of skilling, employability, and livelihoods for underserved youth.

Our Lighthouse model brings together **Government, Corporates, NGOs, and Communities** through a Public\-Private Partnership to create sustainable pathways towards employment and socio\-economic transformation.

Our centres are built around collaboration — with different stakeholders contributing resources, expertise, networks, and capabilities to help young people access better opportunities.

**Our work is guided by:**

**Empathy \| Inclusion \| Integrity \| Courage**

**Your Role: Be the Bridge Between People \& Purpose**

As an HR Business Partner, you'll partner with regional leadership, Centre Heads, program teams, and employees to make sure our people practices support both **employee experience and organisational outcomes**.

You'll work across:

**Hiring → Onboarding → Development → Performance → Employee Relations → Culture → Organisational Growth**

And because our teams work across centres and communities, this is a **field\-facing HR role**.

You won't just hear about people challenges in meetings.

**You'll go where the teams are. Listen. Understand. Solve. Build.**

**What You Will Do**

**Partner With Leaders \& Teams**

* Act as the primary HR point of contact for employees and managers across the assigned region.
* Partner with Centre Heads and program leaders on people\-related matters.
* Understand team dynamics, people challenges, and organisational needs.
* Provide practical HR guidance to managers and employees.
* Coach leaders on people management and employee\-related issues.
* Ensure HR support is timely, accessible, and solution\-oriented.

**Build Teams That Can Deliver Impact**

**Great programs need great people.**

**You'll support the complete employee journey, including:**

* Recruitment coordination.
* Candidate screening.
* Interview processes.
* Offer and joining coordination.
* Employee onboarding.
* New\-hire orientation.
* Early\-stage employee support.

**You'll work closely with hiring managers and central HR to ensure we bring in people who are not only capable, but also aligned with our values and mission.**

**Help People Grow**

* Partner with central HR teams to implement learning and development initiatives.
* Identify capability\-building needs across teams.
* Support training and development programs.
* Encourage a culture of continuous learning.
* Work with managers to identify development opportunities for their teams.

**Make Performance Management Meaningful**

**Performance management should be more than an annual form.**

**You'll support managers and employees with:**

* Goal setting.
* Performance reviews.
* Development planning.
* Regular feedback.
* Performance conversations.
* Capability\-building interventions.
* Performance improvement processes where required.

**The goal is to create clarity, accountability, and growth — while ensuring performance practices are fair and aligned with organisational expectations.**

**Support Employee Relations**

* Serve as a trusted HR partner for employees and managers.
* Listen to employee concerns and help identify appropriate solutions.
* Support resolution of workplace issues in a fair and timely manner.
* Help managers navigate sensitive people situations.
* Promote a positive, respectful, and inclusive work environment.
* Ensure organisational policies and processes are understood and followed.

**Strengthen HR Practices Across Centres**

**Our teams work across different centres and communities.**

**You'll help ensure consistency while remaining sensitive to local realities.**

**This includes:**

* Implementing HR policies and processes.
* Supporting compliance requirements.
* Ensuring employees understand relevant policies.
* Identifying gaps in HR processes.
* Working with central HR to improve employee experience.
* Ensuring HR practices are aligned with organisational goals, values, and requirements.

**Use Data to Understand People**

**Good HR decisions need more than intuition.**

**You'll:**

* Monitor HR metrics and trends.
* Track hiring, onboarding, retention, performance, and other relevant people indicators.
* Identify patterns and areas requiring attention.
* Generate insights for leadership.
* Recommend practical solutions to improve HR effectiveness.

The question isn't just:

**“What is the number?”**

It's:

**“What is the number telling us about our people?”**

Be Present Where the Work Happens

This role involves **up to 70% travel across centres in the assigned region**.

**You'll spend significant time with teams on the ground, building relationships, understanding local realities, and providing hands\-on HR support.**

**If you're someone who enjoys being close to the action rather than spending every day behind a desk, you'll enjoy this role.**

**Who Are We Looking For?**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration**, or a related field.
* Master's degree is preferred.

Experience

* **3–4 years of HR experience**.
* Experience in areas such as:
* Talent acquisition
* Employee relations
* Performance management
* Learning \& development
* People management
* Organisational development

**Experience in a nonprofit, social\-impact, education, skilling, or field\-based organisation is an advantage.**

**Communication**

* Excellent communication skills in **English and Hindi**.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with employees across different roles and backgrounds.
* Strong listening, facilitation, and problem\-solving skills.

**You'll Thrive in This Role If...**

**You're someone who:**

* Sees HR as a business and people partner — not just a process owner.
* Is comfortable having difficult conversations with empathy and clarity.
* Can coach a manager through a people problem rather than simply quoting policy.
* Enjoys meeting people where they work.
* Can move comfortably between strategic conversations and operational problem\-solving.
* Is curious about what is happening on the ground.
* Can work with people from very different backgrounds and roles.
* Is comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.
* Can work independently and take ownership.
* Believes that inclusion is something you **build into everyday decisions**, not just something you write in a policy.
* Is genuinely motivated by the idea that better people practices can lead to better outcomes for young people.

**What Success Looks Like**

**In this role, success isn't simply:**

**“HR processes were completed.”**

It's when:

* The right people are hired at the right time.
* New employees feel welcomed and supported.
* Managers become stronger people leaders.
* Employees know what is expected of them.
* Performance conversations happen with clarity and fairness.
* Teams feel heard and supported.
* People challenges are addressed before they become organisational problems.
* Employees have opportunities to learn and grow.
* HR data helps leaders make better decisions.
* And ultimately, our teams are better equipped to create impact for young people.

**Why Join Lighthouse?**

**Build the People Behind the Impact**

**At Lighthouse, you'll get the opportunity to work at the intersection of:**

**People \+ Purpose \+ Field Operations \+ Organisational Development**

You'll work with diverse teams, engage with leaders across centres, and experience the realities of building people systems in a growing social\-impact organisation.

You'll also be part of an organisation where our values matter:

**Empathy \| Inclusion \| Integrity \| Courage**

Because creating opportunities for young people starts with creating an environment where the people doing the work can **learn, grow, contribute, and thrive.**

Ready to Build the People Behind the Mission?

If you're an HR professional who wants to move beyond transactional HR and become a genuine **people partner**, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Civil Engineer
description:
Job Description – Civil Engineer \| CAD \& Site

WorkPosition: Civil Engineer

Department: Engineering / Projects

Experience: 0–2 Years

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Location: Chinchwad

Reporting To: Project Manager / Senior Civil Engineer

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Civil Engineer** with good technical knowledge and practical understanding of civil engineering activities. The candidate will be responsible for **CAD drafting, preparation and modification of drawings, site visits, measurements, project coordination, documentation, and providing technical support for ongoing projects**.

The role will involve a combination of **office\-based CAD/design work and field/site work**. The candidate should therefore be comfortable travelling to project sites, company locations, or client locations whenever required.

Freshers with good knowledge of **AutoCAD/CAD software**, basic civil engineering concepts, and a willingness to work on\-site may also apply.

Key Responsibilities1\. CAD \& Drawing Work

* Prepare, modify, and update **2D drawings using AutoCAD/CAD software**.
* Prepare civil engineering drawings based on project requirements and instructions from senior engineers.
* Read and interpret engineering drawings, layouts, plans, and technical specifications.
* Make necessary corrections and revisions to drawings as per project requirements.
* Assist in preparing **plans, elevations, sections, layouts, and detailed drawings**.
* Maintain proper records of drawings and ensure the latest revisions are used.
* Coordinate with senior engineers/design teams for drawing\-related requirements.
* Ensure drawings are prepared accurately and according to the required specifications.

2\. Site Visits \& Field Work

* Visit project sites/company locations as required for **measurements, inspections, coordination, and technical support**.
* Take site measurements and collect relevant technical information.
* Verify site conditions against drawings and project requirements.
* Coordinate with site supervisors, contractors, vendors, and other personnel.
* Monitor ongoing civil work and report observations to the reporting manager.
* Identify discrepancies between drawings and actual site conditions and communicate them to the concerned team.
* Assist senior engineers in resolving site\-related technical issues.
* Ensure that work is carried out according to approved drawings and instructions.

3\. Project Coordination

* Coordinate between the **office/design team and site team**.
* Assist in planning and execution of civil engineering activities.
* Follow up on project\-related requirements with internal teams, contractors, and vendors.
* Assist in ensuring timely completion of assigned project activities.
* Communicate project updates, site observations, and technical requirements to the reporting manager.
* Attend site/client meetings when required.

4\. Measurement \& Estimation Support

* Take and record measurements at project sites.
* Assist in preparing **quantity calculations, BOQs, material requirements, and estimates**.
* Check measurements and quantities against drawings and actual site conditions.
* Assist in preparing material requirement statements and project documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of measurements and project\-related data.

5\. Quality \& Safety

* Ensure civil work is carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, and quality requirements.
* Identify and report quality\-related issues observed at the site.
* Assist senior engineers in maintaining project quality standards.
* Follow company and site safety procedures during site visits.
* Ensure proper use of PPE and adherence to basic safety practices while working at project sites.

6\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain project\-related drawings, documents, measurements, and records.
* Prepare daily/weekly site reports as required.
* Maintain records of drawing revisions and approvals.
* Document site observations and communicate them to the reporting manager.
* Assist in preparing project progress reports and other engineering documentation.
* Maintain organized CAD files and project folders.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Civil Engineer will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and quality of CAD drawings.
* Timely completion of assigned drawings and engineering tasks.
* Accuracy of site measurements and documentation.
* Effective coordination between office and site teams.
* Timely completion of assigned project activities.
* Adherence to project specifications and quality standards.
* Ability to identify and communicate site\-related issues.
* Proper maintenance of engineering documents and records.
* Responsiveness to site and project requirements.

Required Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of **AutoCAD/CAD software**.
* Ability to read and understand civil engineering drawings.
* Basic knowledge of civil engineering principles and construction practices.
* Understanding of plans, elevations, sections, and layouts.
* Basic knowledge of quantity estimation and measurements.
* Knowledge of MS Office, particularly **Excel and Word**.
* Ability to prepare and maintain technical documentation.
* Basic knowledge of construction materials and methods.
* Knowledge of surveying/site measurements will be an advantage.

Required Soft Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good problem\-solving ability.
* Willingness to travel to project sites/company locations.
* Comfortable working in both **office and site environments**.
* Ability to coordinate with contractors, vendors, supervisors, and internal teams.
* Attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
* Good time\-management skills.
* Willingness to learn and take responsibility.
* Professional and positive attitude.

Educational Qualification

* **B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering** from a recognized university/institution.
* Diploma in Civil Engineering candidates with relevant skills/experience may also be considered.

Experience

* **0–2 years** of experience in Civil Engineering, CAD Drafting, Construction, Site Engineering, or related roles.
* Freshers with good **AutoCAD knowledge** and willingness to work at project sites are welcome to apply.
* Candidates with experience in both CAD and site work will be preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should:

* Have a **B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering**.
* Have good working knowledge of **AutoCAD**.
* Be comfortable working on drawings as well as visiting project sites.
* Be willing to travel to company/client/project locations whenever required.
* Have basic knowledge of construction and civil engineering activities.
* Be comfortable taking site measurements and coordinating with site personnel.
* Have good communication and reporting skills.
* Be willing to work in a practical, project\-oriented environment.
* Have a willingness to learn and grow with the organization.

Nature of Work

This position involves a combination of:

**CAD/Drawing Work → Site Visits → Measurements → Technical Coordination → Project Documentation → Site Support → Project Execution**

The candidate should be comfortable with both **desk\-based engineering work and field/site responsibilities**.

title: Product Support Engineer - Google Cloud
description:
****Synopsis of the role:**
 Ready to work on the front lines of data delivery, leveraging the power of Google Cloud? If you're a detail\-oriented problem\-solver who enjoys working with sophisticated technology and contributing to a mission\-critical platform, this role is for you!
   

  

 As a Product Support Analyst within the Technical Fulfillment team, you’ll configure, operate and monitor our high\-volume batch data delivery platform built on Google Cloud. You will play a key role in processing and enriching financial data for our clients, ensuring seamless and precise execution with a strong focus on quality and reliability gaining invaluable experience in a dynamic and evolving technological landscape.
   

  

**What you’ll do** 
 :**
**Platform Configuration and Operation:**
* Configure and execute data processing workflows on our batch delivery platform according to established procedures and client specifications.
* Deploy and manage complex data pipelines orchestrated via Apache Airflow.
* Leverage and extend Standard Airflow DAG Templates to ensure deployment consistency and rapid iteration across environments.
* Monitor the execution of data processing jobs, identifying and addressing any issues to ensure timely and accurate delivery.
* Perform data quality checks and validation to ensure the integrity and accuracy of processed information.
* Diagnose and resolve complex configuration, scheduling, and dependency issues within the GCP platform and its associated infrastructure.
* Adhere to established security protocols and maintain the highest standards of data security and privacy in all configuration activities.
* Follow SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) guidelines for any configuration deployments or changes.
* Maintain accurate records of configurations, processes, and any issues encountered.
* Stay up\-to\-date with platform updates, new features, and relevant technical information.
* Contribute to the identification of opportunities for process improvement and automation within the configuration workflows.
* Assist in the creation and maintenance of our configuration documentation and knowledge base articles.


**Client Focus:**
* Understand the importance of accurate and timely data delivery for our clients.
* Support the team in addressing client inquiries and resolving fulfillment\-related issues.
* Take ownership of precise, high\-stakes data configurations that directly impact client trust and business outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional partners (including Engineering and Data Operations) to resolve issues and improve delivery processes.


****What experience you need:****
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology or equivalent.
* Strong analytical, detail\-oriented, and proactive approach to problem solving.
* Familiarity with data processing concepts and batch delivery systems.
* Experience working with configuration files (e.g., YAML).
* Understanding of cloud computing concepts, ideally with some exposure to GCP.
* Familiarity with different file encoding formats.
* Experience with API tools for testing and understanding data interfaces.
* Basic scripting skills (e.g., shell scripting) are an asset.


****What could set you apart:****
* Ability to verify issues by testing in higher environments, be on\-call support for Production Incidents as needed.
* Experience with GCP services such as Dataflow, Composer, Cloud Storage, or BigQuery.
* Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools within a cloud environment (e.g., Google Cloud Logging and Monitoring)
* Proficiency in scripting (Python) or object\-oriented programming languages (Java).


**If you're eager to dive into the Google Cloud and the world of data delivery, apply now to join our innovative team!**

title: Transport Modeler
description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
 Are you enthusiastic about how transportation, land use, socioeconomics, and technology intersect and its real\-world impacts on people’s lives and communities? Do you have a passion to empower regional planning policies and decisions with state\-of\-the\-art transportation planning tools? Are you ready to take on the challenge to deliver highly innovative transportation planning projects that will shape and inspire a sustainable, prosperous, and resilient future? If so, consider joining our innovative Planning team at WSP ! for Canada Business. We are looking for a Junior or Intermediate Transportation Planner/Engineer/Data Scientist to join our team.
   

  

 We focus on the development and application of travel demand models to support multi\-modal transportation planning and policy projects. We specialize in advanced, activity\-based demand modelling techniques to forecast regional population travel patterns and future transportation networks given proposed land uses, transportation infrastructure, and policies. Our proven record for developing industry\-leading solutions include the Cities, Municipalities and Regional Travel Demand Model and its implementations. We are trusted advisors and close collaborators with municipal, regional, and provincial governments, transportation agencies, and academia.
   

  

 We are also actively growing Transportation Planning practice that is rooted in our team’s strong data analytics and visualization capabilities. This involves developing bespoke software solutions to help clients analyze large and complex data sources to derive useful insights and answer complex questions.
   

  

 As a member of the GCC Planning team, you will be part of a forward\-thinking team that seeks to improve transportation mobility through the delivery of travel demand models and data\-driven insights. Depending on the project, work may involve a combination of macro/meso/microscopic modelling, and data science. You will also be part of the broader, multi\-disciplinary Transportation Planning and Science practice and will closely collaborate with other planners and engineers on transportation master plans, secondary plans, environmental assessments, policy studies, and other transportation planning projects.
   

  

 We offer a team\-focused environment that encourages rapid career growth, flexible work arrangements, and a highly competitive benefits package. Join us and be part of a leading national professional services firm that is committed to designing and planning sustainable cities!
   

  

****RESPONSIBILITIES****
**What Skills and Qualifications are needed?**
* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Urban Planning, Computer Science, Economics, or a related discipline, and/or 1\-3 years of equivalent work experience
* Demonstrable experience with computer programming (preferably Python and/or R)
* Strong and proven background in statistics and data analysis
* Strong oral and technical writing communication skills
* Excellent attention to detail
* A great fit working within our close\-knit team culture
* Knowledge of travel demand model design and application, including experience with activity\-based models and platforms
* Proficiency with travel demand modelling software (EMME, VISUM, TransCAD, Cube)
* Experience in meso/microscopic traffic simulations (Aimsun, VISSIM, Viswalk, DYNAMEQ, Synchro, Sidra, HCS)
* Experience with GIS
* Experience applying statistical analyses for model estimation and calibration
* Experience building and applying machine learning models
* Experience with data visualization front\-end development using HTML, CSS, and common web libraries and frameworks


**MICROSIMULATION**
****RESPONSIBILITIES****
* Compiling and analyzing transportation data;
* Undertaking transportation studies, including complex traffic operations studies including capacity analysis using modeling tools such as Synchro/SimTraffic, Vissim, Aimsun Next;
* Conduct traffic impact studies, traffic signal and intersection improvement evaluations, traffic management plan evaluations and safety reviews;
* Liaising with team members;
* Preparing technical reports;
* Other duties as assigned/required.


****QUALIFICATIONS****
* Post\-secondary education in Civil Engineering or Transportation Engineering from an accredited university;
* Excellent attention to detail
* Proficiency in traffic simulation modelling (Synchro/SimTraffic, VISSIM, Aimsun Next, SYDRA, ARCADY) and travel demand modelling (EMME, TransCAD);
* Skills and experience in traffic engineering; specifically travel demand forecasting, traffic operations analysis, and safety analysis;
* Ability to work independently, with minimal supervision, and in a team environment;
* Ability to communicate effectively, orally and in writing; including the ability to prepare and present complex technical reports, research and analysis;
* Ability to develop analysis tools, applications, and macros using computer programming (e.g. VBA, Python, C\#, etc.) would be an asset.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**DevOps Engineer**
**Opening Paragraph**
 As EY continues to evolve and modernize its digital platforms, we are seeking a talented DevOps Engineer to help accelerate the delivery, reliability, and scalability of our enterprise solutions. This role sits at the intersection of development, operations, automation, and cloud infrastructure, enabling teams to deliver innovative business capabilities faster and more securely. You will play a critical role in supporting modern digital experiences, driving automation, and ensuring our platforms operate efficiently and securely across a global environment.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 This is an exciting opportunity to join a high\-performing technology team focused on delivering business\-critical services and digital capabilities. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the infrastructure, automation, and deployment processes that support our applications and platforms.
   

  

 You will work closely with development, operations, architecture, and business stakeholders to implement modern DevOps practices, improve operational efficiency, and enhance platform reliability. This role offers exposure to enterprise\-scale systems, cloud technologies, automation frameworks, and continuous improvement initiatives while providing opportunities to influence the future direction of our technology landscape.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting and enhancing the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational processes that enable successful delivery of applications and services.
   

  

**Key responsibilities include:**
* Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure solutions that support application hosting, data processing, analytics, and enterprise services.
* Develop and manage Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to streamline software delivery and improve deployment quality and consistency.
* Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging capabilities to ensure system health, availability, and performance visibility.
* Automate operational and administrative tasks to reduce manual effort, increase efficiency, and improve reliability.
* Collaborate with development, operations, product, and business teams to ensure solutions meet business requirements and are delivered successfully.
* Support software releases, deployments, and infrastructure maintenance activities as required.
* Ensure platforms and services comply with organizational security standards, governance requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Develop and implement best practices for access management, data protection, and system security.
* Analyze system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimization strategies to improve scalability and operational efficiency.
* Participate in troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis of production issues, driving long\-term corrective actions and continuous improvement.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Success in this role requires a combination of technical expertise, problem\-solving ability, collaboration, and a passion for automation and continuous improvement. You will be effective in a fast\-paced environment where you can balance operational excellence with innovation and partnership across multiple teams.
   

  

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise infrastructure environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Knowledge of monitoring, logging, and observability tools and practices.
* Experience automating operational processes using scripting and automation technologies.
* Understanding of security best practices, access controls, compliance requirements, and infrastructure governance.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to solve complex technical problems.
* Experience working collaboratively with cross\-functional teams in an Agile delivery environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.


**Ideally, You'll Also Have**
* Experience with cloud platforms and modern cloud operations practices.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) methodologies and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of performance tuning, scalability planning, and system optimization.
* Experience supporting enterprise application deployments and release management processes.
* Experience working within large, globally distributed teams.
* Relevant DevOps, cloud, or infrastructure certifications.


**What We Look For**
 We are looking for individuals who are curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning. The ideal candidate is proactive, adaptable, and comfortable taking ownership of challenges while working across global teams. You will be someone who embraces innovation, shares knowledge openly, and consistently seeks opportunities to improve processes, technology, and outcomes. A positive attitude, strong communication skills, and the ability to balance independent work with effective teamwork will be critical for success.
   

  

**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, you'll have the opportunity to build a career as unique as you are, supported by a global scale, an inclusive culture, and technology to help you become the best version of yourself. You'll work on meaningful projects that impact our people, clients, and business while collaborating with talented professionals across diverse disciplines and geographies.
   

  

 We invest in our people through continuous learning, professional development, mentoring, and leadership opportunities. You'll be empowered to bring your ideas forward, challenge the status quo, and contribute to innovative solutions that help shape the future of our organization.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

This role sits at the intersection of development, operations, automation, and cloud infrastructure, enabling teams to deliver innovative business capabilities faster and more securely. You will play a critical role in supporting modern digital experiences, driving automation, and ensuring our platforms operate efficiently and securely across a global environment.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 This is an exciting opportunity to join a high\-performing technology team focused on delivering business\-critical services and digital capabilities. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the infrastructure, automation, and deployment processes that support our applications and platforms.
   

  

 You will work closely with development, operations, architecture, and business stakeholders to implement modern DevOps practices, improve operational efficiency, and enhance platform reliability. This role offers exposure to enterprise\-scale systems, cloud technologies, automation frameworks, and continuous improvement initiatives while providing opportunities to influence the future direction of our technology landscape.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting and enhancing the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational processes that enable successful delivery of applications and services.
   

  

**Key responsibilities include:**
* Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure solutions that support application hosting, data processing, analytics, and enterprise services.
* Develop and manage Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to streamline software delivery and improve deployment quality and consistency.
* Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging capabilities to ensure system health, availability, and performance visibility.
* Automate operational and administrative tasks to reduce manual effort, increase efficiency, and improve reliability.
* Collaborate with development, operations, product, and business teams to ensure solutions meet business requirements and are delivered successfully.
* Support software releases, deployments, and infrastructure maintenance activities as required.
* Ensure platforms and services comply with organizational security standards, governance requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Develop and implement best practices for access management, data protection, and system security.
* Analyze system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimization strategies to improve scalability and operational efficiency.
* Participate in troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis of production issues, driving long\-term corrective actions and continuous improvement.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Success in this role requires a combination of technical expertise, problem\-solving ability, collaboration, and a passion for automation and continuous improvement. You will be effective in a fast\-paced environment where you can balance operational excellence with innovation and partnership across multiple teams.
   

  

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**
* Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise infrastructure environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Knowledge of monitoring, logging, and observability tools and practices.
* Experience automating operational processes using scripting and automation technologies.
* Understanding of security best practices, access controls, compliance requirements, and infrastructure governance.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to solve complex technical problems.
* Experience working collaboratively with cross\-functional teams in an Agile delivery environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.


**Ideally, You'll Also Have**
* Experience with cloud platforms and modern cloud operations practices.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) methodologies and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of performance tuning, scalability planning, and system optimization.
* Experience supporting enterprise application deployments and release management processes.
* Experience working within large, globally distributed teams.
* Relevant DevOps, cloud, or infrastructure certifications.


**What We Look For**
 We are looking for individuals who are curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning. The ideal candidate is proactive, adaptable, and comfortable taking ownership of challenges while working across global teams. You will be someone who embraces innovation, shares knowledge openly, and consistently seeks opportunities to improve processes, technology, and outcomes. A positive attitude, strong communication skills, and the ability to balance independent work with effective teamwork will be critical for success.
   

  

**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, you'll have the opportunity to build a career as unique as you are, supported by a global scale, an inclusive culture, and technology to help you become the best version of yourself. You'll work on meaningful projects that impact our people, clients, and business while collaborating with talented professionals across diverse disciplines and geographies.
   

  

 We invest in our people through continuous learning, professional development, mentoring, and leadership opportunities. You'll be empowered to bring your ideas forward, challenge the status quo, and contribute to innovative solutions that help shape the future of our organization.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Email the clients to inform them of the policy breach and help them in deleting the restricted files.
* To address any queries the clients may have, you will be expected to work closely with the product and technical teams.
* Publish monthly reports to stakeholders about the number of cases handled and the results.
* Create, maintain, and improve processes for detection and mitigation of abusive activity perpetrated through usage of our products
* Liaison with various representatives of the intelligence community, domestic and global law enforcement, industry, and cyber\-crime watchdogs that specialize in abuse mitigation to enable rapid exchange of data and take prompt action against miscreants
* Perform forensic analysis of malware, spam, phishes/spoofs and other abuse incidents to understand modus operandi and implement countermeasures in partnership with support and system admin teams
* Proactively track and review abusive activity within our client base and take appropriate action, ensuring that our Terms of Usage are strictly adhered
* Work with and guide our dedicated operations team that receives complaints from Internet users about abusive activity, and communicates with clients and channel partners to take appropriate action
* Gather actionable intelligence and understand threats by using data obtained from various black lists, browsing various fraud forums, communicating with affected parties and so forth
* Participate in discussions within the Internet security community at large, with a view to gather intelligence and refine our processes based on industry/technology trends
* Educate our channel partners about best practices in abuse and fraud mitigation by conducting webinars and presentations, blogging etc.

* Experience: 0\-1 years in Customer Service or similar capacity, preferably on an IT platform
* Outstanding communication skills
* Sound knowledge of Internet, web technologies, operating systems and networking concepts; ability to rapidly learn new concepts
* Excellent presentation skills
* High level of interest in cyber security
* High degree of motivation, with excellent follow through skills
* Logical and analytical bend of mind, with a penchant for solving complex problems
* Good investigative skills and consummate attention to detail

* Experience in a customer interaction capacity, preferably in a technical field

Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have 20 \+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.

title: TC-CS-CTM-Pentest-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Attack \& Penetration Testing \- Senior**
 As part of our Cyber Security team, you shall perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing. You shall also perform in\-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Security Consultant / Senior Security Consultant with expertise in penetration testing. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, web application, wireless, social engineering, physical penetration testing.
* Execute penetration testing projects using the established methodology, tools and rules of engagements.
* Execute red team assessments to highlight gaps impacting organizations security postures.
* Identify and exploit security vulnerabilities in a wide array of systems in a variety of situations.
* Perform in\-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
* Convey complex technical security concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences including executives.
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10 web and the ability to effectively communicate methodologies and techniques with development teams
* Understanding and experience with Active Directory attacks.
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Develop automated solutions that mitigate risks throughout the organization.
* Ability to automate DAST/SAST solutions and reporting
* Support SDLC and agile environments with application security testing and source code reviews.
* Provide technical leadership and advise to junior team members on attack and penetration test engagements.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Understanding of web\-based application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10\).
* Good understanding of enterprise security controls in Active Directory / Windows environments
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Understanding of network security and popular attacks vectors.
* Ability to communicate detailed technical information to a non\-technical audience clearly
* Experience with Operation Technology / Internet of Things, Cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), Active Directory and 802\.1x penetration testing
* Strong understanding of security principles, policies, and industry best practices
* Demonstrable flair for technical writing, including engagement reports, presentations and operating procedures


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* BE/ B.Tech/ MCA or equivalent
* Minimum of 6 years of work experience in penetration testing which may include at least three of the following: internet, intranet, web application penetration tests, wireless, social engineering, physical and Red Team assessments.
* One of the following certifications: OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, OSWE, CREST, CRTE, eCPTX, or eWPTX
* Knowledge of Windows, Linux, UNIX, any other major operating systems.
* 3\-4\-9 years of work experience in Strategy and Operations projects
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills
* Certifications: CISSP, GPEN, GWAPT.


**What We Look For**
* Who can perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing and provide analysis for the testing results.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Data Protection Field Engineer**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Field Engineer to help deploy, integrate, test, and troubleshoot AI\-enabled data protection solutions for global clients. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on helping clients secure sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, endpoint, collaboration, and AI\-enabled environments by combining strong data protection fundamentals with practical AI engineering skills. The role is designed for professionals with early\-career to mid\-career experience who enjoy solving real client problems in delivery settings and building technical depth in modern data protection. The internal role design emphasizes deployment, model/platform integration, testing, and troubleshooting, while comparable market roles emphasize customer\-facing engineering, rapid iteration, and production\-grade solution delivery.

* Configure, deploy, and support AI\-enabled data protection capabilities across client environments, including data discovery, classification, DLP\-aligned controls, PKI/KMS integrations, and information rights management patterns.
* Integrate data protection platforms with AI models, copilots, and enterprise workflows to help clients protect sensitive information used in prompts, retrieval sources, generated outputs, and broader AI use cases.
* Execute implementation, validation, testing, and troubleshooting tasks for client deployments, including configuration tuning, issue identification, root\-cause analysis, and stabilization support.
* Support workshops, technical assessments, pilots, and proof\-of\-value activities by translating business and security requirements into practical engineering tasks. External field/FDE patterns emphasize embedding closely with customers and iterating quickly based on feedback, which should be reflected in this role.
* Contribute to reusable playbooks, deployment guides, code snippets, engineering templates, and configuration standards that improve repeatability across engagements. Reusable accelerators and reference implementations are a common requirement in comparable AI engineering roles.
* Work with cross\-functional teams spanning cybersecurity, privacy, AI engineering, cloud, and client stakeholders to deliver secure and workable outcomes.


**Required Qualifications**
* Up to 5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: data protection, DLP, information protection, data discovery/classification, security engineering, cloud security, or related cybersecurity engineering domains.
* Working knowledge of data protection fundamentals, including data discovery and classification, DLP concepts, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Practical familiarity with AI/ML concepts relevant to data protection, including machine learning, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring.
* Experience with at least some of the following tools/platforms: Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, VS Code with AI extensions, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Cyera, Varonis, Sentra, CrowdStrike Falcon DSPM, Wiz DSPM, Microsoft Purview, Python, TensorFlow.
* Strong troubleshooting mindset, structured communication, and comfort working in client\-facing delivery environments. Field engineering patterns from Microsoft and AI FDE patterns from the market both strongly emphasize technical depth plus customer communication.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to Microsoft Purview, DSPM, CASB, sensitivity labeling, data lineage, encryption, or privacy engineering.
* Experience writing small scripts, automations, or integrations in Python.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP, and basic understanding of APIs and enterprise integrations. Comparable AI delivery roles frequently require these capabilities.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations*** Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation*** Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support*** Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance*** Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement*** Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:
* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

**Eligibility Requirements:*** Minimum age **18 years**.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:*** Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:*** Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence

  

  

Quality \& Accuracy

  

Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations

  

  

Operational Discipline

  

Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline

  

  

Teamwork \& Operational Support

  

Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**
