description:
Posting Description: **Job Code\-** 11988**Job Title**\- APAC Workforce Admin Lead**Solution Line\-** Global Support Services, People Organisation

**Position type\-** Full Time
**Work Location\-** Gurgaon/Bangalore**Working style\-** Hybrid**GCF Level\-** M40**Shift Time\-** 8AM to 5 PM IST**People Manager role:** Yes**Required education and certifications critical for the role\-**Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience required
PHR Certification or equivalent desired**Required years of experience –**10\+ years of relevant experience in a similar role. **AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**


At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.


As an organization, we are committed as one firm to our purpose, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.


**INFORMATION ABOUT THE BUSINESS**


Aon is a leading global professional services firm providing a broad range of risk, retirement, and health solutions. Our colleagues provide clients in over 120 countries and sovereignties with advice and solutions that give them the clarity and confidence to make better decisions to protect and grow their business. **GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF ROLE:**


The People Operations function delivers the operational, administrative, and transactional services that enable the People Organization to focus on strategy, advisory, governance, and risk management.
Within People Operations, regional teams provide end‑to‑end operational support across the employee lifecycle, which may include, but is not limited to:* Benefits and rewards operations
* Workforce data and administration
* HR knowledge management and colleague‑facing support (e.g., HR portals, FAQs)


The **Regional Workforce Admin Lead** leads these regional operational teams and will report into the People Operations Leader and partners closely with regional People Organization leaders and specialist teams (e.g., Benefits, People Matters, Talent, Total Rewards). The Regional Workforce Admin Lead is responsible for overseeing and continuously improving regional HR operations across the full employee lifecycle. This role leads teams that perform operational and administrative work to support the Colleague experience, ensuring services are delivered accurately, efficiently, and in line with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). While the People Organization owns program, policy, and advisory responsibilities, this role ensures that the underlying operations, processes, systems, and data that support those activities are efficient, consistent, accurate, and well‑coordinated. **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**:  

The colleague is responsible for:
* The Regional Workforce Admin Lead will have a variety of interactions with People Operations, the People Organization, managers, colleagues, and external providers, including:
* 
* **Team Leadership \& People Management:**
	+ Directly manage and develop a team, delivering HR operational services across the employee lifecycle
	+ Plan and manage team capacity, work allocation, and coverage across multiple processes and queues, ensuring support for peak periods, regional time zones, and urgent or sensitive matters
	+ Build a high‑performing, service‑oriented culture focused on accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement
	+ Set clear objectives, priorities, and development plans for team members in line with regional and global People Operations strategies
* **HR/People Operations Across Employee Lifecycle**:
	+ Oversee delivery of end‑to‑end HR operational processes, such as hiring, job and data changes, benefits and rewards administration, employee relations operations support, and exits/retirements, as applicable in the region
	+ Ensure operational processes are aligned to People Organization policies, local legal/regulatory requirements, and global People Operations standards
	+ Support cyclical HR activities (e.g., performance and compensation cycles, benefits renewals and enrollment, engagement initiatives) from an operational execution and readiness perspective
	+ Ensure that new or evolving HR services can be successfully transitioned into regional People Operations, including defining scope, processes, controls, knowledge content, and success measures
	+ Promote a consistent experience for colleagues and managers across all lifecycle touchpoints and channels
* **Operational Excellence \& Knowledge Management:**
* Design, implement, and maintain KPIs, SLAs, and operating standards that define expectations for quality, timeliness, and colleague experience
* Own and continuously improve SOPs, process maps, and work instructions for regional HR operations, ensuring documentation is accurate, accessible, and regularly reviewed
* Oversee HR operational knowledge bases and colleague‑facing content (e.g., HR portal, FAQs, standard communications) in partnership with the People Organization, ensuring content is current, clear, and operationally feasible
* Monitor performance against KPIs/SLAs; identify trends, root causes, and areas for improvement; and lead remediation and enhancement plans
* Partner with HR Technology, Data \& Analytics, and global People Operations to standardize processes and leverage tools, digitization, and automation where possible
* **Governance, Risk, and Third\-Party Management:**
* Establish and facilitate regular governance forums with People Organization counterparts, People Partners, and other stakeholders to:
	+ Review operational KPIs, SLAs, and service metrics
	+ Discuss trends, risks, and colleague experience feedback
	+ Agree on priorities and roadmap of continuous improvement initiatives
* Ensure appropriate controls, documentation, and audit trails are in place to manage operational risk and support compliance, privacy, and regulatory requirements across HR operations
* Coordinate with Internal Audit, Compliance, and other control functions as needed to prepare for and respond to audits and reviews
* Oversee relationships with third‑party providers supporting People operations in the region, working with Procurement and the People Organization to monitor performance, conduct regular service reviews, resolve escalations, and assess opportunities for improvement or change
* **Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration:**
* Act as the primary People Operations point of contact for regional HR partners, clearly communicating process expectations, timelines, and operational impacts
* Build strong partnerships with People Organization leaders and specialist teams (e.g., Benefits, People Matters, Talent, Total Rewards), People Partners, Employment Law, Compliance, Finance, Payroll, and other key stakeholders
* Represent the regional operational perspective in HR program and policy design discussions, ensuring operational feasibility, scalability, controls, and colleague experience are considered
* Capture and share regional feedback and insights, including operational data and colleague experience themes, to inform global and regional People strategies and decision‑making
* **Continuous Improvement, Change Management, and Service Delivery:**
* Identify and implement processes, technologies, and organizational improvements that enhance service quality, efficiency, and colleague satisfaction
* Lead or support transition and change activities when new work, new processes, or new tools are introduced into People Operations (including operational readiness planning, UAT, training, and cutover support)
* Encourage a culture where colleagues challenge the status quo, propose ideas, and use data and feedback to drive improvements
* Oversee service recovery for escalated issues or service failures, ensuring root causes are addressed and learnings are embedded into processes and controls

 **SKILLS/COMPETENCIES REQUIRED** :  

* Varied experience in HR operations/People Operations or a related shared services environment, preferably with regional or multi country scope
* Demonstrated experience leading operational teams across multiple HR process areas and through periods of change or growth
* Proven ability to design and manage SLAs, KPIs, and SOPs, and to use data and metrics to drive performance and decision making
* Experience working with HR systems, case management, and workflow tools, and comfort with introducing and embedding new technologies and processes.
* Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, performance management, and building high performing teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across geographies, cultures, and functions.
* Strong process and continuous improvement mindset, with a track record of simplifying, standardizing, and automating processes.
* High level of attention to detail, data accuracy, and governance, with the ability to manage confidential and sensitive information appropriately.

**HOW WE SUPPORT OUR COLLEAGUES**
In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workforce. At Aon, we believe a diverse workforce is an innovative workforce. Our agile, inclusive environment allows colleagues to manage their wellbeing and work/life balance while empowering you to be your authentic self.


Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging them to take time to focus on themselves. We offer a variety of workstyle options through our Smart Working model, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it!


Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips colleagues to learn, share and grow, helping them achieve their fullest potential. As a result, Aon colleagues are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Within the S\&T organization, we are building our Change Center of Excellence. The Change COE enables the S\&T strategic agenda by providing CM expertise supporting PepsiCo’s “Big Bets.” The Change CoE will lead Change Management for priority transformation programs by owning change management, global frameworks and tools, and through growing S\&T Change talent.

  



To enable this purpose, we are looking for a Change Management Associate Manager with change expertise and proven experienced supporting large and complex transformational projects; applying change tools and techniques to assess, diagnose, design, support, deliver and execute custom solutions needed for the successful delivery of the project. This role will work for Global Transportation program with key stakeholders, and focused on developing, managing, and executing transformational activities.

  


Responsibilities:
* Provide CM support needed to develop, deliver and execute change deliverables needed for the successful delivery of the project (e.g. impact assessments, readiness assessments, detailed change approach). Specifically; provide program design \& development project mgmt. support, develop detailed CM work and deliverables (impact assessments, sustainment plans, detail change approach). Assist in the integration of CM activities across sectors/functions.
* Provide hands\-on change management support needed for the execution of deliverables for sectors/functions that are under\-resourced
* Able to provide guidance and insights based on past experiences with similar projects and can help provide a robust perspective on cultural impacts/process implications
* Provide hands\-on support from a change, project management and analytics perspective for project / program stakeholders and Global S\&T Change CoE
* Provide CM training to functional teams and key stakeholders who are unfamiliar with change management principles, framework and tools
* Work with program stakeholder leads to design, develop and execute change strategy, plans, tools, and deliverables across key change areas within the PEP change planning framework: Assess, Plan, and Integrate \& Sustain, needed for the successful support and adoption of the project through the 5 As (Awareness, Acknowledgement, Acceptance, Activation, Adoption)
* Provides the inputs needed to support the development and execution of a change management strategy that mitigates risk and drives leadership alignment
	+ Executes tactical activities that include, but are not limited to: impact analyses, organizational readiness assessment, learning/training, change leadership, deployment/adoption measurement, sustainment plans
* Proactively supports multiple work streams to execute against the existing change plan

  


Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s Degree in HR, Organizational Development, Communications or related field
* Minimum 5 years of in\-depth experience in Change Management, Large\-scale global Transformations, Organizational Development, Organizational Effectiveness, Agile System Implementation, Consulting experience
* Proficiency in MS Office suite of applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, SharePoint etc.

description:
**Position Overview:**



Anaqua is looking for an HR Associate to support our India\-based workforce and partner closely with our global HR team. Reporting to the Sr. HR Regional Director in the U.S., this role is the day\-to\-day HR point of contact for employees in India — handling everything from statutory compliance and HRIS data to exit interview tracking and employee handbook maintenance. You'll work across time zones as part of a small, tight\-knit regional HR function, with real involvement over the processes you run and regular visibility into cross\-regional reporting and projects.

 **You'll Love This Job if You Like To:**


* Prepare recurring HR reports and dashboards for other departments and executives (headcount, attrition, leave utilization, and similar workforce metrics)
* Assist with periodic reviews and updates to the Employee Handbook, as requested
* Assist with managing onboarding and offboarding for India\-based employees, including documentation, background verification, and exit formalities
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date employee records in the HRIS
* Support statutory compliance activities
* Respond to employee questions on policies, benefits, and HR procedures
* Assist with recruitment coordination — scheduling interviews, preparing offer letters, and tracking background checks
* Support employee engagement and culture initiatives for the India team
* Conduct internal audits to check HR process compliance and consistency
* Partner with the Sr. HR Regional Director on ad hoc regional and global HR projects
* Maintain a high level of confidentiality when handling sensitive employee information
* Assist with any visa letters required for business travel

  


**What You'll Need to Be Successful:**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent experience
* 2–4 years of progressive HR generalist or HR associate experience, ideally within a multinational or technology company
* Working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory compliance requirements (PF, ESI, Gratuity, POSH, Shops \& Establishment Act)
* Experience with an HRIS platform (e.g., BambooHR, ADP, Workday, or similar)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to partner directly with a U.S.\-based manager and stakeholders across time zones
* High level of discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment with confidential information
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Proficiency in MS Office particularly Excel for reporting is a requirement
* Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and manage time well in a remote\-reporting structure
* Experience in the use of AI would be beneficial

  


**About Anaqua**



Anaqua, Inc. is a premium provider of integrated intellectual property (IP) management technology solutions and services. Anaqua's AQX platform combines best practice workflows with big data analytics and tech\-enabled services to create an intelligent environment designed to inform IP strategy, enable IP decision\-making, and streamline IP operations. Today, nearly half of the top 100 U.S. patent filers and global brands, as well as a growing number of law firms worldwide use Anaqua's solutions. The company's global operations are headquartered in Boston, with offices across the U.S., Europe, Asia, and Australia. For additional information, please visit anaqua.com, or on LinkedIn.

description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-255204 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 11, 2026 CATEGORY: Human Resources
**Role Name:** Compensation Senior Manager

**Department Name:** Total Rewards

**Role GCF:** 6A, Individual Contributor

**ABOUT AMGEN**


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Role Description:**


The Compensation Senior Manager serves as a strategic advisor and business partner to deliver world class end\-to\-end support across all facets of compensation. This role blends deep subject matter expertise with business acumen to guide (HR) business partners on compensation\-related decisions that drive attrition, motivation and retention of staff.


Acting as a trusted partner, the Senior Manager will contribute to the design and implementation of new future – ready compensation programs and frameworks, using analytical rigor to turn insights into impactful recommendations. Key focus areas of this role will be supporting the annual compensation cycle, holistic organizational design \& job leveling, leveraging AI, automation \& tech to drive continuous process improvement, and playing a leadership role in global rewards projects. With a continuous improvement mindset, and staying abreast of market trends \& developments, it will also drive simplification, automation, and process enhancements to elevate the efficiency and effectiveness of the Total Rewards function.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Act as trusted compensation partner delivering high\-quality consultative guidance and strategic support on all compensation\-related topics to (HR) business partners.
* Support the seamless execution of the year\-end cycle, including base, bonus, and equity planning, in close collaboration with (HR) business partners and the global Total Rewards team.
* Support compensation benchmarking initiatives by leveraging external survey data and internal analytics to ensure market competitiveness and internal equity.
* Provide strategic input and guidance on org design, role creation, job leveling, and internal mobility decisions for supported client groups.
* Drive or contribute to the execution of global compensation initiatives, such as M\&A, pay equity \& transparency analysis, compensation framework redesign, or job architecture development.
* Partner with global leadership to contribute to the design, rollout, change management, and refinement of future – oriented compensation programs \& frameworks that align with business goals and market practices.
* Use strong analytical skills to translate complex data into insights and compelling narratives that influence decision\-making and drive strategy.
* Identify opportunities to streamline \& simplify processes, reduce manual effort, and enhance user experience through automation, technology and digital tools.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws, pay equity \& transparency legislations, tax regulations, and corporate governance policies.
* Support the development and implementation of SOPs, knowledge bases, and training materials different audiences like (HR) business partners, Talent Acquisition, Tier 2 and Tier 3\.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Master’s degree in human resources, Finance, Business, or related field
* 12\+ years of progressive experience in compensation or Total Rewards, with experience supporting senior leadership in a consultative capacity
* Proven success managing complex compensation cycles and designing compensation programs in a matrixed, global environment

description:
**People \& Culture Lead** 




  





 We’re Hiring: HR Manager. Aka Chief Empathy Officer: the person who helps keep Aventis human.
 



  





 At Aventis Financial Services, we’re building a growing accounting, taxation, advisory, and outsourcing business, and we’re looking for someone to help us build the people side of the company.
 



  





 This is not just about payroll, interviews, policies, or compliance. Look after our people with genuine care, build trust across the team, improve onboarding and employee experience, strengthen culture, engagement, and communication, identify people issues early and handle them maturely, support leadership with honest, practical feedback, balance empathy with accountability and help Aventis stay professional, human, and value\-driven as we grow.
 



  





 Your background? Your background matters less than your mindset.
 



 You may come from HR, operations, administration, training, education, psychology, hospitality, client service, or team leadership.
 



  





 What matters most is that you are:
 


* Emotionally intelligent
* Practical and organised
* Clear in communication
* Trustworthy with confidential matters
* Comfortable having difficult conversations
* People\-focused but commercially sensible



  





 Role Details
 



 📍 Location: Pune
 



 🏢 Work Mode: Full\-time, in\-office
 



 💼 Company: Aventis Financial Services
 



 🧩 Role: HR Manager \| People \& Culture
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




  




* People \& Culture: Build trusted employee relationships and create a positive, inclusive and high\-performance workplace.
* Engagement \& Retention: Understand employee needs, identify concerns early and implement meaningful retention and development initiatives.
* HR Operations: Manage policies, documentation, onboarding, performance reviews and employee records.
* Employee Relations: Handle grievances and workplace conflicts fairly, professionally and confidentially.
* Recruitment: Manage hiring from role definition and candidate assessment through to onboarding.
* Leadership Support: Coach managers, oversee HR vendors and provide practical insights on people trends and risks.



  





  





**How to Apply** 




  





 Please email us your answers to these questions on
 **prat@aventis.com.au** 
 with updated resume:
 


* You have ₹3 Lacs per year in the “
 **Aventis People \& Happiness Wallet** 
 ”
* You cannot use it for routine initiatives like chai pe charcha, awards, fun Fridays, month\-end celebrations, or cricket clubs.
* How would you use this budget to make employees genuinely happier, healthier, more supported, and more connected?

* Name 3 traditional HR processes you believe should be rethought or improved.
* What is one non\-HR book every HR professional should read and why?



  





 Visit
 **www.aventis.com.au** 
 and tell us one thing you like, and one thing we should improve.

title: Manager, People Operations & HRBP – India & APAC
description:
**About Entrupy**
 Entrupy is a global technology company whose mission is to protect businesses, borders and consumers from transacting in counterfeit goods. Entrupy has developed a patented technology system which utilizes a combination of AI and computer vision to instantly identify and authenticate high value physical goods.
   

  

 Entrupy's solutions serve business customers including leading luxury brands, retailers, e\-commerce marketplaces and online resellers in over 60 countries. Entrupy is growing quickly with team members based in the US, India, Japan and Brazil. Entrupy's solutions in market:
   

  

* Entrupy Apparel Authentication
* Entrupy Bags \& Leather Goods Authentication
* Entrupy Sneaker Authentication
* Entrupy Fingerprinting


**As we continue to build...**
 We're seeking curious, growth minded thinkers to help shape our vision, structures and systems; playing a key\-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you're invigorated by our mission, values, and drive to change the world — we'd love to have you apply.
   

  

**About the Role**
 We're looking for an experienced
 **Manager, People Operations \& HRBP – India \& APAC** 
 to lead and scale People Operations across the region while partnering closely with managers and business leaders as an HR Business Partner.
   

  

 This role will own the employee lifecycle and operational foundation across India and APAC, including onboarding, offboarding, employment documentation, HR policies, compliance, and People programs. In addition, the role will provide hands\-on HRBP support to leaders on employee relations, performance, organizational changes, and people\-related decisions.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hybrid – Bangalore, India
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Chief People Officer
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Own the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle across India and APAC, from offer acceptance through offboarding.
* Lead onboarding and offboarding programs, ensuring a seamless and consistent employee experience.
* Manage employment offers, contracts, compensation changes, promotions, transfers, and other employee documentation.
* Own HR policies, handbooks, and operational processes while ensuring compliance with local employment laws.
* Partner with business leaders and managers as an HRBP, providing guidance on employee relations, performance management, organizational changes, and people decisions.
* Support performance reviews, promotions, compensation cycles, employee engagement initiatives, and other People programs.
* Coach managers on effective people management, feedback, performance conversations, and policy application.
* Partner with Legal, Finance, IT, and Talent Acquisition to ensure effective and scalable People processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve and automate HR processes, systems, and workflows.
* Develop and track People Operations metrics and provide insights to inform business and people decisions.
* Serve as a trusted resource for employees and managers on HR policies, processes, and employee lifecycle matters.
* Help build scalable People programs and processes as the organization grows across India and APAC.


**What We're Looking For:**
* **7–10 years of experience** 
 in People Operations, HRBP, or HR Operations roles, ideally in a high\-growth or global organization.
* Strong experience managing employee lifecycle operations, including onboarding, offboarding, employment documentation, and HR compliance.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with managers and business leaders as an HRBP.
* Strong knowledge of Indian employment law; experience supporting APAC markets is a plus.
* Experience with performance management, employee relations, organizational changes, and HR programs.
* Strong project management, organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with HRIS platforms such as BambooHR, HiBob, Rippling, Workday, or similar.
* A hands\-on, proactive, and solutions\-oriented approach with a strong focus on employee experience and operational excellence.


**What we offer**
* A hands\-on, mission\-critical role with direct impact on how Entrupy operates and grows in India
* Build and scale People Operations for a fast\-growing global technology company.
* Partner directly with executive leadership and shape the employee experience across India and APAC.
* Be part of a collaborative team that's redefining trust in the global resale economy.
* The opportunity to be part of building something from the ground up — with the backing of a global team and leadership that is invested in getting it right
* The chance to be part of a category\-defining company at an inflection point in its growth


 At Entrupy, we talk straight, think big, bring a growth mindset to everything we do, and make sure to embrace the fun along the way. If that sounds like you, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 We have had an incredible run so far and laying the foundation for a culture that is fast\-paced, entrepreneurial, and rooted in passion, kindness, and positivity. We live by these values – we hire by them, promote them, and celebrate them every day.
   

  

 Please apply if you want to be a part of a collaborative and dynamic team with a passion for working with high\-end luxury brands and cutting\-edge technology and want to be at the forefront of AI innovation.
   

  

 Entrupy embraces a diversity of backgrounds and experiences and provides equal opportunity for all applicants and employees. We are dedicated to building a company that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work (and work environment) will be for everyone.

title: Data Platform Consultant (DBT)
description:
### **Description**

  

**The headlines...**  

  

**Immediate Joiners Preferred**  

**Location** \- Hybrid in our central Pune office  

  

**A few application tips…**  

  

We want to help you put your best foot forward. Here are a few things we look for:* Clear, specific examples of your work and impact
* Relevant experience aligned with the role’s focus
* A thoughtful response to any application questions
* A resume that highlights both what you did and why it mattered

If you’re unsure whether your background is the “perfect fit,” we still encourage you to apply. We value potential and growth just as much as experience.  

  

**Why this role exists…**  

This role is designed to strengthen our delivery capability across our most strategic accounts in industries like Consumer Goods, Financial Services and Energy.  

As the demand for data and AI\-driven transformation grows, so does the need for structured, proactive project leadership. At Snap Analytics, we help clients unlock the full potential of their data, and we’re scaling fast**.**  

  

We’re building DBT capability on a project. As a small, agile organisation, we’re investing in people who can help us deliver quickly and grow our competency in India with support from UK colleagues. You’ll have clear impact from day one and room to move across projects as you develop.### **What you’ll be doing…**

  

You’ll play a central role in designing and delivering data transformations that power a high‑visibility project. You’ll work closely with project leads, project managers, and senior engineers to ship quality outcomes with increasing autonomy.  

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**
* **Data Modelling:** Design, develop, and maintain complex data models using dbt Core to support various business functions.
* **Pipeline Optimization:** Build and manage scalable data transformation pipelines within Snowflake, ensuring high performance and cost\-efficiency.
* **Code Quality:** Implement software engineering best practices in the data stack, including version control (Git), modularity, and CI/CD.
* **Testing \& Documentation:** Ensure data integrity by writing robust dbt tests and maintaining comprehensive documentation via dbt docs.
* **Performance Tuning:** Optimize Snowflake compute and storage by managing clustering keys, materialized views, and efficient SQL querying.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work closely with Data Analysts and Business Leads to translate business requirements into technical data schemas.

**In your first 3–6 months, success might look like:*** Delivering the majority of your assigned work independently, to a high standard (quality \+ on‑time)
* Demonstrating holistic project understanding \- how your work fits the wider data flow and business goals
* Building healthy working relationships across the India team and, over time, with UK stakeholders

  

### **What you’ll need to succeed…**

  

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of experience, curiosity, and collaboration.  

  

**You might be a great fit if you have:**
* **2 years’ experience** in dbt Core, including macros, packages (like dbt\-utils), and Jinja templating (we’re not considering freshers for this role)
* Strong **SQL** fundamentals and practical exposure to **DBT**
* Deep understanding of Snowflake\-specific features such as Tasks, Streams, Snowpipe, and Zero\-copy cloning.
* Familiarity with **Git/Bitbucket** and awareness of **CI/CD** concepts (nice to have)
* **Clear communication \-** you can articulate your thinking to technical and non‑technical partners
* **A** **learning mindset**: proactive, curious, and willing to work “a notch above” expectations (automation, generalising code, improving process)
* **Transparency** and ownership \- comfortable asking for help early and taking accountability for outcomes

**This role might not be the right fit if you’re looking for:*** Highly siloed work with very narrow task scopes (we value holistic project thinking)
* Constant step‑by‑step guidance (we expect growing autonomy and initiative)

  

### **Why choose Snap**

  

* **Impact from day one** on a new, high‑visibility project
* **Growth in a small, agile company** with opportunities to rotate across projects as you develop
* **Supportive team culture \-** mentorship from seniors, collaboration with India \& UK colleagues, open feedback and help‑seeking encouraged

### **About Snap Analytics**


We're a high\-growth data analytics consultancy on a mission to help enterprise businesses unlock the full potential of their data. With offices in the UK, India, and South Africa, we specialise in cutting\-edge cloud analytics solutions, transforming complex data challenges into actionable business insights.  

  

We partner with some of the biggest brands worldwide to modernise their data platforms, enabling smarter decision\-making through Snowflake, Databricks, Matillion, and other cloud technologies. Our approach is customer\-first, innovation\-driven, and results\-focused, delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision.  

  

At Snap, we’re not just consultants, we’re problem\-solvers, engineers, and strategists who thrive on tackling complex data challenges. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and pushing boundaries, ensuring our people grow just as fast as our business.  

  

Join us and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of data analytics!

Company: BajriX Private LimitedLocation: Jaipur, RajasthanJob Type: Part\-timeExperience: 0–2 YearsQualification: Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering or related fieldLaptop Requirement: Candidate must have their own laptop

About BajriX

BajriX is a technology\-enabled platform focused on simplifying the construction and home\-building ecosystem. We help buyers discover building materials, suppliers, and service professionals while enabling local sellers to take their businesses digital.

We are looking for a Junior Civil Engineer – Product Catalog \& Seller Onboarding who can support our seller onboarding and catalog operations team by understanding construction products, researching product information, and creating accurate and structured product listings.

Role Overview

This is primarily an office\-based product catalog and operations role, not a site\-engineering role.

The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of construction and building materials and should be comfortable with product research, Excel/data entry, internet research, and communicating with sellers and our sales team.

You will convert seller\-provided information such as catalogues, price lists, product photos, WhatsApp messages, brochures, and handwritten lists into accurate and structured product listings on BajriX.

Key Responsibilities

* Support the Sales and Seller Onboarding team in creating product listings for newly onboarded sellers.
* Understand and classify construction products into the correct BajriX categories.
* Research product information using manufacturer websites, official catalogues, brochures, and other reliable sources.
* Identify the correct brand, product name, model, variant, SKU or product family.
* Capture important product attributes such as size, thickness, grade, finish, material, packaging, application, unit, model number, etc.
* Convert unstructured seller information into standardized and structured product data.
* Review seller\-provided product names and descriptions and correct inconsistencies.
* Coordinate with sellers or the onboarding team when important product information is missing.
* Upload and maintain product details, images, specifications, pricing, MOQ, stock information, and other listing data.
* Ensure that duplicate or incorrect products are not created.
* Perform quality checks before product listings are approved or published.
* Maintain product/catalog data in Excel, Google Sheets, and internal BajriX systems.
* Help improve and expand BajriX’s master construction\-product catalogue.

Product Categories You May Work With

Cement, TMT Steel, Sand, Aggregate, Bricks, AAC Blocks, Tiles, Marble \& Granite, Plywood, Laminates, Hardware, Paints, Waterproofing, Plumbing, Sanitaryware, Electricals, Roofing, Doors \& Windows, Furniture Fittings, Construction Chemicals and other building materials.

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of construction materials and terminology.
* Strong internet and product research skills.
* Good attention to detail and accuracy.
* Comfortable working with Excel / Google Sheets.
* Ability to understand technical specifications and product catalogues.
* Good computer and data\-entry skills.
* Ability to differentiate between similar construction products and variants.
* Good Hindi communication skills.
* Basic written English.
* Willingness to learn new product categories.
* Ability to work closely with sales and operations teams.
* Must have a personal laptop and be comfortable using it for day\-to\-day work.

Preferred Candidate

We would particularly like to hear from candidates who:

* Have completed or are pursuing Diploma/B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering.
* Are freshers, students, or have up to 2 years of experience.
* Have worked with a construction\-material supplier, dealer, distributor, contractor, or builder.
* Have exposure to procurement, estimation, billing, BOQ, construction materials, or site work.
* Have knowledge of brands and products commonly used in the Jaipur/Rajasthan construction market.
* Enjoy research and working with structured data.

Important

This position is not primarily a site supervision role.

It is a part\-time role suited for someone who understands construction products and is interested in working in technology, catalog operations, research, and the digital construction ecosystem.

Having your own laptop is mandatory for this role.

Why Join BajriX?

You will get exposure to hundreds of construction\-product categories, brands, suppliers, and real\-world market data while working closely with the sales, product, technology, and founding teams.

You will contribute directly to building one of the most important parts of BajriX — its structured construction\-product catalogue.

If you understand construction materials, enjoy research, and are comfortable working with data and technology, we would love to hear from you.

* Serial communication
* Debugging and troubleshooting

Communication

Knowledge of:

* RS232

* TCP/IP
* Ethernet

Electronics

* Basic digital and analog electronics
* Sensors and signal conditioning

Hands\-on Assembly Responsibilities

description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region .
   

  

 What you have
   

  

 Advisor Wealth \& Asset Technology (AWAT) is an organization within Schwab Technology Services aligned to support the technology needs of Registered Independent Advisor (RIA), Schwab Asset Management (SAM), Wealth \& Advice Solutions (WAS), the Schwab Center for Financial Research (SCFR), and Third\-Party Platform teams.
   

  

 Join a team that is redefining operational excellence at Schwab. As part of AWAT Technology Operations, you'll play a key role in supporting critical Advisory, Wealth and Asset Management platforms while driving the next generation of Site Reliability Engineering practices. As a Support Engineer, you will be part of a collaborative production support team focused on keeping critical applications and platforms stable and highly available, resilient, and ready to support business growth. You will apply your technical expertise to solve complex operational challenges, strengthen system reliability, and improve the experience of both internal and external business partners. With a strong focus on automation, observability, and continuous improvement, you will help shape a more proactive, scalable SRE support model. If you are energized by ownership, modern support practices, incident management, and building smarter tools that make a real difference, this is a great opportunity to grow your career with Schwab.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Support, DevOps, or Systems Engineering supporting highly available, client\-facing enterprise applications.
* Understanding of SRE principles, including reliability, scalability, resiliency, observability, automation, toil reduction, and operational excellence.
* Hands\-on experience with incident management, problem management, change management, root cause analysis, post\-incident reviews, and continuous service improvement practices.
* Experience defining, measuring, and improving SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, KPIs, availability, performance, and reliability metrics for production systems.
* Working knowledge of observability and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana Cloud, OpenTelemetry, ThousandEyes, or similar tools, including dashboards, alerting, logs, metrics, and traces.
* Familiar with one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Bash, or Shell to automate operational tasks and support troubleshooting.
* Familiar with CI/CD and engineering collaboration tools such as GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Atlassian products
* Experience supporting applications hosted on cloud or platform environments such as PCF, AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, or container\-based platforms.
* Familiar with relational and non\-relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar technologies, including query execution, scripting, and production support.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across applications, infrastructure, integrations, end\-user workflows, and distributed systems, with the ability to diagnose complex production issues.
* Understanding of incident life cycle and strong background in incident and problem manage
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical issues, risks, workarounds, and resolution plans to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to participate in rotational on\-call support, respond to production incidents, and drive timely restoration of service while maintaining clear stakeholder communication.
* Experience working in a regulated enterprise environment, preferably financial services, with a focus on secure, compliant, and reliable technology operations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience supporting Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Financial Services platforms, with knowledge of the trade lifecycle, investment operations, and front\-to\-back office workflows.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive incident response, service restoration, root cause analysis, post\-incident reviews, and long\-term corrective actions.
* Practical experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, logs, metrics, and traces using tools such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ThousandEyes, or similar platforms.
* Ability to automate repetitive operational tasks, reduce toil, improve runbooks, and build scripts or tools using Python, PowerShell, Bash, Java, or similar technologies.
* Understanding of SRE practices such as SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, reliability reporting, capacity awareness, performance monitoring, and operational risk reduction.
* Experience supporting applications across cloud, container, or platform environments such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, PCF, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Working knowledge of databases, APIs, integrations, job scheduling, file transfers, CI/CD pipelines, and release/change management processes in a production environment.
* Collaborative, curious, and adaptable problem solver who partners effectively with engineering, product, business, and operations teams while respectfully challenging the status quo.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues, business impact, workarounds, timelines, and resolution plans to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI\-driven, data\-assisted, or analytics\-based operational practices that improve triage, anomaly detection, incident response, knowledge management, or continuous service improvement.
* Ability to participate in rotational on\-call support and work effectively under pressure while maintaining clear priorities, sound judgment, and customer\-focused communication.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.

* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

description:
**Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!**
  

  

  

 Passion, excitement \& global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage \- the combination of our next\-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease \- no matter where they are in the world.
   

  





 What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!
   

  





**Who we are:**




 Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high\-stakes, high\-value payments. We’ve scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.
   

  





 Today we support more than 5,300 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel \& B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries \& territories and more than 140 currencies.
   

  





 With over 1,400\+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world\-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Job Summary:**




 As a
 **Security Engineer II** 
 on the Active Operational Defender track you will build hands on experience across penetration testing, threat detection and incident response, working under the direction of senior and lead engineers. You will support live operational work within a high velocity fintech environment, developing the manual testing and detection engineering skills needed to take on more independent responsibility over time.
   

  





**Responsibilities and Tasks:**




**1\. Offensive Penetration Testing \& Red Teaming**



* Support penetration testing engagements across financial platforms and product architectures under senior guidance, building practical exploit research experience.
* Assist with manual security reviews including source code audits, API testing and cloud configuration checks, working towards independent delivery of smaller engagements.
* Contribute to adversarial testing of AI features where in scope, learning to identify prompt injection and related LLM specific weaknesses.



**2\. Threat Detection Engineering \& SIEM**



* Help design and tune detection rules and alert workflows within the enterprise SIEM, working from senior engineers' guidance and established detection frameworks.
* Support SecOps in reviewing detection coverage against current threats, referencing frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK.



**3\. Incident Response \& Forensics**



* Act as a first line responder during active security incidents, carrying out evidence collection and initial triage under senior direction.
* Support post incident analysis by pulling together logs, timelines and technical findings for senior review.



**4\. Cross Functional Collaboration \& Development**



* Take part in security operations and engineering planning to build a practical understanding of detection and response capability.
* Communicate findings from testing and incidents clearly to immediate team members and stakeholders.
* Actively seek mentorship from senior and lead security engineers on offensive tooling, detection engineering and incident response practice.


**Qualifications**
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Core Experience:** 
 indicative range
 **\[1 to 3 years]** 
 of hands on experience in penetration testing, security operations or a closely related technical role.
* **Foundational Offensive Skills:** 
 exposure to manual web application testing, CTF style exploitation or vulnerability research, gained through work experience, personal projects or study.
* **SecOps \& Forensics Familiarity:** 
 basic working knowledge of SIEM concepts, EDR tooling or network packet analysis, and an interest in frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK.
* **Technical Language Foundation:** 
 comfort reading and, ideally, writing scripts in a language such as Python to support testing and automation.
* **AI Security Awareness:** 
 a working interest in the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs and how adversarial testing of AI features differs from traditional application testing.
* **Regulatory Awareness** 
 : a general understanding of standards such as PCI\-DSS, SOC 2 or DORA, with willingness to build practical depth on the job.
   

  

  

  

**Highly Preferred Certifications**
* Hands\-On Offensive \& Red Team: OSCP, OSCE or SANS GXPN (GIAC Exploit Researcher and Advanced Penetration Tester).
* Incident Response \& Defence: GCIH (GIAC Certified Incident Handler), GCFA (GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst) or a specialised Blue Team certification.
   

  

  

  

**Skills and Abilities**
* Combines an aggressive, attacker's mindset used to find vulnerabilities with the analytical discipline required to write clear, actionable detection rules.
* Stays calm and analytically clear under intense pressure during active, live breach events or business critical system failures.
* Communicates exploit chains and log anomalies clearly, turning technical detail into a plain, high impact risk profile for non\-technical leadership.
* Resilience and analytical clarity in high\-pressure scenarios, supporting transparent communication and contributing to risk\-based decisions during active security incidents or compressed financial product launch windows.
* Balances technical risk reduction with business enablement, supporting security infrastructure that serves as a competitive advantage and helps unblock global revenue and enterprise\-client acquisition.
* Modern AI Security: OffSec OSAI (Offensive Security AI Red Teamer).


**Additional Information**

**What We Offer:**



* Competitive compensation
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Competitive time off, including Digital Disconnect and FlyBetter Days to volunteer in a cause you believe in.
* Flying Start \- Our immersive Global Induction Program (Meet our Execs \& Global Teams)
* Work with brilliant people globally Learn more about their journeys by checking out \#InsideFlywire on social media
* Wellbeing Programs (Mental Health, Wellness, Yoga/Pilates/HIIT Classes) with Global FlyMates
* Be a meaningful part in our success \- every FlyMate makes an impact
* Great Talent \& Development Programs (Managers Taking Flight – for new or aspiring managers, OneFlywire Career Mobility)



**Submit today and get started!**




 We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet with different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager, Peers on the team, the VP of the department, and a skills assessment. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go\-to” person for any questions.

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.  

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. The Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.

title: HR Assistant

Job Overview

Maskoid Technologies is looking for a **multi\-skilled IT Network \& Hardware Administrator** to manage and maintain the company's complete IT infrastructure.

The role involves **office IT support, hardware troubleshooting, system and network administration, server management, website hosting and deployment, DNS/SSL management, WordPress administration, backups, security, monitoring, and basic Python automation**.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling day\-to\-day employee IT issues as well as independently managing servers, networks, hosting environments, website deployments, and infrastructure\-related tasks.

Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Office IT Support \& Hardware

* Troubleshoot employee IT issues including system slowness, keyboard/mouse, monitor, audio, and peripheral issues.
* Install and configure operating systems, office applications, security tools, and required software.
* Maintain desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT peripherals.
* Ensure all office IT systems are operational, secure, and properly maintained.
* Maintain inventory and stock of IT accessories, spare hardware, and components.

2\. System \& Network Administration

* Install, configure, and maintain **Windows and Linux servers**.
* Manage **Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policies, and user accounts**.
* Configure and troubleshoot routers, switches, firewalls, Wi\-Fi access points, and NAS devices.
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi\-Fi, Internet, and connectivity\-related issues.
* Perform OS updates, security patches, driver installations, and firmware upgrades.
* Manage basic firewall and VPN configurations.

3\. Website Hosting, Deployment \& Server Management

* Deploy websites on **cPanel, Plesk, VPS, and cloud hosting environments**.
* Manage DNS records including **A, CNAME, MX, TXT, SPF, DKIM, and SRV**.
* Perform website and server migrations.
* Install, renew, and troubleshoot SSL certificates.
* Troubleshoot server and hosting issues such as:
* High CPU/RAM usage
* HTTP 500/503 errors
* Database errors
* Email delivery issues
* Maintain backups of hosting accounts, databases, and website files.
* Monitor website uptime and server performance.

4\. WordPress Website Management

* Install and configure WordPress on hosting environments.
* Manage WordPress themes, plugins, and updates.
* Troubleshoot basic WordPress issues including plugin conflicts, theme issues, and database connection errors.
* Perform WordPress website backup and restoration.
* Perform basic performance optimization including caching, image optimization, and plugin cleanup.
* Handle basic page edits, content updates, and layout changes when required.

5\. System Monitoring \& Performance

* Perform daily server and system health checks.
* Monitor server load, storage, memory, and network performance.
* Ensure high uptime and reliability of internal systems and services.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and take corrective action.
* Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting systems.

6\. Backup, Security \& Compliance

* Manage daily and weekly backups of systems, servers, databases, and critical data.
* Perform periodic restoration tests to verify backup integrity.
* Manage endpoint protection, antivirus, and IT security controls.
* Manage access controls and password management systems.
* Follow and maintain IT security and operational standards.

7\. Domain, SSL \& IT Documentation

* Manage domain purchases, renewals, transfers, and DNS updates.
* Manage SSL installation, renewal, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain IT documentation, including:
* SOPs
* Network diagrams
* DNS documentation
* Server and hosting documentation
* IT asset information
* Access and configuration records

8\. Vendor \& Service Provider Coordination

* Coordinate with hosting providers, cloud vendors, IT suppliers, and service providers.
* Manage AMC agreements, warranty claims, and technical support escalations.
* Coordinate software and service renewals.
* Track licenses, subscriptions, and related IT services.

9\. Automation \& Python Scripting

* Develop basic Python scripts to automate repetitive IT tasks.
* Automate tasks such as system checks, log monitoring, and backup validation.
* Create simple automation tools for deployment, reporting, and monitoring.
* Maintain and improve existing IT automation scripts.

title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONVideo Editor \& Graphic Designer

**Company:** DPFXPERT Private Limited  
**Department:** Marketing \& Growth  
**Role:** Video Editor \& Graphic Designer  
**Employment:** Full\-Time  
**Reports To:** Marketing / Management

ABOUT DPFXPERT

DPFXPERT is **The Pioneers of DPF Cleaning in India**, building a complete DPF solutions ecosystem covering professional DPF cleaning services, DPF cleaning machines, franchise operations, training, technology and technical support.

We are looking for a **fast, creative and execution\-focused Video Editor \& Graphic Designer** who can turn ideas, raw footage and briefs into high\-quality marketing content quickly.

For this role, **what you can create matters more than your degree or years of experience.**

ROLE PURPOSE

To create **high\-quality videos and graphic content at exceptional speed** for DPFXPERT's digital marketing, sales, branding and internal communication requirements.

The ideal candidate should be someone who can:

**Understand the idea → Visualize it → Create it → Edit it → Deliver it FAST.**

Speed is important, but **speed should not compromise brand quality.**

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Video Editing

Create and edit:

* Instagram/Facebook Reels
* YouTube Shorts and videos
* Promotional videos
* Customer testimonials
* Machine demonstration videos
* DPF cleaning process videos
* Franchise and machine marketing videos
* Educational and technical videos
* Event and corporate videos
* Recruitment and internal communication videos

The editor should be comfortable working with raw footage from mobile phones, cameras and other sources and converting it into professional content.

2\. Graphic Design

Create:

* Social media creatives
* Carousel posts
* Posters
* Thumbnails
* Infographics
* Advertisements
* Promotional banners
* WhatsApp marketing creatives
* Presentation graphics
* Recruitment creatives
* Event creatives
* Simple brochures and marketing materials

All designs must consistently follow DPFXPERT's brand guidelines.

3\. Fast Content Execution

This is a **high\-speed content production role**.

The candidate should be capable of receiving a brief and producing the first usable output with minimum turnaround time.

Simple social\-media creatives and edits should ideally be completed **within hours rather than days**.

The person should be comfortable handling urgent marketing requirements and quick revisions without compromising quality.

4\. Creative Contribution

We do not want someone who only waits for detailed instructions.

The candidate should:

* Suggest better visual approaches
* Convert rough ideas into engaging content
* Identify opportunities from available footage
* Suggest hooks, transitions and storytelling formats
* Follow current social\-media content trends
* Experiment with new editing styles and formats
* Use AI and modern creative tools wherever they improve speed or quality

5\. Brand Consistency

Every output should maintain DPFXPERT's professional and authoritative positioning.

The candidate must maintain consistency in logo usage, typography, colours, layouts and overall visual identity.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate is:

* Extremely fast in execution
* Creative and visually strong
* Good at both video editing and graphic design
* Comfortable with short\-form social\-media content
* Able to understand briefs quickly
* Capable of working independently
* Detail\-oriented without becoming unnecessarily slow
* Comfortable receiving feedback and making quick revisions
* Able to prioritize urgent content
* Curious about new editing, AI and content\-creation tools
* Focused on completed output rather than activity

SOFTWARE / SKILLS

Candidates may use tools such as:

**Video:** Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut or equivalent.

**Graphics:** Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Figma or equivalent.

Knowledge of **AI\-powered video, image, audio, subtitle and content\-generation tools** will be an added advantage.

We are not particular about which software is used.

**The final quality and speed of execution matter more than the tool.**

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

Performance will primarily be measured on:

**Speed \+ Quality \+ Creativity \+ Brand Consistency \+ Reliability**

Key expectations include:

* Turnaround time
* Number of usable creatives/videos delivered
* Quality of final output
* Accuracy of branding
* Ability to understand briefs correctly
* Number of revisions required
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Creative contribution and new ideas

QUALIFICATIONS

Formal educational qualifications are **not the primary selection criterion**.

Candidates from any educational background may apply if they can demonstrate strong creative ability.

Freshers with exceptional portfolios are welcome.

Experienced candidates must also demonstrate their capability through actual work.

SELECTION PROCESSSelection will be based primarily on actual work.Stage 1 – Portfolio / Sample Work Review

Candidates must submit samples of:

* Short\-form videos / Reels
* Promotional or corporate videos
* Graphic designs / social\-media creatives
* Any work demonstrating creativity and editing capability

Applications without relevant sample work may not be shortlisted.

Stage 2 – Practical Trial

Shortlisted candidates will be given DPFXPERT content/raw material and a brief.

They may be asked to create:

**1 short\-form video \+ 1 graphic creative**

within a defined time.

The trial will evaluate:

**1\. Speed of execution**  
**2\. Video editing quality**  
**3\. Graphic design quality**  
**4\. Creativity**  
**5\. Understanding of the brief**  
**6\. Brand consistency**  
**7\. Attention to detail**  
**8\. Ability to produce publish\-ready content**

Stage 3 – Final Discussion

The final discussion will focus on:

* Creative thinking
* Work attitude
* Ability to work under deadlines
* Response to feedback
* Ownership
* Alignment with DPFXPERT's work culture and LIFE values

IMPORTANT

**We are not looking for someone who takes two days to create something that can be professionally completed in two hours.**

At the same time, speed without quality is not acceptable.

We want someone who continuously asks:

**“How can I make this better — and deliver it faster?”**

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.

* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.

**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
