title: Hardware Engineer
description:
Job Description – Hardware Engineer

Position: Hardware Engineer

Location: Delhi NCR

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and responsible Hardware Engineer to handle installation, troubleshooting, repair, maintenance, and technical support for laptops, desktops, servers, printers, networking devices, and other IT hardware.

The candidate should have good knowledge of Delhi NCR routes and locations and be comfortable travelling to customer sites across Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram, and Faridabad.

Key Responsibilities

\- Installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of laptops, desktops, servers, printers, and other IT hardware.

\- Diagnose and resolve hardware\-related issues at customer locations.

\- Handle hardware replacement, upgrades, RAM/SSD installation, battery, adapter, charger, and other component\-related issues.

\- Perform preventive maintenance and system health checks.

\- Provide on\-site technical support to customers.

\- Maintain proper records of hardware received, repaired, replaced, and delivered.

\- Coordinate with the internal IT/support team for unresolved technical issues.

\- Ensure timely closure of customer complaints and service requests.

\- Follow company SOPs and maintain proper service documentation.

\- Handle IT equipment safely during pickup, delivery, installation, and servicing.

Delhi NCR \& Field Knowledge

The candidate should:

\- Have good knowledge of Delhi NCR areas, routes, and localities.

\- Be comfortable travelling independently for customer visits.

\- Have knowledge of major areas in Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram, and Faridabad.

\- Be familiar with Delhi Metro routes and major metro stations.

\- Be able to identify the most convenient route using Metro, bus, or other local transport.

\- Reach customer locations on time and manage multiple field visits efficiently.

\- Be willing to travel extensively across Delhi NCR as required.

Required Skills

\- Good knowledge of computer hardware and troubleshooting.

\- Knowledge of Windows installation and configuration.

\- Knowledge of RAM, SSD/HDD, motherboard, SMPS, battery, adapter, charger, etc.

\- Basic knowledge of networking and peripherals.

\- Good communication and customer\-handling skills.

\- Problem\-solving and diagnostic abilities.

\- Good knowledge of Delhi NCR locations and transportation.

\- Ability to work independently in field conditions.

Qualification \& Experience

description:

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Marketing

About the Role

We are looking for a **performance\-driven Digital Marketing Executive** to join our team in **Hoshiarpur**. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in **Meta Ads (Facebook \& Instagram Ads)** and be capable of planning, launching, monitoring, and optimizing paid advertising campaigns to generate quality leads, sales, and business growth.

This role is ideal for someone who understands that digital marketing is not just about posting content \- it is about **generating measurable results through smart targeting, creative testing, campaign optimization, and data analysis.**

Key Responsibilities Meta Ads Management

* Plan, create, launch, and manage **Facebook \& Instagram advertising campaigns** through Meta Ads Manager.
* Manage campaigns for **lead generation, conversions, sales, traffic, engagement, and remarketing**.
* Conduct audience research and create relevant targeting strategies.
* Set up and manage **Custom Audiences, Lookalike Audiences, retargeting campaigns, and interest\-based targeting**.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize campaigns based on key metrics.
* Regularly test different **ad creatives, copy, audiences, placements, and campaign objectives**.
* Identify underperforming campaigns/ad sets/ads and take corrective action.
* Manage advertising budgets efficiently and work toward improving **ROAS, CPL, CTR, conversion rate, and overall campaign profitability**.
* Scale successful campaigns while maintaining performance and cost efficiency.
* Stay updated with changes to the Meta advertising platform, policies, targeting options, and best practices.

Campaign \& Performance Analysis

* Track and analyze campaign performance on a daily basis.
* Prepare performance reports and communicate key insights to management.
* Identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Use data to make informed decisions about budget allocation and campaign strategy.
* Monitor lead quality and work with the sales team to improve lead\-to\-customer conversion.

Creative \& Content Coordination

* Provide creative briefs and recommendations based on campaign performance.
* Suggest new hooks, ad angles, offers, headlines, captions, and creative concepts.
* Understand what type of content works best for different audiences and stages of the customer journey.

Digital Marketing

* Assist in developing and executing the overall digital marketing strategy.
* Monitor industry trends and identify new opportunities for customer acquisition.
* Support website, landing page, and conversion\-rate optimization initiatives where required.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure marketing campaigns are aligned with business objectives.

Required Skills

* Strong hands\-on knowledge of **Meta Ads Manager**.
* Good understanding of Facebook and Instagram advertising.
* Experience in **lead generation and/or performance marketing**.
* Understanding of campaign structures, audiences, placements, budgets, bidding, and optimization.
* Ability to analyze metrics such as **CPL, CTR, CPM, ROAS, conversion rate, and frequency**.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of digital marketing funnels and customer journeys.
* Ability to conduct audience and competitor research.
* Basic knowledge of ad copywriting and creative strategy.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of campaigns.
* Strong attention to detail and a results\-oriented mindset.

Preferred Skills

Candidates with knowledge or experience in the following will be preferred:

* Meta Pixel / Meta Events Manager
* Conversion API
* Landing page optimization
* CRM and lead management
* Canva or basic creative tools
* Lead\-generation funnels
* Retargeting and remarketing strategies

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

* Has **practical experience managing Meta Ads campaigns**, not just theoretical knowledge.
* Understands how to optimize campaigns based on performance data.
* Is comfortable working with budgets and performance targets.
* Takes initiative and continuously looks for ways to improve campaign results.
* Can identify why a campaign is not performing and suggest actionable solutions.
* Is willing to experiment with new audiences, creatives, offers, and strategies.
* Can work in a fast\-paced environment and meet deadlines.
* Is focused on **business outcomes rather than vanity metrics**.

Experience

**1–3 years of relevant experience** in digital marketing/performance marketing is preferred.

Freshers with strong practical knowledge of Meta Ads and demonstrable campaign experience may also be considered.

Education

Bachelor's degree/diploma in **Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or a related field** is preferred but not mandatory for candidates with relevant practical experience.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience and skills.
* Performance\-based growth opportunities.
* Hands\-on exposure to performance marketing and customer acquisition.
* Learning and career growth opportunities.
* Supportive and professional work environment.
* Opportunity to take ownership of digital marketing campaigns and contribute directly to business growth.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply with their **updated resume**.

Candidates with previous Meta Ads experience are encouraged to mention:

* Types of campaigns managed
* Approximate monthly ad budgets handled
* Average CPL/CPA/ROAS achieved, where applicable
* Industries/niches worked with
* Examples of campaigns or results they have generated

**Location:** Hoshiarpur, Punjab

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

We are looking for an Onboarding \& Customer Success Executive who will act as the primary point of contact between our organization and schools / educational institutions during the onboarding and implementation process.

The role will be responsible for ensuring that every new institution is onboarded smoothly from account and user ID creation, curriculum and platform setup, data coordination and training to resolving initial queries and ensuring customer satisfaction.

The ideal candidate should be organized, technically comfortable, good at communication and highly customer\-focused. This role is suitable for both fresh graduates with a technical background and candidates with 1–2 years of experience in EdTech, customer success, implementation, project coordination or a similar role.

Key Responsibilities

* Act as the primary Point of Contact (POC) for schools and educational institutions during onboarding and implementation.
* Coordinate the complete onboarding process from initial handover by the Sales team to successful activation and implementation.
* Collect and validate required information from schools, including student, teacher, class, section and other relevant data.
* Coordinate the creation and activation of student, teacher, administrator and institutional IDs/accounts.
* Coordinate with internal Product, Technology, Curriculum and Operations teams to ensure the institution is configured correctly.
* Support the setup and deployment of curriculum, courses, learning content, modules and other educational resources.
* Coordinate platform configuration and ensure that the school's requirements are correctly implemented.
* Conduct or coordinate onboarding sessions, product walkthroughs and basic training for teachers, coordinators and school administrators.
* Handle day\-to\-day customer queries during the onboarding and initial implementation phase.
* Understand customer issues, coordinate internally for resolution and ensure timely closure.
* Maintain regular communication with institutional stakeholders and keep them updated on onboarding progress.
* Track onboarding activities, pending requirements, dependencies and completion timelines.
* Maintain accurate onboarding records, checklists, reports and documentation.
* Monitor the initial customer experience and proactively identify issues that may affect adoption or satisfaction.
* Collect customer feedback and communicate recurring requirements or concerns to the relevant internal teams.
* Coordinate with the Sales team during the transition from sales closure to implementation and customer success.
* Ensure that customers receive a smooth and professional experience throughout the onboarding journey.
* Support customer retention and adoption by maintaining strong relationships with institutional stakeholders.

Technical Responsibilities

The candidate does not need to be an advanced programmer, but should be comfortable working with technology and learning new systems.

The role may involve:

* Basic understanding of coding/programming concepts.
* Working with web\-based platforms and educational technology products.
* Basic understanding of databases, spreadsheets and data management.
* Handling user/account creation and platform configuration.
* Basic troubleshooting and issue identification.
* Working with Excel / Google Sheets and other productivity tools.

Required Skills

* Strong coordination and follow\-up abilities.

* Ability to manage multiple schools/institutions and onboarding activities simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail, especially when handling student/teacher data and account setup.
* Comfortable working with technology and learning new software/platforms quickly.
* Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting ability.
* Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets / PowerPoint.
* Ability to communicate professionally with teachers, coordinators, principals and other institutional stakeholders.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About Zeno** 




 An unprecedented energy transition has begun. To meet 2040 net zero goals, over 2 billion electric two\-wheelers (motorcycles) must be sold and $11 trillion in fuel consumption replaced. Zeno is building a tech platform to electrify this two\-wheeler market, currently responsible for more than 4% of the world’s GHG emissions. Our mission is to accelerate the energy transition and democratize the benefits across Africa, India, and Latin America. With a focus on East Africa as a starting point, Zeno is building a new energy ecosystem with ground\-up development of a fundamentally better electric motorcycle and associated battery swap network to drive a better experience for our customers.
 



 We are looking for audacious, creative, and committed people to join us on this important mission. You will be joining a bold team consisting of leading engineers, operators, and entrepreneurs hailing from companies that include Tesla, Apple, Google, SRAM, Ola Electric, Dott, LiveWire, Lucid, Bolt, Microsoft, SafeBoda, Sun Mobility, among many others. Zeno has just closed its seed round with Lowercarbon, Silicon Valley’s leading climate tech venture fund, Toyota Ventures, the VC of the world’s largest automotive company, and 4DX Ventures, a leading early\-stage investor in Africa.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Zeno is seeking a highly skilled and hands\-on
 **Data Engineer** 
 to design, build, and scale our global data ecosystem. Sitting within our core
 **Global Insights Node** 
 , this role is not a traditional corporate dashboard\-building job. You will bridge the gap between heavy hardware telematics and high\-fidelity operational intelligence.
 



 You will design and build a resilient, local\-first data architecture capable of handling high\-frequency telemetry from moving vehicles and distributed battery swap stations operating in environments with variable network connectivity.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong systems engineering fundamentals with an analytical mindset, a passion for first\-principles problem solving, and a refusal to rely on bloated enterprise templates when a leaner, more elegant solution exists.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




**1\. Data Architecture \& Edge Ecosystem Design** 



* Design, build, and maintain a highly resilient, scalable data architecture capable of syncing, storing, and processing massive datasets from both centralized cloud services and distributed edge devices (battery swap stations and vehicles).
* Establish robust strategies for partition tolerance and local\-first data caching to handle intermittent cellular connectivity in emerging markets.



**2\. High\-Performance Pipeline Development** 



* Develop, test, and optimize batch and stream\-processing pipelines to handle real\-time IoT telematics, state\-of\-charge tracking, and transactional business data.
* Build efficient ingestion mechanisms from internal systems, IoT hardware modules, APIs, and third\-party operational platforms using languages like Go, Rust, or Python.



**3\. First\-Principles Infrastructure Optimization** 



* Constantly challenge the data\-stack status quo. Focus on building lightweight, cost\-effective, and highly performant data systems, selecting tools based on architectural suitability rather than industry hype.
* Optimize data storage layouts, partitioning schemes, and query mechanics to handle high data volumes with minimal latency and infrastructure cost.



**4\. Unified Semantics \& Intelligence Enablement** 



* Architect clean, well\-documented semantic layers and structured transformations (using SQL and modern modeling frameworks) to expose reliable datasets.
* Support both traditional analytical queries (BI dashboards in Grafana, Looker, or Kibana) and downstream machine learning and automated agentic pipelines.



**5\. Data Quality, Reliability \& Observability** 



* Implement strict data validation, monitoring, and proactive alerting frameworks to ensure absolute consistency and accuracy across the network.
* Define and maintain strict access control, governance, and data privacy standard practices across the global insights platform.



**6\. Engineering Hygiene \& DevOps** 



* Packaged and deploy data services using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Maintain elegant CI/CD automation pipelines for data code deployments and infrastructure\-as\-code updates.
* Ensure impeccable Git/version control hygiene (clean commit histories, thorough documentation, and rigorous peer code reviews).



  





**What You Bring** 



* **The Mindset:** 
 A true first\-principles thinker. You are energized by physical constraints (like network drops or limited hardware memory) and prefer elegant, custom\-tailored solutions over bloated, off\-the\-shelf enterprise software.
* **Core Technical Expertise:** 
 Strong programming fundamentals in systems\-adjacent or highly performant languages (
 **Go, Rust, or Python** 
 ) alongside advanced mastery of
 **SQL** 
 .
* **IoT \& Telematics Experience:** 
 Proven experience dealing with high\-volume, time\-series, or streaming telematics/IoT data.
* **Distributed Systems Knowledge:** 
 Hands\-on experience with modern streaming and orchestration tools (such as Kafka, Redpanda, Airflow, Spark, or Beam) and an understanding of how to run them efficiently.
* **Modern Warehouse Proficiency:** 
 Practical experience leveraging cloud\-native data warehouses or lakehouses (such as BigQuery, Snowflake, ClickHouse, or Redshift) for high\-performance analytics.
* **Cloud \& DevOps Foundations:** 
 Solid working knowledge of cloud ecosystems (AWS and/or GCP) and experience deploying robust services via Docker and Kubernetes.
* **Data Advocacy:** 
 Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex data schemas, structural bottlenecks, and analytical tradeoffs to both hardware engineers and business operations teams.



  





**Benefits** 



* **Competitive Salary:** 
 Highly competitive base salary based on your experience and technical capabilities.
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** 
 Company\-sponsored healthcare plan for you and your dependents.
* **Incredible Mission \& Culture:** 
 Join a world\-class, globally distributed team of engineers, operators, and builders who are driving the inevitable, multi\-trillion\-dollar transition of two\-wheelers to electric.

**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Industry:** FMCG / Food \& Dry Fruits  
**Experience:** 1–5 years preferred  
**Location:** Rudrapur, Uttarakhand

**Salary:** ₹16,000 – ₹25,000 per month \+ Performance Incentives  
**Transportation:** Company\-provided vehicle for official market visits

About the Company

We are a growing FMCG brand dealing in **raw and premium\-quality dry fruits**, with a focus on building a strong distribution network across different markets.

We are looking for a motivated and result\-oriented **B2B Sales \& Marketing Manager** who can help us expand our business by developing relationships with **wholesalers, distributors, and super stockists**.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and approach **large wholesalers, distributors, and super stockists** in different markets.
* Introduce and promote our dry fruit product range to potential B2B customers.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with wholesalers and super stockists.
* Generate enquiries and **convert potential customers into regular buyers**.
* Negotiate pricing, order quantities, payment terms, and other commercial requirements within company guidelines.
* Take orders and coordinate with the internal team to ensure **smooth and timely order fulfilment**.
* Coordinate with the packing, dispatch, and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery.
* Follow up with customers for **timely payments and outstanding collections**.
* Maintain regular communication with existing customers to generate repeat orders and increase business.
* Monitor market prices, competitors, customer requirements, and new business opportunities.
* Maintain proper records of leads, customer meetings, orders, payments, and follow\-ups.
* Travel to different markets and meet potential customers whenever required.
* Contribute to expanding the company's wholesaler and super stockist network.

What We Are Looking For

* 1–5 years of experience in **FMCG sales, food products, dry fruits, grocery, or general trade** is preferred.
* Candidates with relevant B2B sales experience will be given preference.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to approach new customers and independently generate business.
* Good understanding of wholesale and distribution markets.
* Strong follow\-up skills and a target\-oriented approach.
* Comfortable discussing **pricing, payment terms, order quantities, and commercial negotiations**.
* Willingness to travel for market visits and customer meetings.
* Basic knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and maintaining customer records.
* Candidates with an existing network of **FMCG wholesalers, dry fruit traders, distributors, or super stockists** will be preferred.

Compensation \& Benefits

* **Fixed Salary: ₹16,000 – ₹25,000 per month**, based on experience and suitability.
* **Performance\-based incentives in addition to salary.**
* **Company\-provided transportation vehicle** for official market visits and customer meetings.
* Opportunity to grow with a developing FMCG brand and take responsibility for expanding its distribution network.

Performance Expectations

The candidate's performance will primarily be evaluated on:

* New wholesalers/distributors/super stockists acquired
* Orders and sales generated
* Repeat business from existing customers
* Expansion of the customer network
* Timely payment realization
* Effective coordination of deliveries and customer requirements

Who Should Apply?

This position is ideal for someone who is **comfortable with field sales, enjoys meeting new business owners, can negotiate confidently, and is motivated by achieving sales targets.**

Candidates who can **build relationships, generate orders, and develop long\-term B2B customers** will be highly valued.

description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a passionate and analytical Assistant Product Manager to support the Product Management team in planning, developing, launching, and improving Xiaomi products. The role requires strong market understanding, data analysis, cross\-functional coordination, and the ability to translate consumer insights into actionable product requirements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Product Planning \& Market Research
 


* Support market research and competitive analysis across smartphones and other consumer electronics categories.
* Track competitor products, specifications, pricing, launches, and market trends.
* Collect and analyze consumer feedback, reviews, and pain points.



 Support the Product Manager in defining product positioning and key selling points.
 



  





 2\. Product Development Support
 


* Assist in preparing product requirements and feature proposals.
* Coordinate with R\&D, software, hardware, camera, testing, and other internal teams.
* Follow up on product development progress and key issues.
* Support product testing and identify opportunities for localization and optimization for the Indian market.



  





 3\. Product Testing \& User Experience
 


* Participate in product testing and evaluation.
* Compare product performance with key competitors.
* Analyze areas such as:
* Performance and gaming
* Battery life and charging
* Camera quality
* Display
* Software and user experience
* Network and connectivity
* Durability and reliability
* Collect and summarize user feedback and testing results.



  





 4\. Competitive Analysis
 


* Maintain regular competitor tracking and comparison reports.
* Analyze key areas including:
* Chipset and performance
* Camera
* Battery and charging
* Display
* Storage and memory
* Software
* Price and value proposition
* Identify Xiaomi's competitive advantages and potential product gaps.



  





**5\. Launch \& Go\-to\-Market Support** 



* Support product launch preparation and product positioning.
* Prepare product comparison materials and key selling points.
* Work with Marketing, Sales, Retail, Training, and PR teams.
* Support preparation of:
* Product FAQs
* Competitive battle cards
* Training materials
* Product presentations
* Product messaging and proof points



  





 6\. Consumer \& Market Insights
 


* Monitor product reviews, social media discussions, and customer feedback.
* Identify recurring consumer complaints and opportunities.
* Analyze market trends and provide actionable insights to the Product team.
* Support post\-launch product performance reviews.



  





 7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 


* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely completion of product\-related activities.
* Track action items, testing progress, and open issues.
* Prepare clear reports and presentations for management.



  





**Requirement:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Marketing, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in Product Management, Consumer Electronics or Technology preferred.
* Strong interest and understanding of smartphones and consumer technology.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Basic understanding of smartphone technologies such as chipsets, camera, display, battery, charging, and software.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional and international teams.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Sales Representative
description:
**About Nexus Infra \& Energy**

Nexus Infra \& Energy is a renewable energy solutions company focused on delivering solar power, energy solutions, and EV charging infrastructure to residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional customers.

We are looking for a driven and result\-oriented Sales Executive to join our growing sales team and help businesses and individuals transition towards reliable and sustainable energy solutions.

**Role Overview**

As a Sales Executive, you will be responsible for identifying potential customers, generating leads, understanding their energy requirements, presenting suitable solar solutions, and converting prospects into customers.

The role involves a combination of field sales, client meetings, lead generation, relationship management, and sales closure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Generate new leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, digital platforms, and field visits.
* Identify and approach potential customers across residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, and other segments.
* Understand customers' electricity consumption, requirements, budgets, and site conditions.
* Conduct preliminary discussions and coordinate site surveys and energy assessments.
* Present customized solar and energy solutions based on the customer's requirements.
* Prepare and share quotations, proposals, and commercial offers with prospective clients.
* Follow up consistently with leads throughout the sales cycle.
* Coordinate with the technical and execution teams to ensure accurate communication of project requirements.
* Negotiate with clients and assist in closing deals while achieving assigned sales targets.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Keep track of leads, meetings, proposals, follow\-ups, and conversions through the company's CRM/reporting system.
* Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, pricing, and developments in the renewable\-energy sector.
* Participate in exhibitions, networking events, corporate meetings, and other business\-development activities.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales and revenue targets.

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good negotiation and persuasion abilities.
* Ability to confidently interact with decision\-makers, business owners, facility managers, procurement teams, and other stakeholders.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-management skills.
* Target\-oriented and self\-motivated approach.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and site visits.
* Basic understanding of solar power, electricity consumption, and renewable energy is an advantage.
* Ability to understand and explain technical concepts in a simple manner.
* Good proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace.
* Experience with CRM tools is an added advantage.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Engineering, or a related field.
* Candidates from other educational backgrounds with strong sales and communication skills may also be considered.

**Experience**

* 1–3 years of experience in sales/business development.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a genuine interest in sales are welcome to apply.
* Experience in solar, renewable energy, electrical equipment, EPC, infrastructure, or B2B sales will be an advantage.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives.
* Opportunity to work in the rapidly growing renewable\-energy sector.
* Hands\-on exposure to solar EPC, energy solutions, and EV charging infrastructure.
* Learning opportunities across sales, technical solutions, project execution, and business development.
* Growth opportunities based on performance and contribution.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for someone who is hungry to sell, comfortable speaking to new people, willing to be on the field, and motivated by targets. The ideal candidate should be able to turn conversations into opportunities and opportunities into long\-term customer relationships.

If you are passionate about sales and want to build a career in the renewable\-energy industry, we'd love to hear from you.

Kavora Tech Groups is a next\-generation technology upskilling and career transformation platform designed for students, graduates, and working professionals aiming to thrive in the ever\-evolving tech industry.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between academic learning and industry requirements by providing hands\-on training, mentorship, and real\-world problem\-solving opportunities.

Our structured ecosystem ensures that learners not only gain valuable technical knowledge but also develop the confidence and skill set needed to create a meaningful impact in the tech world.

Our learners are guided and mentored by industry veterans and tech leaders from globally recognized organizations such as Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, Netflix, and Infosys, among others.

Each program is carefully curated and vetted by experts, ensuring that the curriculum remains aligned with industry needs and prepares professionals for both cutting\-edge innovation and high\-growth career paths.

* Access to the Kavora Tech Groups Community, a dynamic network of learners, mentors, and alumni collaborating on knowledge\-sharing, opportunities, and referrals.

* **Deep Mentorship:** Personalized guidance tailored to each learner’s pace and career goals.
* **Industry Readiness:** We go beyond academics to ensure our learners are job\-ready for the toughest interviews and challenging tech scenarios.
* **Community for Life:** Our alumni and mentor community is committed to giving back, helping learners accelerate career growth with strong peer and leadership support.

Kavora Tech Groups is steadily becoming one of the most trusted names in tech education and career development — a platform where ambition meets opportunity.

* Ability to build rapport, influence decision\-making, and manage client relationships effectively.

**Job Summary**

The Junior Production Engineer supports day\-to\-day production activities for interior projects by coordinating between design, factory, and site teams. The role focuses on execution as per drawings, production planning support, quality compliance, and timely delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Production Support**

* Assist in executing daily production activities as per approved drawings.
* Support production planning and follow up on daily targets.
* Monitor work progress on the shop floor and update seniors.
* Help identify production issues and assist in resolving them.

**Drawing \& Design Coordination**

* Understand shop drawings, GFC drawings, and production drawings.
* Coordinate with the design team for clarifications and revisions.
* Ensure work is carried out as per latest approved drawings.

**Quality \& Process Control**

* Conduct basic in\-process quality checks.
* Coordinate with QC team for inspections and rectifications.
* Ensure finishing, dimensions, and materials meet quality standards.

**Material \& Inventory Coordination**

* Coordinate with Stores for material issue and tracking.
* Monitor material usage and report shortages or wastage.
* Assist in maintaining material consumption records.

description:

The ideal candidate is a visual craftsperson who can turn complex enterprise problems into clean, intuitive, pixel\-perfect interfaces, while owning and scaling design systems that keep products consistent across teams.
   

  

 You will work closely with product managers, developers, and business stakeholders to design intuitive, scalable, and accessible digital experiences for web and enterprise applications. We are also looking for someone who actively uses AI tools to work faster and smarter, and who can think critically about how AI is reshaping the way products are designed and experienced.

**UI Design \& Visual Execution**
* Design pixel\-perfect, high\-fidelity UI for web, mobile, and enterprise applications
* Apply strong visual hierarchy, typography, colour theory, grid, spacing, and layout principles
* Craft polished states, micro\-interactions, and responsive behaviour across breakpoints
* Own the visual quality of the product and raise the overall craft bar across screens

title: Product Designer (UX)
description:
**Don't Apply If...** 



* You love making beautiful screens but aren't particularly interested in whether the experience actually works.
* You'd rather jump straight into Figma than understand the problem you're trying to solve.
* You prefer working in isolation rather than alongside Product and Engineering.
* Your work ends at developer handoff. You want to see your designs shipped, tested and improved.
* Details like spacing, hierarchy, states and consistency don't bother you when they're slightly off.



  





**Do Apply If...** 



* You have a genuinely strong eye for design and notice the details other people miss.
* You care equally about how a product works and how it feels to use.
* You start with the user and the problem, then use design to find the simplest, strongest solution.
* You can take a complex workflow and make it feel obvious.
* You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering, and you're comfortable challenging ideas as well as having your own challenged.
* You care about what actually gets built, not just what looks great in Figma.
* You work with structure and priorities, but bring curiosity, energy and ideas to the table.
* You want to help shape a growing product and
 **raise the design bar as we build** 
 .



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a thoughtful, structured and execution\-focused
 **Product Designer (UX)** 
 to join Doerscircle’s Product \& Technology team.
 



 Doerscircle is building a platform for independent professionals and the organisations that hire, engage and manage them. As our platform grows, we’re looking for someone who can turn complex product and business problems into experiences that feel simple, intuitive and beautifully designed.
 



 This is a hands\-on role. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA and Data, taking problems from early exploration and user flows through to polished UI, developer handoff and what ultimately gets shipped.
 



 You’ll need strong UX and product thinking, an excellent eye for design and visual detail, and a good understanding of business outcomes. You should be equally comfortable thinking through how something works and obsessing over how well it is executed.
 



  





**The Position** 




 You’ll be part of our fast\-growing commercial team, and working closely with the entire team of Doerscircle. This role involves working closely with our product development and marketing teams to design and improve our digital products and promotional materials. Ideally, you have experience with marketplace design, optimizing for revenue generation and conversions, and significantly improving the user experience journey.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities** 



* 2–4 years of hands\-on experience designing digital products.
* A portfolio showing
 **real product UX/UI work** 
 , not predominantly websites, branding or marketing design.
* Strong Figma skills, including Auto Layout, components, variants and prototyping.
* Strong visual design fundamentals such as hierarchy, typography, spacing, consistency and interaction.
* Ability to turn product requirements and user problems into flows, wireframes and polished interfaces.
* Understanding of responsive design, states, edge cases and common interaction patterns.
* Experience working directly with Product Managers and Engineers.
* Comfortable explaining design decisions, receiving feedback and iterating quickly.
* Experience working with an existing design system or component library.
* Able to work independently and reliably in a remote team.
* Translate product and business problems into clear user journeys, information architecture, flows, wireframes and high\-fidelity designs.
* Explore solutions through wireframes, prototypes and interaction designs before moving into detailed UI.



  





**How Design Works at Doerscircle** 




 Product Design and Brand Design work closely together, with distinct areas of ownership.
 



 As Product Designer, you own the experience of using our digital products, including user journeys, information architecture, interaction design, usability and product UI.
 



 Within our design system, Brand Design defines the visual foundations and overall creative language. Product Design translates those foundations into functional product components, patterns, behaviours and states.
 



 You’ll bring a strong visual sensibility and excellent design judgement, applying Doerscircle’s visual identity to create product experiences that feel polished, coherent and thoughtfully designed, while evolving the product experience in close collaboration with Brand Design.
 



 In simple terms: Brand Design defines how Doerscircle looks. Product Design makes sure the experience works beautifully.
 



  





**What We're Looking For?** 



* Proven experience as a Product Designer, UI/UX Designer or similar role designing digital products.
* A strong portfolio of shipped product work. We want to understand the problem, constraints, decisions, iterations and outcomes and not just see polished screens.
* A strong visual design sensibility and an excellent eye for design, with a sharp understanding of layout, hierarchy, typography, spacing, consistency and interaction.
* Strong UX fundamentals and the ability to simplify complex workflows and information.
* Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, Auto Layout and prototyping.
* Experience creating, maintaining or working extensively with design systems.
* Strong understanding of information architecture, interaction design and usability.
* Experience designing responsive web products.
* Ability to think through interaction states, edge cases, permissions and different user scenarios.
* Experience collaborating closely with Product Managers and Engineers from early exploration through implementation.
* Ability to explain the reasoning behind design decisions and challenge ideas constructively, while being equally comfortable receiving feedback and iterating on your own work.
* A good understanding of business and commercial outcomes, and the ability to balance user needs with business goals and technical constraints.
* Comfortable working iteratively and adapting as requirements and understanding evolve.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Good time management and the ability to deliver reliably against agreed priorities.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with marketplaces, talent platforms, workforce products or other multi\-sided platforms.
* Experience designing products serving both B2B and B2C users.
* Experience using product analytics or behavioural data to inform design decisions.
* Familiarity with Webflow or similar website\-building tools.
* Experience creating marketing or brand collateral alongside core product design work.



  





**Location** 




 Based anywhere in India. Fully remote, work\-from\-home.
 



 You’ll be working as part of a distributed Product \& Technology team, so you'll need to be comfortable collaborating remotely with colleagues across locations.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* Be part of an amazing team! We’re a young, vibrant, and fast\-moving team. We genuinely value our team members. We all play an important part and together we develop and grow stronger.
* Growth opportunities! We’re growing our team and expanding our reach, which means more opportunities for you.
* You can make an impact! We’re reshaping the world for Independent Doers. By being apart of the early journey, you can be a significant force for change.
* Personal development! You’ll get the chance to take ownership and be part of setting direction.
* Have fun! At the same time as we’re super ambitious, challenge ourselves and work hard to realize our vision, we make sure to have fun. We enjoy the ride, we don’t take ourselves too seriously, and we guarantee you that we’ll add to your good mood. We simply believe that fun and happiness bring along greater achievements.



  





**If You're Keen** 




 We care about the people behind the portfolio. So before you apply, tell us
 **why Doerscircle, why this role, and what you think makes you the right designer for our team** 
 .
 



 Keep it short and make it yours. A few thoughtful paragraphs, a short video, a visual, or something else entirely. We’re designers, so we appreciate a little personality.
 



 Please include your
 **portfolio and short motivation note** 
 with your application.
 **Applications that don't include both will not be considered.** 




  





 You can apply through the form below.

title: Research Analyst- Technology Futures (Solar)
company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
description:
**Purpose** 




 CEEW's Technology Futures team works towards mainstreaming appropriate global and indigenous technologies that can deliver energy security and sustainable economic growth at scale. The team's work spans clean energy technology manufacturing, critical minerals, and the evolving geopolitics and governance of clean energy technology collaboration, and has previously informed India's G20 presidency\-led work on global renewable energy supply chains.
 



 CEEW seeks to hire a suitable candidate to support the Technology Futures team's work on clean energy manufacturing, with a particular focus on solar photovoltaic (PV) technology. The candidate in this role will examine manufacturing processes, machinery and materials across the solar value chain (polysilicon, ingot/wafer, cell and module), assess supply chain dependencies and bottlenecks — including critical minerals and manufacturing equipment — and track the evolving policies and regulations shaping domestic and global solar manufacturing.
 



 The researcher will undertake technology and techno\-economic assessments of manufacturing processes, track domestic and international policy developments relevant to solar manufacturing (such as production\-linked incentives, local content requirements, customs duties and other measures), analyse supply chain data, and support the team in engaging with government, industry and international stakeholders.
 



 The candidate must have a strong technical understanding of clean energy manufacturing, particularly solar PV technologies and processes, along with a keen interest in how policy and regulation shape technology and manufacturing outcomes, and have demonstrable research experience. In addition to the duties and responsibilities outlined below, the candidate should be prepared, as and when necessary, to take on additional responsibilities and respond to ongoing events and developments in the sector.
 



 CEEW offers an intellectually challenging and conducive work environment, with a focus on research rigour, innovative thinking, and strategic outreach. We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail\-oriented individual who would be excited to take research to action. We recommend that applicants visit the Technology Futures page for more details about our projects.
 



**Job duties and accountabilities** 




**Research and programme assistance** 



* Review literature and track developments in clean energy manufacturing, with an emphasis on manufacturing processes, machinery and materials used across the entire solar PV value chain.
* Map and analyse domestic and global supply chains for solar PV and other clean energy technologies, including dependencies on critical minerals, intermediate goods, and manufacturing equipment.
* Analyse the policy and regulatory landscape governing solar manufacturing in India and other geographies.
* Track the geopolitics of solar technology — including export controls, technology partnerships, and shifts in global manufacturing competitiveness.
* Collect and analyse quantitative data — production capacities and costs to support techno\-economic and policy analysis.
* Prepare appropriate memos and presentations to brief the team and stakeholders.
* Assist the team in drafting and publishing high\-value research briefs and reports.



**Stakeholder engagement** 



* Engage with industry players, and government agencies to collect data, understand manufacturing and policy challenges, and validate research findings.
* Participate in in\-person and virtual convenings to network with relevant stakeholders and understand on\-ground challenges in clean energy manufacturing.



**Selection Criteria** 




**Qualification** 



* A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering — mechanical, materials science, chemical, or renewable energy — or a related technical discipline, ideally with exposure to photovoltaic or semiconductor manufacturing.
* Familiarity with the solar PV manufacturing value chain (polysilicon, ingot/wafer, cell, module) and the associated machinery, processes and materials is highly desirable.
* Research experience of at least 1 year is preferred.

title: Technical Content Writer
description:
**About Dreamfoot** 





 Dreamfoot is a premier corporate video production and 3D industrial animation studio based in Vadodara, Gujarat. We specialize in producing high\-impact corporate brand films, 3D technical animations, industrial process explainers, and comprehensive safety training films for leading engineering, manufacturing, and infrastructure enterprises.
 




**Role Overview** 





 We're looking for a Technical Content Writer who can research, understand, and explain complex industrial and engineering subject matter through clear, credible, long\-form writing. This is primarily a content writing role — you'll spend most of your time producing technically grounded blogs, case studies, whitepapers, and website content that build trust and establish authority with plant heads, safety VPs, and engineering leaders. A smaller part of the role involves writing narrative AV scripts for our corporate brand films, process videos, and safety training videos.
 




***This is not a copywriting role. We are not looking for persuasive, sales\-driven, conversion\-focused writing (ad copy, landing pages, CTA\-heavy campaigns). We want someone who educates and informs, not someone who sells.***




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Technical \& B2B Content Writing — Primary Mandate (80%)** 




 •     
 **Technical Content Development:** 

 Research and write in\-depth, technically accurate long\-form content — blog posts, engineering explainers, whitepapers, and detailed guides — that build trust and establish Dreamfoot's (and our clients') technical authority.
 




 •     
 **Case Studies \& Project Stories:** 

 Turn completed video and animation projects into detailed, technically grounded case studies and client success stories for the website and LinkedIn.
 




 •     
 **Client \& SME Discovery:** 

 Participate in discovery sessions with engineers, safety leads, and project directors to translate machinery, workflows, and SOPs into clear written narratives.
 




 •     
 **Website \& SEO Content:** 

 Author SEO\-aligned website copy, service pages, and long\-form articles aimed at informing prospective clients — not pushing an immediate sale.
 




 •     
 **LinkedIn Thought Leadership:** 

 Write long\-form LinkedIn articles and posts sharing engineering insights, behind\-the\-scenes production knowledge, and studio milestones — educational in tone, not promotional.
 




 •     
 **Editorial Consistency:** 

 Maintain a clear, credible, and technically trustworthy voice across all written material.
 




**2\. Corporate \& Safety Video Scriptwriting — Secondary Mandate (20%)** 




 •     
 **AV Script Development:** 

 Write two\-column (Audio/Visual) scripts for corporate brand films, industrial process videos, and safety induction/training modules.
 




 •     
 **Narrative Structuring:** 

 Translate technical or safety information into spoken\-word narratives with clear scene direction and pacing.
 




 •     
 **Production Support:** 

 Coordinate with 3D animators, editors, and voiceover artists to keep scripts aligned with the visual storytelling.
 




**Candidate Requirements** 




 •     
 **Experience:** 

 1–3 years in technical writing, content writing, corporate communications, or B2B writing. Scriptwriting exposure is a plus, not a requirement.
 




 •     
 **Core Skill:** 

 Strong long\-form writing — able to research a technical subject and turn it into a clear, well\-structured blog, whitepaper, or case study.
 




 •     
 **Writing Style:** 

 Informative, educational, conversational — geared toward building trust over time, not toward driving immediate action or sales.
 




 •     
 **Technical Curiosity:** 

 Comfortable learning and simplifying industrial operations, heavy machinery, and technical systems without intimidation.
 




 •     
 **Secondary Skill:** 

 Basic familiarity with AV script structure (two\-column Audio/Visual format) and willingness to write narration for video — this is roughly a fifth of the role, not the core of it.
 




 •     
 **Language:** 

 Excellent written English required; Hindi or Gujarati is a plus for client interactions.
 




 •     
 **Work Mode:** 

 Full\-time, in\-office, Vadodara, Gujarat.

title: SDE-2 (React Native + Full stack)
description:
**Software Development Engineer – II** 




**Frontend Platform (Orion)** 




**Urban Company \| Gurugram** 




  





**About the Company** 




 Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardised, and reliable service experience. To fulfil this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



  





 Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind \-
 



  




1. **Customer love:** 
 Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
2. **Partner empowerment:** 
 Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
3. **Technology first:** 
 Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry



  





**About the Role \& Team** 




**Orion is Urban Company’s in\-house frontend platform** 
 : the framework, component system, rendering layer and release infrastructure that every customer and provider facing entity at Urban Company is built on. It is not a library we adopted; we designed and own all of it.
 



 Orion is deliberately cross\-stack. It spans React Native as the base rendering engine for our customer and partner apps, a micro\-frontend architecture, and native Android and iOS layers underneath, with a single component system across all of them.
 



  





 At UC we follow a micro frontend architecture, every product flow: a booking flow, a category page, a checkout step is built as an independently developed and independently deployed micro\-frontend that renders inside the Orion shell, on both app and web. A team ships its changes without coordinating a release with anyone else.
 



  





 Our pod owns that architecture: the shell and its contracts, routing and lifecycle, isolation between micro\-frontends, shared state and navigation across them. As the number of micro\-frontends grows, holding that boundary clean while keeping the app feeling like one product is among the hardest problems on the platform.
 



  





 Orion’s server\-driven UI lets product teams change what a screen shows without shipping an app release, and its own in\-house over\-the\-air pipeline delivers JavaScript updates straight to users’ devices. Every product engineer at Urban Company builds on Orion, which means a change to the platform is felt across the entire company.
 



  





**Our pod sits inside the Orion team** 
 , and owns the following charters built on top of it:
 



  




* **Merchant Platform** 
 : Letting integrating partners sell their services from inside Urban Company. Their experience runs in a container inside our app session, integrated SSO auth, deeplinks, order lifecycle, discovery touchpoints, and their orders showing up alongside ours in the customer's bookings. The bar is performance good enough that our users cannot tell where our product ends and theirs begins while keeping in mind the security and stability repercussions.
* **Third\-Party Integrations** 
 : Taking Urban Company services into other companies' apps. Their users book us without ever leaving their product, server\-to\-server booking flows, request journeys, catalogue mapping, idempotency, and reconciliation when the other side goes quiet.
* **Release \& Over\-the\-Air Delivery** 
 : OTA bundles for customer and partner apps, Android, iOS and web release pipelines, canary rollouts.
* **Platform itself:** 
 Because the pod is part of the Orion team, whoever joins
 **also owns and contributes to Orion itself** 
 , the shared components, the rendering and navigation layer, the release pipeline. You will not just consume the platform, you will improve it, and what you build there is used by every product team at Urban Company and has a direct impact on both our customer and provider app and website ecosystem.



  





 This is a genuinely cross\-stack charter. A single feature here routinely spans a React Native container, a Node.js service and an event pipeline, which is why we hire strong frontend engineers and grow them across the full stack rather than keeping them on one side of it.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* **Build the Merchant Platform:** 
 Take partner brands live inside the Urban Company app, session handoff, order lifecycle, discovery surfaces. While making it secure and fast enough that our users cannot tell where our product ends and theirs begins.
* **Take Urban Company Into Other Apps** 
 : Design and ship server\-to\-server booking flows that let another company's users book us from inside their product. From the first partner call through contract design, idempotency, rollout and reconciliation.
* **Strengthen Orion Itself:** 
 Improve the shared components, rendering layer and release infrastructure that every Urban Company product team depends on.
* **Own and Scale the Micro\-frontend Architecture** 
 : Evolve the shell, contracts and lifecycle that every product team's surface plugs into, and keep the experience feeling like one app as the number of micro\-frontends grows.
* **Grow Across the Stack:** 
 Start in React Native, then take on the Node.js services behind your own features. We expect this, we plan for it, and you will not be doing it alone.
* **Elevate Technical Standards:** 
 Write production\-grade code, drive architectural design discussions, and raise the bar on performance, correctness and observability.



  





**Technology Stack** 




 You will get hands\-on exposure to:
 


* **Frontend (primary):** 
 React Native, TypeScript, micro\-frontends architecture
* **Native:** 
 Kotlin (Android), Swift (iOS)
* **Backend:** 
 Node.js, TypeScript
* **Databases:** 
 MongoDB, MySQL, redis
* **Events:** 
 Kafka, event\-driven systems
* **Analytics:** 
 Snowflake
* **Observability:** 
 Prometheus, Grafana
* **Architecture:** 
 Micro\-frontends, server\-driven UI, microservices
* **Delivery:** 
 In\-house over\-the\-air pipeline, feature flags and experiments



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 2\-4 years of software engineering experience.
* At least 2 years building React Native, or modern web with React/Next.js, shipped to real users at real scale.
* Strong JavaScript and TypeScript.
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design fundamentals.
* Comfortable debugging on real devices: logs, traces, profilers, network waterfalls.
* You already develop with an AI agent. Claude Code is mandatory for every engineer at Urban Company, it is how we write code, debug production issues and find our way around unfamiliar services. You should be comfortable building with an AI coding agent.
* Strong ownership mindset. You have taken a feature from spec through build and release, and then watched the metrics.
* Open to writing backend. No backend experience needed on day one; genuine interest is the requirement. (Backend code in production in any language is a plus.)
* Native Android or iOS exposure, server\-driven UI, design systems, or hard performance work is a plus.
* Experience with mobile release pipelines, CI, or over\-the\-air delivery is a plus.
* Comfortable working in a large codebase you did not write.



  





**What Can You Expect at UC?** 



* Massive ownership and direct customer impact.
* An AI\-native engineering org: Claude Code is standard for every engineer here. It changes what a small pod can own, and it collapses the time it takes to understand a service you have never opened. We are still working out what good practice looks like, and you will help decide it.
* Work on the surfaces every Urban Company customer touches, and the platform every product team builds on.
* Genuine full\-stack growth, frontend to backend, web to native, rather than a single layer for years.
* A high\-performance, high\-velocity engineering culture.
* Quick iterations with real\-world feedback loops.
* Opportunity to grow into senior technical leadership roles.
* Exposure to problems involving, Cross\-platform rendering, app performance on low\-end devices, over\-the\-air delivery and safe rollback, partner API integration, idempotency and correctness.

 Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. title: Game Developer
description:
AI\-FIRST WEB GAME ENGINEER \- GAME GENERATION \& QUALITY AUTOMATION
   

  

 Pupiltree.ai \| Full\-time \| On\-site \- Ballari, Karnataka
   

  

 ABOUT THE ROLE
   

  

 Pupiltree.ai is building a platform that can create web\-based games in bulk from reusable templates. We are looking for a hands\-on engineer who can build engaging browser\-game templates, integrate them into our AI\-powered generation harness, and create the automated quality\-control systems that make generated games reliable, testable, and continuously better.
   

  

 This is not a one\-game\-at\-a\-time development role. You will help build the factory: reusable templates, standard interfaces, generation workflows, validation rules, automated tests, release gates, feedback loops, and the golden dataset that allow game production to scale without sacrificing quality.
   

  

 WORKING ARRANGEMENT \- PLEASE READ
   

  

 This is a permanent, full\-time position and requires compulsory on\-site work in Ballari (Bellary), Karnataka. It is not a remote or hybrid role. Food and accommodation are provided. Specific arrangements will be explained during the hiring process.
   

  

 WHAT YOU WILL DO
   

  

 • Review our existing web games, templates, generation workflow, and cloud harness.
   

 • Design and build reusable templates for multiple types of browser\-based games.
   

 • Create new games and variants with clear rules, responsive controls, reliable state management, and polished player feedback.
   

 • Define standard interfaces for configuration, assets, levels, scoring, difficulty, win/loss states, telemetry, and lifecycle events.
   

 • Integrate templates into the generation harness using Claude Code and/or the Claude Agent SDK, MCP integrations, cloud SDKs, APIs, storage, queues, deployment workflows, and CI/CD where appropriate.
   

 • Make generation runs versioned and reproducible across prompts, configurations, templates, models, and code revisions.
   

 • Build automated checks for compilation, runtime errors, gameplay rules, scoring, state transitions, responsiveness, performance, assets, and browser compatibility.
   

 • Develop programmatic playtests, simulations, test agents, or deterministic replay systems where they improve confidence.
   

 • Create an automated QC and evaluation layer that scores each generated game and blocks outputs that fail agreed thresholds.
   

 • Capture structured reviewer feedback, player signals, defects, and accepted outputs.
   

 • Convert validated feedback into regression tests, improved evaluation criteria, stronger templates, better generation instructions, and updates to the golden dataset.
   

 • Add observability and reporting so the team can understand failure patterns and quality trends across batches.
   

 • Document the template specification, integration workflow, QC framework, and operating procedures.
   

  

 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
   

  

 • New game templates can be added through a clear, repeatable process.
   

 • Generated games are automatically built, launched, exercised, evaluated, and accepted or rejected.
   

 • Failures are traceable and easy to diagnose.
   

 • Human and player feedback becomes structured data that improves future templates, tests, evaluations, prompts, and the golden dataset.
   

 • Game output can scale without manual review effort increasing at the same rate.
   

  

 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
   

  

 • Strong experience building web\-based games or highly interactive browser applications.
   

 • Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and modern web\-development fundamentals.
   

 • Experience with Phaser, PixiJS, Three.js, Canvas/WebGL, or an equivalent browser\-game or rendering stack.
   

 • Ability to design reusable architectures, template systems, and clean integration contracts.
   

 • Experience with automated browser testing and programmatic validation using Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools.
   

 • Experience building cloud\-based workflows using SDKs, APIs, storage, queues, containers, serverless services, or CI/CD systems.
   

 • Strong understanding of game state, input handling, scoring, progression, difficulty, deterministic behaviour, and edge cases.
   

 • Ability to translate quality goals into measurable checks and useful evaluation criteria.
   

 • Strong debugging, documentation, and end\-to\-end ownership skills.
   

  

 NICE TO HAVE
   

  

 • Production experience with Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, MCP, or equivalent coding\-agent workflows.
   

 • Experience with LLM\-assisted code generation, AI agents, evaluation harnesses, or synthetic\-data workflows.
   

 • Experience designing golden datasets, regression corpora, rubric\-based evaluations, or human\-in\-the\-loop review systems.
   

 • Knowledge of telemetry, experimentation, player analytics, or automated gameplay simulation.
   

 • Familiarity with procedural content generation and configuration\-driven game systems.
   

 • Experience optimizing browser games for performance, accessibility, touch devices, and multiple screen sizes.
   

 • Experience operating large batch pipelines with traceability, retries, idempotency, and cost controls.
   

  

 HOW TO APPLY
   

  

 Please apply with your resume or LinkedIn profile and include:
   

  

 • Links to browser games, interactive products, developer tools, or generation systems you have built.
   

 • A short description of the most relevant game architecture or automation pipeline you owned.
   

 • An example of how you tested game logic or evaluated generated software or content at scale.
   

  

 Code samples, playable demos, technical write\-ups, and architecture diagrams are welcome. Please explain how you would use AI\-powered agents and automated QC to generate and validate many games without manually reviewing every output.

The HR Executive cum Learning \& Development (L\&D) role is a dual\-function position responsible for supporting core HR operations while driving the organization’s training and development initiatives. The candidate will be instrumental in enhancing employee capabilities, engagement, and organizational effectiveness.

**Key Responsibilities:1\. HR Operations:**

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment processes, including job postings, candidate screening, scheduling interviews, and onboarding.
* Maintain employee records, attendance, and payroll coordination.
* Handle employee grievances, queries, and concerns with professionalism and confidentiality.
* Support HR policy formulation, implementation, and compliance with labor laws.
* Facilitate exit interviews and clearance processes for departing employees.

**2\. Learning \& Development (L\&D):**

* Identify training needs across the organization by conducting training needs analysis (TNA).
* Design, develop, and deliver effective training programs, workshops, and sessions for employees.
* Coordinate with external training providers or subject matter experts for specialized sessions.
* Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through feedback, assessments, and impact analysis.
* Create a learning culture by promoting online learning platforms and knowledge\-sharing sessions.

**3\. Employee Engagement:**

* Plan and execute employee engagement activities and events to improve organizational morale.
* Conduct surveys and feedback mechanisms to understand employee needs and satisfaction.
* Assist in organizing rewards and recognition programs.

**4\. Performance Management:**

* Support the implementation and monitoring of performance appraisal systems.
* Assist managers in setting KPIs and provide feedback training for team members.
* Analyze appraisal data to identify gaps and recommend development plans.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2\-4 years of experience in HR and Learning \& Development functions.
* Strong knowledge of HR processes, labor laws, and training methodologies.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Proficient in MS Office and HRIS tools.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Training \& Development (e.g., ISTD, ATD) or HR\-related courses.
* Experience in conducting soft skills or technical training sessions.
* Familiarity with e\-learning platforms and tools.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
* Exposure to diverse HR and L\&D initiatives.
* Career growth and development opportunities.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹9,941\.86 \- ₹32,838\.47 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Department:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Location:** 
 Cocoma Digital HQ – Andheri West, Mumbai
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time (On\-site)
 



**Overall Experience** 
 : 5\+ years in Human Resources.
 



**HR Manager Experience:** 
 Minimum 2\+ years working in an HR Manager/Asst. Hr Manager role.
 



**Industry Background** 

 : Entertainment, Social Media, Digital Marketing, Advertising, Creative, Media, or Agency experience is mandatory.
 




**Reporting To:** 
 COO / Leadership Team
 



  





**ABOUT COCOMA DIGITAL \& STUDIOS** 




 Cocoma Digital \& Studios is a fast\-growing creative and marketing powerhouse managing multiple brands and sister companies. Our Digital division specializes in YouTube growth strategy, social media marketing, creator collaborations, content development, and digital brand building. Our Studios division delivers end\-to\-end post\-production, localization, and creative production services across Films, OTT, Television, and Digital Platforms.
 



 As we continue to scale rapidly, we're building a structured, technology\-first, and performance\-driven organization. We're looking for an HR professional who can help us hire better, build stronger processes, improve employee experience, and implement AI\-driven HR operations.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 We're looking for a proactive and execution\-focused
 **Human Resources Manager** 
 who can build strong HR systems while supporting the company's rapid growth.
 



 This role goes beyond traditional HR.
 



 You'll be responsible for attracting top talent, improving hiring quality, reducing hiring turnaround time, implementing HR processes, strengthening company culture, improving employee retention, driving performance management, and leveraging AI and automation to build a modern HR function.
 



 You'll work closely with leadership and department heads to ensure Cocoma hires the right people, builds scalable processes, and creates a high\-performance culture.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Own end\-to\-end recruitment across Creative Depts, YouTube, Social Media, Production, Technology, Business Development, and Corporate functions.
* Partner with department heads to understand hiring priorities and workforce planning.
* Build strong talent pipelines through LinkedIn, Naukri, referrals, networking, social media, and proactive talent sourcing.
* Improve hiring quality while reducing hiring turnaround time.
* Screen candidates beyond resumes by evaluating attitude, communication, culture fit, ownership, and long\-term potential.
* Coordinate interviews, assessments, offer rollouts, salary negotiations, documentation, and onboarding.
* Maintain a structured ATS and recruitment database for future hiring needs.



**HR Operations \& Process Excellence** 



* Manage the complete employee lifecycle—from onboarding to exit.
* Maintain employee records, HR documentation, attendance, leave management, and HRMS.
* Coordinate payroll inputs with the Finance team.
* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements including PF, ESIC, Gratuity, Shops \& Establishment Act, and applicable labour laws.
* Prepare HR dashboards, MIS reports, hiring analytics, attrition reports, and workforce insights for leadership.



**Performance Management \& Employee Development** 



* Drive probation reviews, confirmations, KRAs, KPIs, and performance evaluation cycles.
* Partner with managers to identify skill gaps and training requirements.
* Support career development, internal mobility, and succession planning.
* Help managers build high\-performing teams through structured feedback and performance tracking.



**Employee Engagement \& Culture** 



* Conduct induction and onboarding programs for new employees.
* Foster a collaborative, performance\-oriented, and accountable work culture.
* Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives, celebrations, learning sessions, and team\-building activities.
* Address employee concerns professionally while maintaining confidentiality and fairness.
* Drive initiatives that improve employee satisfaction and retention.



**HR Systems, SOPs \& Organizational Development** 



* Build, document, and continuously review and improve HR policies, SOPs, onboarding processes, and employee handbooks.
* Standardize HR workflows across departments to ensure consistency and operational efficiency.
* Recommend process improvements that increase transparency, accountability, and productivity.
* Ensure all HR documentation and organizational records are accurate and up to date.



**AI, Automation \& HR Technology** 



* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR tasks using AI and digital tools.
* Utilize ATS platforms, AI sourcing tools, AI screening tools, and workflow automation to improve recruitment efficiency.
* Leverage AI for job descriptions, candidate sourcing, interview coordination, HR documentation, reporting, and internal communication.
* Continuously evaluate emerging HR technologies that improve hiring speed, candidate experience, and operational excellence.



**Leadership Partnership** 



* Act as a trusted HR partner for department heads.
* Support leadership in manpower planning, organizational restructuring, and resource allocation.
* Present hiring insights, workforce analytics, and HR recommendations to management.
* Contribute towards building a scalable HR function aligned with Cocoma's long\-term growth plans.



  





**REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in HR, Talent Acquisition, or HR Operations.
* Experience hiring for Social Media, Creative Agencies, Media, Technology, Production, or Startup environments is highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of recruitment strategies, HR operations, employee engagement, and performance management.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational abilities with the capability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* High ownership, execution capability, and problem\-solving mindset.



  





**LANGUAGE \& COMMUNICATION PROFICIENCY** 



* **English** 
 – Professional Proficiency
* **Hindi** 
 – Professional Proficiency



  





**TOOLS \& TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY** 




**HR \& Recruitment** 



* ATS Platforms (Zoho Recruit, Recruit CRM, Workable, or similar)
* LinkedIn Recruiter
* Naukri Recruiter
* HRMS Platforms



**Productivity** 



* Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive)
* Microsoft Office Suite



**AI \& Automation** 



* ChatGPT
* Google Gemini
* Claude
* Perplexity
* AI sourcing and recruitment tools
* Workflow automation platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar)



  





**SUCCESS METRICS (KPIs)** 



* Time\-to\-Hire
* Quality of Hire
* Offer Acceptance Rate
* Hiring Target Achievement
* Employee Retention
* Probation Success Rate
* Recruitment Funnel Conversion
* Employee Engagement Score
* HR Process Compliance
* Hiring Manager Satisfaction
* AI \& Process Automation Adoption
* HR Documentation \& SOP Completion



  





**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE** 




 We're looking for someone who:
 


* Thinks like a business partner rather than just an HR executive.
* Enjoys building teams and hiring exceptional talent.
* Can identify high\-potential candidates beyond what's written on a resume.
* Is process\-oriented and believes in documentation, SOPs, and continuous improvement.
* Has experience working in high\-growth, fast\-paced organizations.
* Embraces AI and technology to improve HR efficiency.
* Is proactive, accountable, and execution\-focused.
* Can confidently work with founders, department heads, and leadership teams.
* Thrives in a performance\-driven environment and enjoys solving organizational challenges.



  





**WHAT WE OFFER** 



* Competitive Compensation
* Career Growth Opportunities
* Opportunity to Build \& Scale HR for a Rapidly Growing Organization
* Exposure to Creative, Digital, Media \& Technology Businesses
* AI\-Driven HR \& Recruitment Environment
* Collaborative \& Entrepreneurial Work Culture
* Opportunity to Drive Organizational Growth \& Transformation



  





**A DAY AT COCOMA DIGITAL – Human Resources Manager** 




 Your day begins by reviewing hiring priorities, recruitment pipelines, and workforce updates. You'll coordinate with department heads to close critical positions, conduct interviews, and ensure candidates move efficiently through the hiring process.
 



 Throughout the day, you'll optimize recruitment workflows, manage employee relations, support onboarding, review HR metrics, implement AI\-driven hiring processes, and collaborate with leadership on organizational planning.
 



 At Cocoma, HR is more than managing people; it's about building high\-performing teams, creating scalable systems, leveraging technology, and enabling the organization to grow with the right talent, processes, and culture.

title: HR Manager – Talent Acquisition, HR Ops & Facility Management
description:

 **D2C (E\-commerce/Retail)** 
 and
 **B2B (Wholesale/Corporate/Exports)** 
 channels, we combine creative innovation with robust supply chain execution to deliver high\-quality apparel nationwide and globally.
 



  




**Role Overview** 

 We are looking for a versatile, proactive
 **HR Manager** 
 to take end\-to\-end ownership of our Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, General Administration, and Facility Management functions.
 



 The ideal candidate brings a blend of
 **Non\-IT** 
 (manufacturing, pattern masters, merchandisers, retail sales) and
 **IT/E\-commerce hiring** 
 experience, alongside strong operational grit to manage facility upkeep, office administration, and employee life\-cycle governance.
