**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning (IT \& Non\-IT)**

 Source and recruit specialized apparel talent—Fashion Designers, Pattern Masters, Merchandisers, Sourcing Specialists, Quality Controllers, and Factory/Production staff.

 Recruit for modern D2C and corporate roles—E\-commerce Specialists, Digital Marketing Executives, Software developers, and Analytics professionals.

 **exit management** 
 , including notice period adherence, clear handover documentation, and Full \& Final (F\&F) settlements.

 Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred).

 Strong organizational ability to manage facility vendors, asset inventory, and daily administrative needs simultaneously.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills; capability to interact comfortably with floor staff, corporate teams, and senior leadership.Being Multi lingual is an added advantage withspoken Hindi a must.

 Ability to thrive in a fast\-moving, multi\-channel (D2C \+ B2B) business environment.

 Play a central leadership role shaping people practices across creative design, manufacturing, and e\-commerce.
* **Growth Platform:** 
 Be an integral driver of our operational expansion as we scale our production and retail channels.
* **Competitive Compensation:** 
 Salary package commensurate with industry standards and candidate expertise.

title: Senior HR Manager
description:
**NOTE ABOUT LOCATION:** 
 This is an onsite role based out of Milliman office in Gurgaon, India. The person is expected to work out of Gurgaon office 5 days a week.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Senior HR Manager supports and strengthens the HR function for Milliman India by delivering professional and comprehensive HR service to all practices. As a steward of the company's values, the successful candidate will advise, influence and coach the HR team to build and support an inclusive, productive and high integrity work environment.
   

  

 This includes oversight of the Talent Acquisition function, HR Administration and providing direction and leadership to develop the team as required. This individual will be working closely with the HR Business Partnering team as well who reports to the Director Of Human Resources.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work collaboratively with the broader HR teams to ensure that Milliman practices receive the highest standards of HR support.
* Collaborate with the HRBP team to develop new policies, then be responsible for implementing and administering those HR policies locally.
* Review changes in employment law and work with Global Corporate Services (GCS) to ensure the organization’s policies and procedures are up to date and compliant with legislation.
* Ensure POSH compliance and records are maintained, with any concerns being dealt with appropriately by the relevant team.
* Work on queries received by HR department e.g. compensation, benefits, flexible work, leave entitlement etc. ensuring they are passed to the appropriate team members for resolution in a timely manner.
* Work with HR Service Team (HRST) to ensure that any administrative support is provided in a timely and accurate manner.
* Ensure that all HR data is managed with a zero tolerance for error or inaccuracy.
* Produce and analyze monthly absence reports, identifying trends and working with HRBP team to improve the practice support.
* Ensure that any Employee Relations matters are passed immediately to the HRBP team for resolution but providing guidance and support to the team in managing issues within Milliman India.
* Deal with any immigration queries, working with the central Immigration teams as required.
* Deal with all Leavers administration.
* Identify opportunities to develop and implement process improvement initiatives.
* Work with Compensation team to ensure regular benchmarking is carried out and available prior to performance reviews.
* Collaborate with the Finance team to collate and forward all necessary payroll information per the deadline and requirements. Partner with Finance to resolve any payroll queries and discrepancies.
* Liaise with the relevant HR departments globally to ensure that compensation data is accurate and updated accordingly.
* Deal with annual review of all Employee Benefits. Work with Finance leader to ensure accurate maintenance of all employee benefits administration.
* Support the Performance Review Processes for local practices, ensuring that any performance issues are passed to the HRBP team for resolution (e.g. PIPs).
* Ensure all performance management data is collected in the HRIS system of record and changes and promotions are passed to HRST for letters and notifications to be distributed.
* Support the Talent Acquisition Manager in developing strategic partnerships across the local practices to support all hiring needs whilst developing solid talent pipelines for future recruitment needs. Provide oversight and support the end\-to\-end recruitment delivery across actuarial, technical and non\-technical roles, requisition management, sourcing and interviewing through to onboarding.
* Provide oversight and support the TA Manager in driving direct sourcing, using agencies where appropriate, optimizing referrals, developing campus hiring and utilizing TA metrics as appropriate.
* Employer Brand – Work with practices to strengthen Milliman’s employer brand locally and continue to develop the awareness of Milliman as a great place to work.
* Review and ensure a fair and transparent Recruitment and Selection process across Milliman India.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager (Full Time/Remote)
description:
**ABOUT SMILE** 




  






 Smile is a national digital health company founded in 2006 comprising five divisions, including the National Dental Network and Health Fund Partnerships.
 




  






 Smile is committed to revolutionising quality healthcare accessibility and affordability for the people of Australia. Smile is the top\-rated dental cover in the country, offering Retail Dental Cover to the public and Corporate Dental Cover to companies and their teams across Australia.
 




  






 We have operated successfully with a globally distributed team since 2017 and continue to grow across multiple areas of the business.
 




  





**ROLE OBJECTIVE** 




  





 We are seeking an exceptional
 **Senior HR Manager** 
 to take ownership of Smile's People function as our lead HR professional.
 



  





 This is a broad, high\-ownership position combining three important elements:
 


* **Strategic Adviser** 
 — partnering directly with our CEO and COO on People strategy, organisational challenges, performance, retention and remuneration.
* **HR Manager** 
 — owning the full employee lifecycle and ensuring our People practices remain effective as the company grows.
* **Hands\-On Operator** 
 — personally carrying out the operational work required to keep the HR function moving.



  





 This is not a role for someone who wants to manage HR from a distance or delegate most operational work to a coordinator.
 



  





 You will be senior enough to advise leadership while remaining hands\-on enough to personally execute.
 



 Our immediate priority is
 **Talent Acquisition** 
 . We are therefore looking for someone with significant international recruitment experience, strong judgement when assessing talent and a demonstrated ability to identify and attract exceptional performers.
 



  





 As Smile grows, you will also help strengthen our performance, development, retention and remuneration practices while keeping our People systems practical, lightweight and appropriate for a globally distributed organisation.
 



  





**AMAZING REASONS TO WORK WITH SMILE** 




  




* **100% Remote:** 
 Enjoy the flexibility and convenience of working remotely.
* **Full\-Time Position:** 
 Secure a stable and consistent working schedule.
* **Similar Time Zone:** 
 Work with a globally distributed team operating around Australian business hours.
* **Established Company:** 
 Join a successful organisation established in 2006\.
* **National Presence:** 
 Be part of an Australian digital health company with a national footprint.
* **Meaningful Work:** 
 Contribute to Smile's mission of improving healthcare accessibility and affordability.
* **Direct Leadership Exposure:** 
 Work closely with Smile's CEO and COO and have meaningful input into People decisions.
* **High Ownership:** 
 Take genuine ownership of the People function rather than managing one small piece of HR.
* **Opportunity to Build:** 
 Help shape performance, development, retention and People practices as the organisation continues to grow.
* **High\-Performance Environment:** 
 Work alongside experienced leadership and a globally distributed team with high expectations for ownership and performance.



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Talent Acquisition** 



* Own international recruitment end\-to\-end, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, assessment, offers and onboarding.
* Maintain a high hiring bar and help leadership consistently identify A Players.
* Develop practical sourcing strategies across different international talent markets.
* Manage multiple recruitment processes simultaneously while maintaining candidate quality and speed.
* Continuously improve recruitment workflows, screening methods and candidate assessment.
* Partner with hiring managers to clearly define requirements and challenge assumptions where necessary.
* Monitor recruitment performance and identify opportunities to improve candidate quality, efficiency and hiring outcomes.



  





**HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle** 



* Manage employee and contractor onboarding and offboarding.
* Maintain HR documentation, records and People systems.
* Manage leave administration and support payroll processes.
* Ensure HR policies and processes remain accurate, practical and consistently applied.
* Manage day\-to\-day employee queries and People\-related administration.
* Continuously improve HR workflows to reduce unnecessary manual work and administration.



  





**Performance \& Employee Relations** 



* Support and manage performance\-related matters professionally and confidently.
* Guide managers through difficult employee conversations and performance concerns.
* Handle employee\-relations matters with sound judgement, confidentiality and emotional maturity.
* Help establish and operate effective performance management processes.
* Ensure performance expectations and accountability remain clear across the organisation.



  





**People Advisory \& Organisational Development** 



* Act as a trusted People adviser to the CEO and COO.
* Provide honest, practical and evidence\-based recommendations rather than simply agreeing with leadership.
* Identify People risks early and recommend proportionate solutions.
* Support organisational changes and the development of new divisions as Smile grows.
* Help build practical employee development and career\-development processes.
* Support leadership with remuneration reviews and salary benchmarking.
* Identify potential retention risks and recommend appropriate actions.



  





**AI \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Use AI and other digital tools confidently in your day\-to\-day HR and recruitment work.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality and decision\-making through technology.
* Explore ways to reduce repetitive HR administration and improve candidate and employee experiences.
* Stay curious about emerging People, recruitment and AI tools without over\-engineering solutions.



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)** 




  





 Performance in this role may be assessed through areas including:
 



  




* **Quality of Hire:** 
 Ability to consistently identify and recruit strong performers who succeed after joining.
* **Recruitment Efficiency:** 
 Effective management of sourcing, screening, interviewing and hiring pipelines.
* **Hiring Manager Satisfaction:** 
 Quality of partnership and support provided throughout recruitment.
* **People Operations Accuracy:** 
 Timely and accurate completion of onboarding, documentation, leave, payroll support and HR administration.
* **Performance Management:** 
 Effectiveness and consistency of performance\-management processes and manager support.
* **Employee Relations:** 
 Quality, judgement and timeliness in resolving People\-related matters.
* **Retention \& Risk Identification:** 
 Ability to identify meaningful retention or People risks before they become larger problems.
* **People Process Improvement:** 
 Practical improvements to systems, workflows and People practices.
* **Leadership Advisory:** 
 Quality and usefulness of advice provided to the CEO, COO and managers.
* **Ownership \& Accountability:** 
 Demonstrated responsibility for outcomes, reliability and proactive follow\-through.
* **AI \& Digital Effectiveness:** 
 Practical use of technology to improve efficiency and quality across HR and recruitment.



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 




  





 This full\-time role will suit someone who meets all or most of the following:
 


* 8\+ years of broad HR / People experience.
* Experience in senior HR generalist, HR Manager or People leadership roles.
* Strong, hands\-on end\-to\-end international recruitment experience.
* Experience working within a remote or globally distributed organisation.
* Experience advising CEOs, founders or senior leadership.
* Demonstrated experience managing performance and employee\-relations matters.
* Experience with remuneration and salary benchmarking.
* Experience supporting a rapidly growing business or new business division.
* Experience establishing or operating performance and employee\-development processes.
* Strong HR operational capability, including personally handling onboarding, documentation, leave, payroll administration and related activities.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong digital capability and practical day\-to\-day use of AI tools.
* High emotional maturity and sound professional judgement.
* Strong ownership, accountability and ability to work independently.
* Confidence respectfully challenging senior leadership where appropriate.
* A professional remote\-working environment and demonstrated remote\-work experience.



  





**Highly regarded:** 



* Experience operating as the sole or lead HR professional within a smaller or growing organisation.
* Recruitment experience across international talent markets including India, the Philippines, Pakistan, Vietnam and/or Bangladesh.
* Experience building People systems or frameworks from scratch.



  





 If you believe you are a great fit for the role and meet the requirements above, we look forward to hearing from you!

title: Sr. Manager, People Advisory&Business Partnership.People Advisory&Business Partnership
description:
Job Purpose
   

 Working closely with the Senior PABP, the role supports and manages the relationship with employees in the respective client groups on all people matters. The role would also work closely with line managers in an advisory capacity and be responsible for independently managing specific divisions on general people matters end to end.
   

 The role will assist in driving initiatives such as the periodic Performance Management process, L\&D interventions, Rewards \& Recognition, Employee Engagement etc. for the respective client groups in addition to also providing timely reports and analysis. Job also involves also effective coordination with internal PICG functions to facilitate business requirements and take part in PICG led bank wide programs/projects.
   

  

 Business Partnering \& Employee Engagement:
   

  

 \- Establish positive meaningful relationships with employees, serve as an advisor to people and partner to business.
   

  

 \- Assist the Sr. PABP in managing the staffing requirements for the Client Groups.
   

  

 \- Assist in the smooth onboarding and orientation of senior hires, conduct exit interviews and share feedback internally.
   

  

 \- Support in the group wide Employee Engagement and Wellbeing activities as and when required.
   

  

 \- Conduct regular 1:1, skip level meetings and share feedback.
   

  

 \- In coordination with the employee experience function, ensure all staff grievances are addressed and resolved in a timely manner; initiate appropriate disciplinary process in line with the Bank's policies.
   

  

 \- Provides guidance and input on business unit restructures, workforce planning and succession planning.
   

 \- Guide managers on people practices, labor laws and statutory requirements.
   

  

 \- Help drive team culture in creating a ‘preferred’ workplace for employees and foster an environment where employee behavior is aligned to our values. Conduct regular meetings with middle management level in respective groups to update them on PICG transformation journey and new/in the pipeline initiatives/projects.
   

  

 \- Support the PICG team in developing solutions, programs and policies.
   

 \- Maintains in\-depth knowledge of legal requirements related to day\-to\-day management of employees, reducing legal risks and ensuring regulatory compliance. Partners with the legal department as needed/required.
   

 \- Provides HR policy guidance and interpretation.
   

 \- Develops contract terms for new hires, promotions and transfers.
   

  

 MIS and Policy management:
   

 \- Manage all people related MIS / data requests across the client groups.
   

  

 \- Maintain a comprehensive employee database and manage ongoing reports/analysis for all Groups.
   

  

 \- Work with the PICG functions on policy/benefits review and updates, maintain a record of all policies and benefits for UAE \& MGNs.Assist employees and people managers on matters relating to policy Implementation and clarification.
   

  

 \- Ensure adherence to policy and be guided by the people manuals across locations. Support line managers in the job evaluation process(documentation and coordination).
   

  

  

 Rewards and Recognition:
   

 \- Manage the recognition budgets in coordination with the respective Group coordinators, distribution for all client groups.
   

  

 \- Ensure all budgets are accurately maintained and issuance requests are processed in a timely manner in compliance with policy and process.
   

  

 \- Share timely updates with the respective Group Heads and Division Heads on utilization.
   

  

 \- Manage the iValue program in close coordination with the Sr. PABP.
   

  

 Performance Management:
   

 \- Assist the Sr. PABP in effectively managing the PM process for the Client Groups. This includes the mid\-year performance check and the annual appraisal process \-rating, bonus and increment distribution.
   

  

 Ensure timely completion of year end reviews, goal setting and completion of mandatory training programs.
   

 Knowledge, Skills and Experience
   

 \- A minimum bachelor degree qualification in any field is required.
   

 \- –5\-7 years’ experience in Human Resources at both operational and strategic level.
   

 \- Strong interpersonal skills, influencing, high level of analytical ability.
   

 \- Knowledge of banking business/financial services industry is a distinct advantage.
   

 \- Highly customer focused, as it demands in a service industry.
   

 \- Leadership skills, experience in working with matrixed organization.
   

 \- Sound knowledge of all areas of HR with experience of international practices is preferred.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**ABOUT PLUM** 




 Plum is India's leading employee benefits and health insurance platform, helping companies take better care of their people. We're on a mission to make healthcare accessible, transparent, and delightful, and we're growing fast. As we scale, our People function is central to how we build, retain, and grow our talent.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 We're looking for a Senior HRBP who is a genuine thought partner, someone who deeply understands people, business, and the nuance between the two. You'll embed with business teams (with a preference for Sales, Marketing, or Customer\-facing functions), navigate the complex human dynamics of a fast\-scaling startup, and help leaders build resilient, high\-performing cultures.
 



 This is not a transactional HR role. We want someone who thinks in systems, listens before advising, and brings both emotional intelligence and business acuity to every conversation.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 




  




* **Strategic Partnership.** 
 Act as a strategic thought partner to business leaders, helping them navigate org design, team dynamics, and talent decisions.
* **Conflict Resolution.** 
 Handle sensitive and complex employee situations with discretion, empathy, and sound judgment, from performance conversations to team conflict.
* **Stakeholder Relationships.** 
 Build deep relationships across your business unit; understand their goals, pressures, and the human context behind decisions.
* **Manager Enablement.** 
 Coach managers on leadership, feedback, and people practices, enabling them to grow as leaders rather than creating dependency on HR.
* **People Programs.** 
 Drive critical people programs like engagement, retention, and talent reviews with a bias for impact over process.
* **Culture \& EQ.** 
 Spot cultural signals early and bring them to the surface; be the connective tissue between people and leadership.
* **Cross\-functional Collaboration.** 
 Partner with Talent Acquisition, L\&D, and Comp \& Benefits teams to deliver a seamless people experience.



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 



* **Experience.** 
 5\-7 years of HRBP or People Partner experience, ideally in a B2B who has seen the 1\-10 Journey.
* **Conflict Competence.** 
 Demonstrated ability to manage conflict, have difficult conversations, and hold space for complexity without losing composure.
* **Emotional Intelligence.** 
 High EQ, you read rooms well, build trust quickly, and know when to push and when to listen.
* **Business Acumen.** 
 You understand revenue, growth targets, and what it means to operate in a fast\-paced commercial environment.
* **Functional Context.** 
 Exposure to Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success orgs is a strong plus.
* **Academic Background.** 
 Background or training in Psychology, Organizational Behavior, or Human Development is preferred.
* **Builder Mindset.** 
 You're energized by ambiguity and motivated to create, not just run, people processes.



  





**YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF** 




  




* You've been in the room when a startup scaled through chaos and helped the people come out better for it.
* You find yourself naturally curious about why people behave the way they do.
* You can hold a business leader accountable while still being their biggest champion.
* You don't wait for a playbook, you write the playbook.
* You're as comfortable with data and dashboards as you are with a 1:1 that goes emotionally deep.



  





**WHAT PLUM OFFERS** 



* A seat at the table with real influence on how we build our people culture at scale.
* Comprehensive health insurance (of course, we're Plum).
* Flexible hybrid work environment from Bangalore.
* A leadership team that takes people seriously as a competitive advantage.

description:
**JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.**
 Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you have got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you are looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a motivated Transformation Business Analyst to join our team and contribute to diverse projects spanning strategy, technology, operations, and process improvement. This role sits at the intersection of business understanding and AI/tech enabled product development: you will work to understand what the business is trying to achieve and help translate that understanding into direction that a technology team can act on to build. It is a role built around working closely and iteratively with technology teams, in an environment that moves quickly and puts data at the center of decision making. The role calls for someone who is comfortable with ambiguity and pace, and who can engage confidently with senior stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic analysis and problem solving**
* Support senior analysts in evaluating business opportunities and market expansion initiatives
* Assist in developing recommendations by conducting research, gathering data, and analyzing industry trends
* Help identify risks, opportunities, and potential solutions through structured problem solving approaches
* Translate business outcomes and priorities into problem framing that technology and data teams can act on
* Participate in client meetings and contribute to presentation development, including engaging directly with senior stakeholders


**Process analysis and problem resolution**
* Identify and analyze business pain points through stakeholder interviews, process observation, and data analysis
* Support root cause analysis initiatives using structured methodologies to uncover underlying issues
* Assist in designing process improvements and solutions that address identified problems
* Help develop workflows and procedures that streamline operations and eliminate inefficiencies
* Support the implementation of new processes and monitor their effectiveness
* Document current state processes and future state direction, keeping documentation lean and focused on decisions rather than exhaustive specification


**Bridging business and technology for AI/tech enabled products**
* Work alongside technology and data teams to shape what a tech solution should do, grounded in a clear understanding of the business problem
* Translate business context and outcomes into direction that technical teams can use to scope and build solutions, and translate technical possibilities and constraints back to business stakeholders
* Support technology implementations by clarifying business intent and priorities
* Assist in user acceptance testing (UAT) and quality assurance activities
* Support process improvement initiatives and workflow optimization projects
* Work in an iterative, fast paced manner, adjusting direction as understanding of the problem and the data evolves


**Project coordination and delivery**
* Track project milestones, deliverables, and key performance indicators
* Assist in managing project documentation and maintaining organized records
* Help coordinate cross\-functional teams and facilitate communication between stakeholders, including senior stakeholders


**Data analysis and reporting**
* Analyze business data to identify trends, patterns, and insights
* Create reports and dashboards to support decision making
* Support the development of business cases and analytical frameworks
* Assist in developing metrics and KPIs for business performance measurement
* Use data as a starting point for shaping what a tech solution should address, not only as a reporting output


**Business analysis tools and techniques**
* Apply foundational BA techniques including stakeholder analysis, requirements elicitation, and gap analysis
* Utilize process modeling tools (process flows, swimlane diagrams, value stream mapping)
* Support data modeling and documentation using techniques such as entity relationship diagrams
* Assist with business rules analysis and decision modeling
* Apply problem solving frameworks including root cause analysis (5 Whys, Fishbone diagrams)
* Support risk analysis and impact assessment methodologies
* Use prioritization techniques (MoSCoW, Kano model) for requirements and solution evaluation


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or related analytical field
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with attention to detail
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and a fast pace, and adjusting direction as new information emerges
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned tasks
* Demonstrated project management capabilities through internships, coursework, or extracurricular activities
* Understanding of fundamental business analysis concepts and techniques


**Preferred Qualifications**
* A genuine interest in and working understanding of how data and AI can be applied to business problems
* Comfort with data (for example SQL, Tableau, Power BI) as a way of understanding a business problem, rather than as a technical specialization
* Previous internship experience in consulting, strategy, or business analysis
* Familiarity with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall)
* Knowledge of business process mapping tools (Visio, Lucidchart, or similar)
* Understanding of process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma basics)
* Exposure to requirements management tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps, or similar)
* Basic understanding of how AI or data driven products get scoped and evaluated


**What We Offer**
* Exposure to diverse projects across strategy, technology, and operations, including AI enabled product work
* Mentorship from senior business analysts and consultants
* Opportunity to develop both technical and consulting skills
* Training in advanced business analysis methodologies and tools
* Clear career progression path with increasing responsibility and client exposure

description:
Job Description – Operations \& Data Analyst
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 We are looking for an Operations \& Data Analyst to manage business data, maintain accurate reports and trackers, analyse operational performance, and provide meaningful insights to support management decisions.
 



  





 The role will work closely across Operations, Sales and Marketing, with responsibility for pulling data from different teams and systems, consolidating it, analysing performance and highlighting important business insights.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is analytical, organised, detail\-oriented and proactive, with strong hands\-on knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and the ability to work across multiple business functions.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Data Management \& Reporting
 



  





 \* Pull and consolidate data across Operations, Sales and Marketing from different teams, platforms and business systems.
 



 \* Collect, organise, clean and validate data to ensure reports are accurate and up to date.
 



 \* Maintain structured trackers, dashboards, MIS reports and management reports.
 



 \* Ensure strong sheet hygiene through correct formatting, formulas, dropdowns, validations, naming conventions and duplicate checks.
 



 \* Cross\-check and reconcile information across multiple reports and data sources.
 



 \* Coordinate with teams to collect missing information and ensure timely updates.
 



  





 Operations Data \& Analysis
 



  





 \* Track and analyse operational data including order processing, production, inventory, dispatch, delivery, returns, exchanges and other key operational metrics.
 



 \* Identify delays, exceptions, recurring issues, process gaps and operational inefficiencies.
 



 \* Monitor operational KPIs and highlight areas requiring immediate attention.
 



 \* Maintain action trackers and follow up on pending operational issues.
 



  





 Sales Data \& Analysis
 



  





 \* Pull and maintain daily, weekly and monthly sales data.
 



 \* Track sales performance, orders, revenue, conversion, customer trends and other relevant sales KPIs.
 



 \* Analyse sales trends and identify gaps, opportunities and areas of improvement.
 



 \* Reconcile sales data across different sources and ensure reporting accuracy.
 



 \* Provide management with clear observations and insights from sales performance.
 



  





 Marketing Data \& Analysis
 



  





 \* Pull and consolidate data from marketing channels, campaigns and platforms.
 



 \* Track key marketing metrics such as traffic, leads, enquiries, campaign performance, customer acquisition and conversions.
 



 \* Maintain marketing performance trackers and dashboards.
 



 \* Analyse campaign and channel performance to identify what is working, what is not and where improvements may be required.
 



 \* Coordinate with the marketing team/agency to ensure data is collected and reported accurately and on time.
 



  





 Business Insights \& Management Reporting
 



  





 \* Analyse daily, weekly and monthly business performance across Operations, Sales and Marketing.
 



 \* Track KPIs, trends, delays, exceptions, gaps and areas requiring attention.
 



 \* Prepare structured reports and data summaries for management and review meetings.
 



 \* Convert raw data into observations, insights and actionable recommendations.
 



 \* Highlight unusual trends, inconsistencies or potential business risks proactively.
 



 \* Support management in making data\-driven decisions.
 



  





 Documentation \& Process Management
 



  





 \* Maintain SOPs, process documentation, meeting notes and action trackers.
 



 \* Keep reporting systems and trackers organised and easy for teams to use.
 



 \* Follow up on key action points and ensure timely closure.
 



 \* Help improve reporting processes, data collection systems and business dashboards.
 



 \* Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve reporting efficiency through basic automation.
 



  





 Skills Required
 



  





 \* Strong knowledge of Google Sheets
 



 \* Data collection, cleaning, consolidation and validation
 



 \* Data analysis and management reporting
 



 \* Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS and basic dashboards
 



 \* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
 



 \* High attention to detail and data accuracy. Ai workflow and automation.
 



 \* Good communication and cross\-functional coordination
 



 \* Ability to understand business metrics and identify trends
 



 \* Strong documentation and organisational skills
 



 \* Ability to present data and insights clearly during meetings
 



 \* Ability to work with data across Operations, Sales and Marketing
 



  





 Qualifications
 



  





 \* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics or a related field.
 



 \* Strong practical knowledge of data handling and Excel/Google Sheets will be given significant importance.
 



  





 Experience
 



  





 \* 1–3 years of experience in Operations, MIS, Business Analytics, Data Analysis, Reporting or a similar role.
 



 \* Experience handling trackers, dashboards, MIS reports and management reporting is preferred.
 



 \* Experience working with data across multiple departments will be an added advantage.
 



 \* Strong freshers with excellent Excel/Google Sheets and analytical skills may also be considered.
 



  





 Preferred Knowledge
 



  





 Exposure to tools such as Shopify, CRM platforms, Google Analytics, logistics platforms, Google Drive and basic automation tools will be an added advantage.
 



  





 Ideal Candidate
 



  





 We are looking for someone who does not just update data, but can understand what the numbers mean, identify gaps, find possible reasons and recommend the next course of action.
 



  





 You should be comfortable working across Operations, Sales and Marketing, pulling data from different sources and bringing it together into one clear view of business performance.
 



  





 Key Approach
 



  





 Collect → Clean → Analyse → Identify → Insight → Recommend → Track

 A Blend of Business Consulting and Product Expertise, your responsibilities will encompass both business consulting and product expertise, enabling you to make a holistic impact on our clients' success.

title: Operations Excellence- Business Analytics
description:
**About The Role**
 Purplle's Operational Excellence function drives the standards, systems, and problem\-solving discipline across the full supply chain — Fulfillment Centers, Distribution Centers, Dark Stores, Control Tower, Logistics (B2B and B2C), and Inventory Planning. This role sits at the core of that function — translating operational noise into structured diagnosis, and structured diagnosis into on\-ground fixes, using an AI\-first way of working as the default rather than the exception.
   

  

 You will work directly with the Operational Excellence lead across live network problems — quality escalations, cost leakage, process breakdowns, and performance gaps — and you will be expected to use AI tools as a core part of how you analyze, write, and build, not as an occasional shortcut.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Operational Diagnosis and Process Improvement**
* Diagnose recurring inefficiencies across FC inbound/outbound, ICQA, STO/IWT, and Dark Store operations, and convert findings into structured improvement charters with clear owners and timelines.
* Drive root\-cause analysis on escalations — quality misses, CPT breaches, inventory loss — through to closure, not just documentation.
* Build, standardize, and maintain SOPs across nodes so fixes hold beyond a single site or shift.


**AI\-First Analytics and Automation**
* Default to AI tools for reporting, root\-cause synthesis, SOP drafting, and leadership summaries — speed and quality of output are expected to reflect this.
* Build and maintain dashboards (Metabase, Looker Studio, BigQuery) tracking DPMO, CPT breach, inventory loss, and productivity metrics in real time.
* Identify manual, repetitive workflows across the network and prototype AI\-assisted or automated alternatives to replace them.


**Control Tower and Performance Governance**
* Support Control Tower exception management and network\-wide performance visibility.
* Prepare sharp, number\-driven inputs for weekly and monthly business reviews (WBR/MBR).
* Track cross\-functional action items to closure — silence is not confirmation; closure is.


**Cost and Quality**
* Support cost optimization initiatives — packaging, shipping, capex — with data\-backed recommendations.
* Partner with ICQA on inventory accuracy and loss\-reduction tracking across FC and DS.


**Logistics and Inventory Planning**
* Partner with B2B and B2C Logistics teams to track exception resolution, TAT adherence, and the health of network movements (STO/IWT).
* Work with Inventory Planning / S\&OP to reconcile distribution plans against on\-ground execution capacity and flag gaps early.
* Support network\-wide inventory visibility — DC–FC movements, SWIS gaps, in\-transit stock — feeding directly into Control Tower reporting.


**Stakeholder Execution**
* Coordinate directly across FC, DC, DS, Logistics (B2B/B2C), Inventory Planning, tech, and vendor stakeholders to push improvement initiatives to completion.
* Take independent ownership of smaller improvement programs end\-to\-end, with scope expanding as you demonstrate consistency.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Improvement charters that move from analysis to implemented, measurable fixes — independently, without repeated hand\-holding.
* A growing footprint of ownership across programs and stakeholder relationships, not just tasks.
* Dashboards and AI\-assisted workflows that measurably cut manual reporting effort across the OE function.
* A track record where problems identified become problems closed.


**What We're Looking For**
**Must Have**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in supply chain operations, logistics, inventory planning, business/operations analytics, or process excellence — e\-commerce, quick\-commerce, or warehousing background preferred.
* Strong hands\-on command of Excel/Google Sheets, with working knowledge of SQL and BigQuery (or equivalent).
* A genuine AI\-first working style — fluent and fast with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or NotebookLM for analysis, drafting, and problem\-solving, not just occasional use.
* Ability to turn messy, ambiguous operational data into clear, decision\-ready insight.
* Sharp written and verbal communication — able to produce leadership\-ready output with minimal editing.
* High ownership and comfort operating across multiple sites and stakeholders simultaneously.


**Good to Have**
* Working exposure to Python for data automation.
* Familiarity with WMS/OMS platforms such as Easyecom or equivalent.
* Prior experience coordinating small projects or improvement initiatives end\-to\-end.


**About Company**
 Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000\+ brands, 60,000\+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
   

  

 Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000\+ offline touchpoints and launched 100\+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third\-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend\-driven, high\-quality beauty essentials.
   

  

 What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper\-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer\-first approach.
   

  

 In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
   

  

 With a 3,000\+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

description:
A Jr data engineer on the BW SOON Data Team supports the analysis of data from multiple source systems and assists in developing data marts based on business requirements, under the guidance of senior team members. Solid data analytics and technical fundamentals are required, along with the ability to assist in creating data models, STTMs, and other technical documentation. The Engineer should have good communication skills and the ability to understand design requirements and existing business processes to support the design, development, and implementation of data products — in partnership with business partners and senior engineers. In addition, the Engineer should have the following knowledge: 1\) Develop, monitor, and support ETL/ELT pipelines processing enterprise data, with intermediate experience using Oracle Data Integrator (ODI). 2\) Assist in developing data warehouse and data mart solutions, including data models, STTMs, technical design documents, and data lineage documentation, under senior guidance. 3\) Analyze and profile data from source systems, including DB2, Oracle, and distributed data platforms. 4\) Intermediate expertise in SQL and Oracle PL/SQL development, including query writing, troubleshooting, and basic performance tuning. 5\) Working knowledge of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling using Kimball methodologies, Third Normal Form (TNF), Data Vault concepts, and Medallion Architecture. 6\) Assist in investigating and resolving production issues, data quality concerns, and performance bottlenecks; basic experience with incident support and root cause analysis. 7\) Collaborate with business partners and senior engineers to understand requirements and support the development of data solutions. 8\) Basic experience supporting data quality controls, reconciliation processes, and metadata management, with awareness of data security, access controls, PII protection, and compliance requirements. 9\) Support cloud modernization and data migration initiatives as assigned; exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) is a plus. 10\) Good communication, documentation, and collaboration skills, with a willingness to learn and grow technical and stakeholder\-facing abilities. 11\) Beginner to Intermediate — Python development skills for data integration and automation tasks. 12\) Familiarity — Snowflake, DBT, and related orchestration/version\-control tools (e.g., Fivetran, Airflow, GitHub) is a plus.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Join us as a Data Engineer
   

  

* This is an exciting opportunity to use your technical expertise to collaborate with colleagues and build effortless, digital first customer experiences
* You’ll be simplifying the bank by developing innovative data driven solutions, using insight to be commercially successful, and keeping our customers’ and the bank’s data safe and secure
* Participating actively in the data engineering community, you’ll deliver opportunities to support the bank’s strategic direction while building your network across the bank
* We're offering this role at associate level


 What you'll do
   

  

 As a Data Engineer, you’ll play a key role in driving value for our customers by building data solutions. You’ll be carrying out data engineering tasks to build, maintain, test and optimise a scalable data architecture, as well as carrying out data extractions, transforming data to make it usable to data analysts and scientists, and loading data into data platforms.
   

  

**You’ll Also Be**
* Developing comprehensive knowledge of the bank’s data structures and metrics, advocating change where needed for product development
* Practicing DevOps adoption in the delivery of data engineering, proactively performing root cause analysis and resolving issues
* Collaborating closely with core technology and architecture teams in the bank to build data knowledge and data solutions
* Developing a clear understanding of data platform cost levers to build cost effective and strategic solutions
* Sourcing new data using the most appropriate tooling and integrating it into the overall solution to deliver for our customers


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you’ll need a good understanding of data usage and dependencies with wider teams and the end customer, as well as experience of extracting value and features from large scale data.
   

  

**You’ll Also Demonstrate**
* Experience of ETL technical design, including data quality testing, cleansing and monitoring, and data warehousing and data modelling capabilities
* Experience of using programming languages alongside knowledge of data and software engineering fundamentals
* Good knowledge of modern code development practices
* Strong communication skills with the ability to proactively engage with a wide range of stakeholders

**About Us:**
 Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
   

  

 Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
   

  

**Overview:**
 Join us at Seismic, a cutting\-edge technology company leading the way in the SaaS industry. We specialize in delivering modern, scalable, and multi\-cloud solutions that empower businesses to succeed in today’s digital era. Leveraging the latest advancements in technology, including Generative AI, we are committed to driving innovation and transforming the way businesses operate. As we embark on an exciting journey of growth and expansion, we are seeking engineering talent to join our AI team in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 We are seeking a versatile Data Engineer with 2\+ years of experience to build and scale the data infrastructure powering our organization. You will develop robust pipelines and optimize architectures that bridge the gap between traditional analytics and next\-generation AI. In this role, you will work at the intersection of large\-scale data processing and modern AI, building the critical foundations for high\-performance applications and agentic workflows.
   

  

**Who you are:**
* Experienced Engineer: You have 2\+ years of professional experience in data engineering or a backend\-heavy software engineering role.
* Python Expert: You possess expert\-level Python coding skills (Must Have), with a focus on writing clean, scalable, and asynchronous code.
* LLM Orchestrator: You have deep, hands\-on experience (Must Have) with LangChain or LangGraph to build sophisticated multi\-step chains and agentic systems.
* Vector DB Specialist: You have proven experience (Must Have) implementing and tuning Vector Databases for high\-volume RAG pipelines.
* Data Foundationist: You have a strong understanding of traditional data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and working with SQL/NoSQL databases.
* AI\-Literate: You have a solid grasp of embedding models, tokenization, and modern information retrieval techniques.
* Agile \& Innovative: You thrive in fast\-paced environments and enjoy staying updated with the rapidly evolving landscape of GenAI and search technologies.


**What you’ll be doing:**
* Architect AI Data Pipelines: Design and maintain robust data ingestion and transformation pipelines tailored for LLM training, fine\-tuning, and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Build Agentic Workflows: Utilize LangGraph to develop complex, state\-managed AI agents and cyclical workflows that enhance automated user interactions.
* Optimize RAG Systems: Architect the retrieval layer of our AI applications, implementing efficient document embedding strategies and semantic search.
* Manage Vector Infrastructure: Implement and optimize Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus) to ensure high\-performance data retrieval and storage.
* Scale Data Models: Create scalable data schemas that support both structured and unstructured data, ensuring seamless integration with our AI services.
* Performance Engineering: Identify and resolve latency bottlenecks in data retrieval and embedding generation to ensure real\-time AI responsiveness.
* Collaborate Cross\-Functionally: Partner with AI Researchers and Product Managers to transition experimental AI prototypes into production\-ready data products.


**What we have for you:**
 At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
   

  

 If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
   

  

 Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
   

  

 Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward‑thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting‑edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long‑term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.
   

  

 From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.
   

  

**About The Department**
 The Enterprise Data, Governance \& Integration Platforms Engineering team delivers the foundational platforms that power enterprise data, analytics, integration, governance, and AI capabilities across Franklin Templeton. Working at the intersection of cloud engineering, platform development, and data innovation, the team builds reusable services, APIs, and engineering frameworks that enable scalable and secure business solutions. Team members gain hands\-on experience with modern cloud technologies, platform engineering practices, AI\-enabled development tools, and enterprise\-scale data ecosystems while partnering with engineering, governance, analytics, and security teams.
   

  

***How You Will Add Value?***
**Core Responsibilities**
* You will develop and enhance reusable data engineering frameworks and platform services.
* You will build APIs, SDKs, and cloud\-native components supporting enterprise data platforms.
* You will develop batch and real\-time data processing capabilities using Python and AWS.
* You will implement scalable data ingestion and transformation solutions.
* You will contribute to Data Lake and event\-driven platform development.
* You will build and support CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and deployment processes.
* You will monitor platform performance and resolve operational issues.

***Team \& Collaboration***
* You will collaborate with engineers, architects, and product teams to deliver platform capabilities.
* You will participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and engineering forums.
* You will share knowledge and contribute to engineering best practices.

**Strategic Responsibilities**
* You will leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) coding assistants to improve productivity.
* You will use AI\-powered tools for development, testing, and debugging activities.
* You will contribute to prompts, workflows, and orchestration capabilities supporting AI\-enabled engineering.
* You will help drive adoption of modern engineering and automation practices.
* You will support platform reliability, governance, security, and operational excellence.
* You will continuously learn emerging technologies and platform engineering approaches.


***What Will Help You Be Successful in This Role?***
**Experience**
* 2–3\+ years of software engineering experience.
* Experience with backend, cloud, or platform development.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and source control tools.
* Experience developing software using Python.
* Exposure to reusable frameworks, platform services, or shared libraries is preferred.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development workflows is advantageous.


***Education \& Certifications***
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Equivalent practical experience may be considered.


**Technical Skills**
* Python and object\-oriented programming.
* Amazon Web Services (AWS) including Lambda, S3, Glue, ECS, and Event Bridge.
* APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Event\-driven architecture patterns.
* Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* GitLab, CI/CD automation, and deployment pipelines.
* Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals.
* Data Lake, Kafka, Kinesis, and streaming technologies.
* Airflow, observability, and monitoring tools.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Curiosity and passion for learning.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Attention to detail and quality.
* Enthusiasm for AI, cloud\-native technologies, and platform engineering.


**Work Shift Timings \- 2:00 PM \- 11:00 PM IST**
 At Franklin Templeton, we believe your benefits should support your life, your goals, and your future. That’s why we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to help you thrive both personally and professionally.

title: Senior Associate, Data Science & AI
description:
The Global Commercial Analytics (GCA) team within the Chief Marketing Office (CMO) organization is dedicated to transforming data into actionable intelligence, enabling the business to remain competitive and innovative in a data\-driven world.  We play a pivotal role in extracting insights from large and complex datasets to drive strategic decision\-making. Collaborating closely with various subject matter experts across various fields, our team leverages advanced statistical analysis, machine learning techniques, and data visualization tools to uncover patterns, trends, and correlations within the data. Additionally, we are dedicated to delivering new, innovative capabilities by deploying cutting\-edge Machine learning algorithms and artificial intelligence techniques to solve complex problems and create value.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Sr Associate, Data Science and AI** 
 who will be responsible for delivering data\-derived insights and/or AI\-powered analytics tools to Pfizer’s Commercial organization and will support a brand or therapeutic area. This includes leading the execution and interpretation of AI/ML models, framing problems, and shaping solutions with clear and compelling communication of data\-driven insights. We are seeking a hands\-on Data Scientist to design and implement advanced analytics and machine learning solutions that drive commercial decision\-making in the pharmaceutical domain. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in statistical modeling, forecasting, segmentation, clustering, classification, and regression, with experience in Bayesian methods. Familiarity with pharma or healthcare data is highly desirable. Exposure to agentic AI frameworks is a plus.
   

  

 This role is dynamic, fast\-paced, highly collaborative, and covers a broad range of strategic topics that are critical to our business. The successful candidate will join GCA colleagues worldwide that are driving business transformation through proactive thought\-leadership, innovative analytical capabilities, and their ability to communicate highly complex and dynamic information in new and creative ways.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Predictive Modeling \& Forecasting
* Develop and deploy forecasting models for sales, demand, and market performance using advanced statistical and ML techniques.
* Apply Bayesian modeling for uncertainty quantification and scenario planning.
* Segmentation \& Targeting
* Implement customer/physician segmentation using clustering algorithms and behavioral data.
* Build classification models to predict engagement, conversion, and prescribing patterns.
* Commercial Analytics
* Design and execute regression models to measure promotional effectiveness and ROI.
* Support marketing mix modeling (MMM) and resource allocation strategies.
* Machine Learning \& AI
* Develop ML pipelines for classification, clustering, and recommendation systems.
* Explore agentic AI approaches for workflow automation and decision support (good\-to\-have).
* Data Management \& Visualization
* Work with large\-scale pharma datasets (e.g., IQVIA, Veeva CRM, claims, prescription data).
* Create interactive dashboards and visualizations using Tableau/Power BI for senior stakeholders.
* Collaboration \& Communication
* Partner with Commercial, Marketing, and Insights teams to understand business needs.
* Present analytical findings and actionable recommendations through clear storytelling.


**Required Qualifications**
* Education: Master’s or Ph.D. in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field.
* Experience: 0–2 years in data science or advanced analytics, preferably in commercial pharma or healthcare.
* Technical Skills:
* Strong proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit\-learn, statsmodels, PyMC for Bayesian).
* SQL for data extraction and transformation.
* Experience with ML algorithms: regression, classification, clustering, time\-series forecasting.
* Familiarity with Bayesian modeling and probabilistic programming.
* Visualization tools: Tableau, Power BI.
* Domain Knowledge: Pharma/healthcare datasets and commercial analytics concepts.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication and ability to translate complex analytics into business insights.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with agentic AI frameworks (good\-to\-have).
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and MLOps practices.
* Exposure to marketing mix modeling (MMM) and promotional analytics.


 Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

 We are looking for a Data Scientist, Performance Analytics within Engineering to build performance intelligence for our advertising platform.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

 engineering.

title: Natural Language Processing Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 




**Moleculyst Ventures Private Limited is a deep\-tech artificial intelligence research startup focused on building more reliable, autonomous, and scientifically capable AI systems.** 




**Our current research focuses on hallucination detection in large language models, mechanistic understanding of model behavior, uncertainty and reliability estimation, and the development of automated AI research pipelines.** 




**We are building systems that can assist with the full research cycle: reading technical literature, identifying open questions, generating hypotheses, designing experiments, executing computational studies, analyzing results, and retaining useful knowledge across iterations.** 




**A central goal of our work is to understand when AI systems possess relevant internal knowledge but still produce incorrect or fabricated outputs, and to develop methods for detecting and reducing such failures.** 




**Moleculyst is also developing infrastructure for self\-improving research agents, including scientific memory systems, experiment orchestration, model evaluation, and tools for reproducible AI research.** 




**Our broader objective is to create AI systems that can function as reliable scientific collaborators rather than simple language interfaces—systems capable of reasoning, experimentation, self\-evaluation, and increasingly autonomous discovery.** 




**Role Description — Natural Language Processing / AI Research Engineer** 




**As a Natural Language Processing / AI Research Engineer at Moleculyst, you will work on research involving large language models, hallucination detection, model reliability, scientific reasoning, and automated AI research systems.** 




**This role goes beyond conventional NLP tasks such as text classification or basic information extraction. You will study how language models represent and retrieve knowledge, why they hallucinate, and how internal model signals can be used to predict whether an output is reliable.** 




**You will also contribute to the development of AI research agents capable of reading papers, generating hypotheses, running experiments, evaluating results, and improving their research strategies over time.** 




**Key responsibilities include:** 



* Developing methods for detecting hallucinations and unreliable outputs from large language models.
* Analyzing transformer representations, hidden states, attention patterns, residual streams, and other internal model signals.
* Investigating whether models internally distinguish known information from uncertain or fabricated information.
* Designing controlled experiments and benchmark datasets for evaluating hallucination detection methods.
* Studying representation geometry, model confidence, uncertainty, and other signals related to factual reliability.
* Implementing and evaluating ideas from current research papers in NLP, language models, interpretability, and AI reasoning.
* Building automated research pipelines for literature analysis, hypothesis generation, experimentation, evaluation, and iterative improvement.
* Developing memory systems for research agents, including semantic, procedural, and experimental memory.
* Creating systems for storing research results, experimental observations, failed approaches, and reusable procedures.
* Building tools for experiment orchestration, automated evaluation, result comparison, and research reproducibility.
* Developing scientific literature processing and retrieval systems where required by the research pipeline.
* Working with local and remote large\-language\-model inference infrastructure.
* Maintaining high\-quality experimental code, documentation, datasets, and research records.
* Collaborating with other researchers and engineers on open\-ended AI research problems.



**Qualifications** 



* Strong foundation in computer science, algorithms, data structures, and software engineering.
* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Solid understanding of machine learning and deep learning.
* Familiarity with transformer architectures and modern large language models.
* Practical experience with PyTorch and relevant scientific computing libraries.
* Understanding of embeddings, attention mechanisms, representation learning, and model evaluation.
* Ability to read research papers and independently implement experimental ideas.
* Strong experimental reasoning skills, including hypothesis formation, controlled evaluation, and interpretation of results.
* Familiarity with Git and reproducible research workflows.



 Experience in any of the following is highly valuable:
 


* Hallucination detection, factuality evaluation, uncertainty estimation, or calibration.
* Mechanistic interpretability or transform

title: Database Architect
description:
**Internal Designation:** 

 DigiVir \- Database Structure Architect / Digivir \- Database Administrator 
 




  





**Portal Designation:** 

 Database Structure Architect 
 




  





**Salary:** 

 18,000 INR to 21,000 INR per month (Total Package)
 




  





**Location:** 

 100% Remote (Requires high\-speed internet, working camera, and microphone)
 




  





**Employment Type:** 

 Full\-time
 




  





**Experience** 

 : 0\-1 Year 
 




  





**Education:** 

 Bachelor’s degree (B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc / BCA) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 




  





**About HabotConnect FZCO** 




  






 HabotConnect FZCO is a Dubai\-based, bootstrapped, 100% remote company building a digital platform that connects parents with Learning Support Assistants (LSA)  for children with learning difficulties. We operate in a high\-ownership, accountability\-driven remote culture where quality and clarity come before speed.
 




  





**About the Role** 




  






 The Database Structure Architect serves as the critical translation layer between our Data Lineage specialists and our physical infrastructure. Your primary job will be to document the database schema and create comprehensive Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERDs). You will be responsible for taking upstream inputs—specifically the Logical Design Document (LDD)—and extending them into a standalone, buildable database structure. Traditional "UI\-first" database design is strictly banned; instead, you will engineer databases backward, starting exclusively from the defined End Document (ED) and reverse\-engineering step\-by\-step to the Source Document (SD). 
 




  





**Primary Responsibilities** 




  




* **Document Database Schemas** 

 : Translate every table, queue, or store referenced in the LDD into a formal, buildable physical schema.
* **Create ERD Diagrams:** 

 Generate accurate Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERDs) that exactly reflect the tables, primary keys, foreign keys, and relationships defined in the schema constraints.
* **Polyglot Persistence Mapping:** 

 Determine the exact right storage engine for specific data types, deciding where the architecture requires SQL, NoSQL, Graph, or Time\-Series databases.
* **Lineage\-to\-Storage Traceability:** 

 Maintain a strict mapping from upstream transformations to downstream storage, ensuring every table column traces back to its origin.
* **Database Lineage Locks:** 

 Hardcode strict relational constraints, specifically requiring a predecessor\_id column to ensure the database engine physically rejects any orphan records.
* **Normalization \& Optimization:** 

 Balance data integrity against read performance by structuring schemas (1NF–3NF) for transactional safety or strategically denormalizing for analytical efficiency. Architect indexing strategies to ensure queries execute within optimal time complexities.



  





**Technical Skills / Tools** 




  




* **Relational Design:** 

 Deep expertise in relational database design (e.g., PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Cloud SQL).
* **Documentation \& ERD:** 

 Proven ability to document strict data dictionaries and generate precise ERD diagrams.
* **Data Boundaries:** 

 Strong understanding of schema constraints, primary/foreign key relationships, and explicit data type boundaries.
* **Analytical Deconstruction:** 

 Ability to objectively deconstruct compound data structures into atomic, granular components.



  





**Soft Skills** 
**\& Remote Work Mindset:** 





  




1. **Self\-Discipline \& Routine:** 

 Exceptional time\-management skills with the ability to maintain a highly productive and consistent remote routine
2. **Meticulous Attention to Detail:** 

 Extreme structural discipline and a commitment to validating work thoroughly rather than assuming correctness
3. **Resourcefulness:** 

 An independent learner who proactively utilizes documentation and outside resources to solve technical blocks
4. **Structured Communication:** 

 Ability to communicate clearly, objectively, and concisely via chat and email



  





**Onboarding \& Success Path** 




  






 Selected candidates must successfully complete a mandatory structured onboarding and training program. Engagement and progress during onboarding are closely monitored and form part of the probation evaluation. Failure to complete required training or demonstrate sufficient involvement may result in the offer being withdrawn.
 




  





**What This Role Is NOT** 




  




* **This is NOT a senior architect, lead engineer, or tech lead position.** 

 It is an entry\-level, execution\-focused role where you will deploy and maintain resources based on structured guidelines
* **This is NOT a subjective, open\-ended decision\-making role.** 

 We build highly automated, strict, rule\-based systems to eliminate guesswork
* **This is NOT a part\-time or flexible freelance contract.** 

 It is a full\-time, high\-ownership commitment



  





**Application Process** 




  






 Interested candidates are invited to apply for this exciting opportunity. As part of our evaluation process, you will be required to complete a short Hiring Project Form (HPF)  simulating the analytical tasks of this role.
 




  





**Project Link:** 
 https://forms.gle/dSWV1WsWYrfYfdxx7
 



  






 Kindly review the project instructions carefully and submit your completed work using the submission link below. Be sure to include your contact information and any other required details.
 




  





**Submission Link (Google Form):** 
 https://forms.gle/Rqr2AAth1hrXReWD6
 



**Submission Deadline:** 

 20th September 2026
 




  






 Our team will review all submissions, and shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a virtual interview. Note: You only have one chance to submit. We are looking for quality of identification and clarity of impact.
 




  





**Final Self\-Screening Checklist Apply only if:** 




  




* You are comfortable with the exact salary bracket of 18,000 \- 21,000 INR/month.
* You have a dedicated workspace with a stable internet connection and webcam for remote work.
* You are fully prepared to abandon traditional workflow writing and embrace strict Data Flow logic.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
IND Senior Quality Engineer \- GCC015
   

  

 We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.
   

  

**Job Description: Junior SDET**
 Location: Hyderabad, India
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

  

 Experience Level: 1\-2 years
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking Junior SDET to join our Premium Audit transformation team in Hyderabad, India. In this role, you will architect, implement, and scale automated testing for the Premium Audit platform spanning UI, API, data, and workflow layers. You’ll enable high‑velocity delivery by building robust automation frameworks (Playwright, REST Assured), integrating quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating with Engineering, Product, and Ops to ensure releases are secure, reliable, and performant.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support test preparation and validation activities, including writing simple SQL queries, preparing test data, performing regression checks in CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating with engineers and BAs to clarify requirements and expected behaviors.
* Build and maintain Playwright UI suites and REST Assured API frameworks; standardize patterns, utilities, fixtures, and test data management for reuse across teams.
* Embed smoke, regression, and non‑functional checks into automated CI/CD pipelines (gating, parallelization, flaky‑test management, artifacting) to ensure predictable, fast feedback.
* Use SQL to validate audit data transformations, reconcile service responses to source of truth, and codify data‑quality assertions in automation suites.
* Incorporate Premium Audit domain rules (documents, exposures, triage paths) into test scenarios to maximize defect prevention and business accuracy.
* Partner with engineers and BAs to define acceptance criteria, add test hooks/telemetry, and adopt TDD/BDD where valuable.
* Collaborate on performance, resilience, and security checks aligned with enterprise standards and platform SLIs/SLOs.
* Improve test observability (logs, traces, metrics), triage pipeline failures quickly, and drive continuous improvement of flakiness, coverage, and mean‑time‑to‑detect.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 1 \- 2 years in SDET/SWE roles with a strong track record building test automation for cloud‑native, microservices‑based systems.
* Experience with Playwright and Karate for UI and REST Assured for API automation; hands‑on with Postman for exploratory/API validation.
* Proven experience integrating automated test suites into enterprise CI/CD pipelines, including parallel execution, environment configuration, artifacts, and test‑data seeding.
* Strong coding skills (e.g., TypeScript/Java) with clean test‑code design, use of fixtures/mocks, dependency injection, and maintainable framework patterns.
* Comfortable writing complex SQL for verification, reconciliation, and data‑quality checks across transactional and analytical stores.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, event‑driven architectures, workflow/rules engines, and integration testing at system boundaries.
* Experience contributing to backlog refinement, definition of done, and iterative delivery within Agile/SAFe teams.
* Ability to map test scenarios to Premium Audit processes and financial/insurance operational controls.
* Familiarity with AWS‑based delivery, containerized runners, and pipeline tooling such as Jenkins or Azure DevOps.


**Nice To Have Skills**
* Experience with performance testing (e.g., k6, Gatling, JMeter), chaos/resilience checks, and tuning within CI.
* Experience with service virtualization, synthetic data generation, and privacy‑aware test data management.
* Awareness of OWASP‑aligned security testing practices and collaboration with AppSec to automate baseline security validations.
* Working knowledge of P\&C / Premium Audit workflows (documents, exposure/classification logic, audit review paths)


**What We Offer**
* Opportunity to work on advanced cloud automation and AI technologies.
* Collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.

This separation provides our team with a bold opportunity to unleash our potential, enabling us to operate with greater speed and agility. As a separate entity, we anticipate leveraging increased investments to drive meaningful innovation and enhance our impact on patient care.

 We are seeking a talented
 **Tools \& Automation Software Engineer** 
 to develop and maintain software tools, automation frameworks, and CI/CD platforms that accelerate the development of next\-generation embedded medical devices. This role focuses on improving engineering productivity, software quality, test automation, compliance, and release efficiency within a regulated environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and develop tools and automation solutions that support the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Build and maintain scalable CI/CD pipelines for embedded firmware, cloud, and application software.
* Automate software build, test, validation, release, and compliance workflows.

* Develop solutions that improve traceability between requirements, source code, testing, and releases.

* Create dashboards and metrics that provide visibility into software quality, testing, and pipeline performance.
* Evaluate and apply AI\-assisted engineering tools and workflows to improve productivity and efficiency.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, developer tools, test automation, or CI/CD.
* Strong programming skills in Python, C, C\+\+, JS and scripting for automation.
* Experience with Git, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Experience with Linux\-based development environments and container technologies such as Docker.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation).
