title: Network Engineer II
description:
**Details:**
 Job Description
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced L2 Network Engineer with strong expertise in enterprise networking, data\-center infrastructure, and Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI). The selected candidate will provide second\-level operational support for Cisco ACI fabrics, routers, switches, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, and related network\-management platforms.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for incident resolution, network monitoring, troubleshooting, approved configuration changes, maintenance activities, documentation, and collaboration with L1, L3, architecture, security, application, vendor, and globally distributed teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Cisco ACI and Data Center Networking
   

  

* Administer and troubleshoot Cisco ACI fabrics using Cisco APIC.
* Support and troubleshoot ACI tenants, VRFs, bridge domains, EPGs, application profiles, contracts, filters, VLAN pools, AEPs, physical domains, and interface policies.
* Troubleshoot endpoint learning, endpoint attachment, EPG communication, contract enforcement, policy deployment, and fabric faults.
* Monitor and troubleshoot ACI fabric health scores, events, faults, interface issues, and node connectivity.
* Support Layer 2 and Layer 3 external connectivity, including L2Out and L3Out.
* Troubleshoot OSPF and BGP adjacency, route advertisement, redistribution, and reachability issues between ACI and external networks.
* Support ACI software upgrades, configuration backups, maintenance activities, validation, and rollback procedures.
* Participate in ACI implementation, migration, standardization, and network\-improvement projects.
* Provide operational support for ACI Multi\-Site or Multi\-Pod environments, where applicable.


 Enterprise Network Operations
   

  

* Provide L2 support for LAN, WAN, datacenter, internet\-edge, and wireless network incidents.
* Monitor, manage, and troubleshoot Cisco and Dell switches, routers, wireless controllers, and access points.
* Troubleshoot Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies, including VLANs, trunking, STP, EtherChannel, HSRP/VRRP, inter\-VLAN routing, and device stacking.
* Troubleshoot routing protocols including OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP, based on the network design.
* Perform approved IOS, NX\-OS, firmware, and wireless\-controller upgrades.
* Perform hardware replacement, device commissioning, configuration restoration, and post\-change validation.
* Perform and validate network\-device configuration backups and restores using approved tools and procedures.
* Support remote installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of network devices using secure management methods.


 Firewall and Network Security
   

  

* Provide operational support for Cisco ASA/FTD and, where applicable, Palo Alto or Fortinet firewalls.
* Troubleshoot firewall zones, security rules, NAT, VPN, failover, and traffic\-flow issues.
* Support firewall changes in accordance with approved change\-management and security procedures.
* Support Cisco ISE authentication and authorization services, including RADIUS and TACACS\+ troubleshooting.
* Coordinate with security teams for firewall, access\-control, authentication, and policy\-related issues.


 Incident, Problem, and Change Management
   

  

* Resolve L2 incidents within agreed service levels and provide clear, timely technical updates.
* Perform structured troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for recurring or high\-impact incidents.
* Execute approved network changes and maintenance activities in accordance with change\-management procedures.
* Prepare implementation plans, validation steps, rollback plans, and post\-change reports.
* Escalate design\-level, high\-risk, or unresolved issues to L3 engineering, architecture, or vendor teams.
* Maintain accurate incident, problem, request, and change records in ServiceNow or an equivalent ITSM platform.
* Participate in major incident bridges and provide technical updates to stakeholders when required.


 Monitoring and Documentation
   

  

* Monitor network availability, utilization, capacity, performance, and fault conditions using Cisco Catalyst Center, SolarWinds, or equivalent tools.
* Review alerts, logs, events, health scores, and performance trends and take appropriate corrective action.
* Maintain network diagrams, configuration standards, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Prepare shift handovers, incident reports, post\-incident reviews, and operational documentation.
* Ensure that all activities comply with security, audit, access\-control, and change\-management requirements.


 Job Requirements
   

  

**Details:**
 Required Qualifications and Technical Skills
   

  

* 3\-7 years of experience in network engineering, network operations, data\-center networking, or infrastructure support.
* At least 2 years of hands\-on experience supporting Cisco ACI and APIC.
* Strong understanding of Cisco ACI architecture and its policy\-driven operating model.
* Hands\-on experience with tenants, VRFs, bridge domains, EPGs, contracts, application profiles, L2Out, and L3Out.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4, subnetting, VLANs, STP, EtherChannel, HSRP/VRRP, and inter\-VLAN routing.
* Working experience with OSPF and BGP; EIGRP knowledge is advantageous.
* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting Cisco or equivalent switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of Cisco ASA/FTD, Palo Alto, or Fortinet firewalls.
* Experience with network monitoring tools and ITSM platforms, preferably ServiceNow.
* Experience with network\-device configuration backup and restoration procedures.
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams and follow formal incident, problem, and change\-management processes.
* Bachelor"s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Networking, or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory where equivalent practical experience is demonstrated.


**Preferred Skills And Certifications**
* Cisco CCNA certification is preferred.
* Cisco CCNP Enterprise or CCNP Data Center is highly desirable.
* Experience with ACI Multi\-Site, Multi\-Pod, VMM integration, VMware networking, or hypervisor connectivity.
* Experience with Cisco ISE, Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco Prime, SolarWinds, or equivalent tools.
* Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud networking.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, Ansible, Terraform, or other network\-automation technologies.
* Experience creating and maintaining network diagrams using Microsoft Visio or equivalent tools.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong analytical and structured troubleshooting abilities.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong ownership of incidents through resolution or appropriate escalation.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a service\-driven environment.
* Calm and professional approach during outages and critical incidents.
* Good customer service and stakeholder\-management orientation.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and support continuous improvement.
* Ability to work effectively during US time\-zone coverage, rotational shifts, and on\-call assignments.


 Working Conditions

* US time\-zone support, rotational shifts, weekend maintenance, and occasional on\-call support may be required.
* The role may require coordination with global teams, customers, service providers, and technology vendors.
* The engineer must follow all company security, access\-control, confidentiality, and change management policies.

 \* Reduced market entry costs

title: Software Engineer 3, AI Framework Integrations
description:
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI — and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Software Engineers to be among its founding members.
   

  

 The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third\-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools — the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest\-moving open\-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it.
   

  

 This is a strong role for an engineer who wants to grow into the AI space with real ownership. You'll own well\-scoped projects from design through release, work with fast\-moving and sometimes unproven technologies, and get a clear view of how the ecosystem is evolving. Priorities shift as frameworks change and customer demand moves, so we're looking for engineers who are adaptable, ask good questions, and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and participating in developer communities as MongoDB.
   

  

 You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, with senior engineers and your manager close at hand as you take on larger pieces of it.
   

  

 MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high\-quality software and living our cultural values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Position expectations
   

  

* Build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra
* Own well\-scoped projects end to end on weekly\-to\-quarterly timelines, taking responsibility for the scope, schedule, and quality of your own work and communicating progress and trade\-offs clearly
* Solve day\-to\-day technical problems with growing independence, using the team's established patterns and past practice to guide your decisions, and seeking guidance on non\-standard problems
* Contribute to exploratory work on new frameworks: help evaluate an integration's feasibility, build a first working version of the piece you own, and share what you learn with the team
* Contribute high\-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, following the team's contribution practices and maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy through external maintainer review cycles
* Work within and improve the team's engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility checks, and release steps. Suggest improvements where you see repeated friction
* Help keep the integrations you work on healthy: monitor for upstream breaking changes, handle upgrades, triage incoming issues, and follow through after release
* Coordinate with adjacent teams, including DBX, when your work depends on driver, platform, or product capability, and escalate cross\-team dependencies and risks early rather than working around them
* Collaborate with product management, product design, and other partners to understand what users need from an integration and how your work connects to the team's objectives
* Write clear documentation, give useful code reviews, share what you know with teammates, and follow through on your commitments
* Develop specialized knowledge of the Python or TypeScript AI builder ecosystems — frameworks, agent and retrieval patterns, vector search — and bring interesting developments back to the team


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience building backend systems, libraries, or other developer\-facing software, with solid proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript
* Experience designing, writing, testing, and debugging software in a shared, long\-lived code base, with an eye for the tests and documentation that make it maintainable
* Track record of delivering scoped projects reliably and on time, with growing independence and good judgment about when to ask for help
* Demonstrated ability to work on several projects at once and keep quality and commitments intact as priorities shift
* Clear interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, or vector search
* Solid verbal and written technical communication, including the ability to write things down clearly for teammates and partners you won't always overlap with in real time
* Enjoys collaboration and being part of a close\-knit team; is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest
* Eager to learn, with a strong technical foundation and an interest in deepening it


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Open source contributions, especially any work that landed in a repository you don't own
* Experience building AI or framework integrations, MCP servers, agent skills, or plugins for agentic applications, professionally or as side projects
* Familiarity with the agentic AI tooling ecosystem (AI IDEs, CLIs, and assistants) and how developers integrate with it
* Experience with CI/CD and automated testing for libraries that support multiple versions or platforms
* Experience working with databases; familiarity with MongoDB query patterns
* Exposure to vector search, embedding pipelines, or index management
* Working knowledge of Java, Go, C\#, or Rust
* Experience with containerization tools (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and with AI frameworks and libraries
* Familiarity with Jira and related tools


 Success measures
   

  

* In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, how our integrations are structured, where the relevant repositories and pipelines live, and how we build, test, and release. You'll have landed your first code contribution and know who to ask when you're blocked
* In three months, you will be delivering scoped work on one or more integrations with growing independence, will have landed an upstream contribution, and will be comfortable running the team's testing and release process for your own changes
* In six months, you will own a well\-defined area or project end to end, deliver against quarterly objectives with limited oversight, and have made at least one concrete improvement to the quality or efficiency of how the team works
* In twelve months, you will be a dependable owner of a piece of the portfolio, will have delivered multiple meaningful features or integrations, will be handling upstream and customer issues in your area with confidence, and will be helping teammates get up to speed on what you know best


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI\-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: ASIC Engineer, Design
description:
The Infra\-Silicon team at Meta designs and develops custom Application\-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASICs) that power Meta's data center infrastructure. These domain\-specific chips are purpose\-built to accelerate computationally intensive workloads, including AI inference, video processing, and networking at scale. In this role, you will contribute to the full front\-end design lifecycle of next\-generation silicon, from microarchitecture definition through RTL implementation and handoff to physical design teams, working closely with architecture, verification, and implementation engineers to deliver high\-performance, power\-efficient silicon solutions.
   

  

 ASIC Engineer, Design Responsibilities:
   

  

* Develop and refine micro\-architecture specifications for complex digital logic blocks including control paths, data paths, and interconnects
* Implement RTL designs in Verilog or SystemVerilog based on micro\-architecture specifications and design requirements
* Collaborate with verification engineers to review test plans, coverage results, and debug functional failures at the block and chip level
* Partner with physical design and implementation teams to resolve timing, area, and power closure issues through RTL and constraint refinement
* Identify, evaluate, and integrate soft and hard IP components into the SoC design flow
* Participate in design reviews and contribute to micro\-architecture documentation and specification updates
* Support emulation and prototyping efforts to enable early software bring\-up and system\-level validation
* Analyze power consumption and contribute to low\-power design techniques such as clock gating and power domain partitioning
* Collaborate with architecture teams to translate algorithmic requirements into implementable hardware micro\-architectures


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 2\+ years of experience in digital ASIC or SoC front\-end design
* Experience in one of these skills: Micro\-architecture and RTL development for complex control/data path and networking IPs (Intellectual Properties), OR Experience in SoC (System on Chip) Micro\-architecture, Design and Integration, OR Implementation, Power methodology development
* Experience with RTL coding using Verilog or SystemVerilog


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Experience with lint, CDC, RDC analysis and flows
* Knowledge and hands\-on experience with AMBA\-AXI, PCIe or networking protocols
* Experience with synthesis, static timing analysis, and timing closure methodologies
* Experience collaborating with verification or physical design teams during the silicon development cycle
* Experience designing data path or memory subsystem logic for AI, networking, or video processing workloads


 About Meta:
   

  

 Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology.  Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

**Software Development Engineer 2 – Fulfilment** 




**About Urban Company** 




 Urban Company is Asia's largest tech\-enabled home services marketplace, operating across India, UAE, Singapore, and Saudi Arabia. Customers use our platform to book a wide range of services — beauty and grooming, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, and more — delivered at home, at a time of their choosing. Behind this simple promise sits a deep technology stack that matches millions of customers with trained, background\-verified service partners while guaranteeing a standardised, high\-quality, and reliable experience every single time.
 



  





**About the Fulfilment Team** 




 The Fulfilment team sits at the heart of Urban Company's marketplace — we make sure every customer gets the right service, from the right partner, at the right time. We do this through three core charters:
 



  





 \- Planning \& Shaping: Efficiently planning supply to meet forecasted customer demand, and intelligently shaping that demand to meet business goals.
 



 \- Capacity Management: Managing partner time and computing real\-time availability of UC services for any given time slot, customer location, business category, and skill requirement.
 



 \- Allocation \& Recovery: Assigning the most suitable partner for each job while maintaining fairness in partner earnings, and protecting customer experience in cases of no\-shows, cancellations, or partner unavailability.
 



 These are classic marketplace optimization problems — forecasting, matching, scheduling, and real\-time recovery — solved at the scale of millions of monthly service requests.
 



  





**Job Description: SDE\-2** 




 We are looking for experienced Software Development Engineers (SDE\-2\) to join our Fulfilment team. You will work on complex, high\-impact engineering challenges — the systems you build directly determine whether a customer's booking is fulfilled seamlessly and whether a partner earns fairly. If you enjoy problems that blend distributed systems, optimization, and real\-world operational constraints, this is the team for you.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 \- Design and build scalable, high\-performance, fault\-tolerant systems and services that power supply planning, capacity, and allocation.
 



 \- Develop and optimize intelligent algorithms and ML/AI\-driven solutions for demand forecasting, capacity planning, and partner–job matching.
 



 \- Own features end\-to\-end — from ideation and design to deployment, monitoring, and iteration across a modern tech stack.
 



 \- Raise the bar on the team's engineering practices: code quality, system architecture, observability, and operational excellence.
 



 \- Collaborate cross\-functionally with Product, Analytics, and Data Science teams to translate business problems into robust technical solutions.
 



  





**What Are We Looking For?** 




 \- Experience: 2–3 years of experience building large\-scale backend applications or Products.
 



 \-Technical Strength: Strong foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms, OS, Networks, and Database fundamentals, with a good understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, caching, and scalable architectures.
 



 \- Backend Skills: Proficiency in at least one backend language (Node.js, Java, Go, or Python). Experience with databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and messaging systems like Kafka is a plus; exposure to cloud platforms and production observability is desirable.
 



 \- AI Fluency: Hands\-on experience leveraging AI in day\-to\-day engineering — using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to ship faster, and/or building with LLMs, ML models, or intelligent automation in production systems. Curiosity to apply.
 



 \- AI to real marketplace problems is a strong plus.
 



 \- Mindset: Bias for action, end\-to\-end ownership, and comfort with ambiguity.
 



 \- Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 \- Work on marketplace\-scale optimisation problems that few companies in the region get to solve.
 



 \- High ownership from day one — your systems ship to millions of users.
 



 \- A culture that rewards initiative, craftsmanship, and first\-principles thinking.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**NEOLYTIX**
**Full Stack Developer**
 Product \& Engineering \| UK Shift \| Gurugram
 **DEPARTMENT**
**Product \& EngineeringEXPERIENCE**
**1–2 Years** 
**LOCATION**
**Gurugram (Onsite)** 
**SHIFT**
**UK Shift (1:30–10:30 PM, Flexible)** 
**⚠ UK Shift: This role operates on a UK\-aligned schedule, 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM IST, with flexibility based on project requirements and team overlap needs. Consistent availability within this window is essential. Please apply only if you are comfortable with this commitment.** 
**⚠ Non\-Negotiable: BTech / BCA / MCA with a live project component during graduation is mandatory. Your GitHub profile will be reviewed before your screening call. Profiles without genuine, deployed public projects will not advance, regardless of experience or education.**
**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Full Stack Developer to join an existing, senior\-led product and engineering team at Neolytix. This is a full\-time role, not an internship. You will work on live products used by healthcare providers across the US, collaborating daily with a Product Owner, senior developers, and cross\-functional stakeholders on UK\-aligned working hours that also overlap with the US.
   

  

 The technical bar here is real. We are looking for someone who has shipped code, not just studied it. Your GitHub profile will tell us more about you than your resume will. If your repos show consistent commits, genuine project depth, and code you'd stand behind, you will stand out. If they are empty or filled with tutorial clones, you won't.
   

  

 The core stack is Node.js, Python, SQL, and Docker. Frontend exposure in React or Next.js is needed. You will work across the full cycle: designing, building, testing, and deploying. You will participate in code reviews, work within CI/CD pipelines, and write code that will be flagged by SonarQube and Copilot. That is not a threat; it is the standard of the team you are joining.
   

  

**What You'll Build** 
**2\. Frontend Development** 
**3\. Database \& Data Management** 
**4\. DevOps \& Deployment** 
**5\. Code Quality \& Collaboration**
* Backend Development
* Build and maintain server\-side applications and REST APIs using Node.js, NestJS, and Express.js
* Write Python scripts and services for automation, data handling, and backend logic
* Integrate third\-party APIs and external services cleanly and reliably
* Ensure backend code is tested, documented, and production\-ready before it ships
* Develop responsive, user\-facing interfaces using React and Next.js
* Collaborate with the team on UI/UX decisions and implement them with clean, maintainable component structures
* Ensure frontend and backend are tightly integrated and behave consistently in production
* Design and work with relational and non\-relational databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB
* Write efficient SQL queries and apply core DBMS principles to schema design and data handling
* Handle data migration, indexing, and query optimization as the product scales
* Containerize applications using Docker and deploy to Azure environments
* Work within and contribute to CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable, repeatable deployments
* Maintain awareness of deployment health and flag risks before they reach production
* Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving feedback constructively
* Work within SonarQube and GitHub Copilot review workflows as standard practice
* Write clear documentation for your code, APIs, and architectural decisions
* Communicate proactively on blockers, progress, and handoffs in an async, cross\-timezone team environment


**What You Bring**
**Must\-Have**
* BTech / BCA / MCA degree with a live project component during graduation. Non\-negotiable
* 1 to 2 years of full\-time experience, or an in\-depth internship with real delivery ownership across the stack (not shadow work or tutorial projects)
* Hands\-on Node.js: you have built backend services, not just read the docs
* Python: working knowledge for scripting, automation, or backend services
* Core DBMS and SQL: schema design, query writing, joins, indexing basics
* Docker: containerization fundamentals and working knowledge of container\-based deployments
* Git: disciplined commit history, branching, and PR\-based workflow
* Public GitHub profile with genuine, deployed projects. This is reviewed before the screening call
* AI\-assisted development tools: working knowledge of GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent as part of your daily coding workflow. This is standard practice on the team, not a bonus skill
* Claude Code: hands\-on familiarity with Claude Code as an agentic coding assistant. Used on this team for autonomous code generation, refactoring, writing and running tests, debugging complex issues, and scaffolding new features. If you have not used it, you should know what it is and be ready to adopt it from day one
* Prompt engineering fundamentals: ability to write structured, effective prompts for code generation, debugging assistance, and feature development. You know how to get useful output, not just any output


**Strong Preference**
* NestJS and Express.js for backend service development
* React and Next.js for frontend development
* PostgreSQL or MySQL as a primary relational database
* Experience with third\-party API integration (payment gateways, CRMs, communication platforms, etc.)
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and Azure deployment environments


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* SonarQube familiarity and experience working within automated code quality pipelines
* LinearB familiarity
* Cross\-platform mobile development (React Native or Flutter)
* Cloud platform exposure: AWS or Firebase
* DevOps tooling: Blob storage, Prometheus, or Grafana


**Who You Are**
* Async\-first communicator. You write clearly, document blockers before being asked, and don't go dark on a cross\-timezone team
* Code owner, not task completer. You push code you would be proud of in production, not code that just passes the sprint board
* Feedback\-forward. SonarQube flags and Copilot review comments are part of your workflow, not a judgment on you
* Builder with proof. Your GitHub shows consistent work over time, projects that actually run, and code that reflects learning. Not one\-commit repos from a bootcamp
* Curious over defensive. You ask good questions and admit what you don't know. In a senior\-mentored team, that compounds faster than pretending


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Education: BTech / BCA / MCA with live project experience during graduation is mandatory. Degrees without a project component or from programmes that didn't require hands\-on delivery will not be considered
* GitHub: A public GitHub profile with genuine, deployed projects is required before your screening call. Repos with one commit, empty ReadMEs, or only tutorial clones will not count. We look at commit history, not just code volume
* LinkedIn: Your profile should be current, accurate, and professional. It will be reviewed alongside your GitHub before screening
* Shift Commitment: UK\-aligned shift, 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM IST, with flexibility based on project needs and team overlap. Comfortable availability within this window is required
* Notice Period: Immediate to 30 days preferred. Longer notices considered only for a strong match


**Performance Expectations (KPIs)**
 In the first 90 days, you will be measured on:
   

  

* Ramp time: actively contributing to sprint tasks within the first 30 days, independently owning features by day 60
* Code quality: SonarQube and Copilot review pass rates trending cleanly within 60 days
* Sprint delivery: features and fixes shipped on time with documented, reviewable code
* Bug rate: low defect density in code pushed to staging and production
* Communication quality: async updates, blockers flagged proactively, no chasing required
* PR hygiene: clean pull requests with meaningful descriptions and responsive turnaround on review feedback


**Hiring Process**
* Stage 1: Talent Management screening, GitHub profile review, and LinkedIn review. Profiles without a public GitHub will not progress
* Stage 2: Technical assessment. This is skills\-heavy with real\-world simulations, not MCQs. Expect coding tasks that reflect the actual stack and problems you will encounter on the job
* Stage 3: Technical interview with the Product Owner and a senior developer from the team, covering your assessment output, your GitHub projects, and your approach to building and debugging
* Stage 4: Final discussion and offer


**Why Join Neolytix**
**Real Work from Day 1**
 You join a live product team and own real features from the start, not shadow tasks or mock projects.
 **Senior Mentorship**
 Work directly with experienced developers and a Product Owner in a structured, code\-review\-driven environment.
 **International Exposure**
 UK\-aligned shift with US overlap means you work with global stakeholders and build communication habits that will carry through your career.
 **Competitive Package**
 Compensation benchmarked for a 1 to 2 year profile in Delhi NCR, with a clear path to scope expansion based on delivery.
   

  

*Questions? Reach out to Lakshay at Neolytix Talent Management \| This document is confidential and for internal use only*

Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design\-Trade\-off\-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
   

  

 Beeinflusst die Qualität der eigenen Arbeit und der Arbeit anderer im Team.Führt betriebliche/technische Standardaufgaben aus, die in der Regel Anweisungen und Arbeitsabläufen unterliegen.Möglicherweise besteht Spielraum, um die Reihenfolge zu ändern und Aufgaben/Pflichten basierend auf sich ändernden Arbeitssituationen zu erledigen.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Identifizieren, entwickeln, bewerten, führen ein und verwalten Engineering\-Lösungen für die Anforderungen der Produkt\- und Steuerungssystemtechnologie. Wenden die Steuerungstheorie und mathematische Modellierung auf Entwurfs\- und Steuerungssysteme mit dem gewünschten Verhalten an. Beinhaltet Bedienbarkeit, Festlegen von Grenzen, Zyklusoptimierung, Steuerlogik, steuerungsbezogene Software, Sensoren, Hardware\- und Softwarealgorithmen sowie Feedback zur Steuerung der Leistung von Geräten, Subsystemen und Systemen.
* Erweiterung der Kenntnisse der eigenen technischen Disziplin zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.Kann Support\-Rollen mit spezialisiertem technischem Wissensgebiet beinhalten; laufender Erwerb von Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten auf höherem Niveau.
* Grundlegendes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Gute Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Kann eine gewisse Autonomie besitzen, um Entscheidungen innerhalb eines definierten Rahmens zu treffen.Löst Probleme in Situationen, in denen gute technische Kenntnisse und Urteilsvermögen im Rahmen festgelegter Verfahren erforderlich sind.Konsultiert hochrangigere Teammitglieder zu Problemen außerhalb definierter Anweisungen/Parameter.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
Associate Product Manager
 



 Ionic Wealth (by Angel One)
 



 Own the products. Find the problems. Build the fix yourself.
 



 Location: Mumbai (in\-office) · Experience: 0–2 years · Team: Product
 



 About Ionic Wealth
 



 Ionic Wealth (by Angel One) is an AI\-powered wealth management platform for High Net Worth Individuals
 



 and the Relationship Managers who serve them. Clients get a unified view of their entire portfolio: mutual
 



 funds, stocks, bonds, AIFs, PMS, unlisted with AI\-driven insights and advisory. RMs run their entire book on
 



 STORM, our in\-house CRM. We're a small, fast team building an AI\-native product from the ground up.
 



 The Role
 



 This is not a blank\-page PM role and it's not a documentation role either.
 



 You will take end\-to\-end ownership of live products that real clients and RMs use every day:
 



 • STORM: our all\-in\-one RM platform, not just a CRM: inbuilt CRM (leads, client book, tasks, meetings),
 



 user analytics, transaction capability, and an AI agent that works alongside the RM.
 



 • The client app : the highest\-impact surfaces of the Ionic Wealth experience: AI\-powered portfolio
 



 insights, exclusive product offerings (PMS, AIFs, unlisted/pre\-IPO), Ionic Wealth AI (our conversational
 



 AI advisor), plus portfolio dashboards, mutual fund onboarding, and transactions.
 



 These products work, but they're far from done. Your job is to find what's broken, confusing, or
 



 underperforming and fix it.
 



 We work differently from most product teams. Here, PMs build before they write. When you have an idea,
 



 you don't open a doc you open an AI tool and build a working prototype. You walk into the design and
 



 engineering conversation with something clickable, not a 10\-page PRD.
 



 What You'll Do
 



 • Own your surfaces. Be the person accountable for STORM and client\-app modules \- their quality, their
 



 metrics, their roadmap.
 



 • Find the problems yourself. Shadow RMs, talk to clients, dig through analytics and funnel data, read
 



 support tickets, use the product daily. Build and ruthlessly prioritize a problem backlog.
 



 • Prototype, don't just spec. Use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, v0, Lovable, Figma, Make whatever gets
 



 you there) to build working POCs of your proposed fixes and features yourself. Bring a demo to the
 



 discussion, not a slide.
 



 • Ship fixes and enhancements. Work with engineering and design from prototype to production. Keep
 



 specs lean, just enough for the team to build the real thing from your POC.
 



 • Measure and iterate. Define success metrics for everything you ship, track them, and go again when
 



 the data says you're wrong.
 



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 • A builder's instinct. You'd rather spend two hours prototyping than two hours writing. You've already
 



 built things with AI coding tools — side projects, hackathon demos, internal tools — and can show us.
 



 • Ownership mindset. You treat the product like it's yours: you notice what's broken without being told,
 



 and you can't leave it alone.
 



 • Sharp problem diagnosis. You separate symptoms from root causes and can defend your prioritization
 



 with data.
 



 • Comfort with data. You can pull your own numbers. SQL or a strong willingness to learn it fast.
 



 • 0–2 years of experience in product, engineering, design, analytics, or a strong portfolio of things you've
 



 shipped on your own. Fresh graduates who build are very welcome.
 



 Nice to Have
 



 • Exposure to fintech, wealth management, or capital markets
 



 • Experience working with or building on LLMs / AI agents
 



 • Basic familiarity with how modern web apps are put together (APIs, frontend/backend split)
 



 Why Join
 



 • Real ownership on day one. Junior doesn't mean sidelined, you own live surfaces with real users from
 



 your first month.
 



 • An AI\-native product org. We use AI tools across the stack; you'll be expected — and enabled — to do
 



 the same.
 



 • Small team, short loops. Your prototype can be in front of leadership the same week you build it.
 



 • HNI wealth\-tech is exploding in India. You'll learn the domain from the inside, fast.
 



 To apply, send your resume — and even better, a link to something you've built.

title: Product Manager I
description:
Swiggy is India’s leading on\-demand delivery platform with a tech\-first approach to logistics and a solution\-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 700\+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, and a 2 lakh\+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Title: Product Manager I (B2C)
   

  

 Experience: 2\-4 Years
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru\- Hybrid**
**About The Role**
 Swiggy is looking for a Product Manager I to own critical parts of the post\-order customer and delivery experience. This role sits at the intersection of customer experience, support, delivery reliability, and product platform, and will drive high\-impact journeys across track screen, customer communication, delivery partner\-customer interaction, and support\-linked product surfaces.
   

  

 You will work on some of the most visible and operationally important moments in the order journey \- when customers are anxious, plans change, delivery issues surface, or the product needs to proactively guide users toward the right action. This role requires strong product judgment, structured problem solving, and the ability to drive cross\-functional execution across engineering, design, analytics, support, operations, and platform teams.
   

  

**What will you get to do here?**
* Own end\-to\-end product strategy and execution for key post\-order and support\-linked customer journeys.
* Drive product development across areas such as : track screen experience, delivery partner \- consumer communication surfaces, address and contactability improvements, support\-linked nudges, and proactive customer communication and more
* Define the next generation of customer\-facing experiences in critical moments such as delays, address issues, payment friction, delivery exceptions, and service recovery.
* Break ambiguous problem spaces into clear milestones, PRDs, experiments, and execution plans.
* Make product architecture and surface\-level decisions across app, bot, WhatsApp, support, and related experience layers.
* Partner closely with engineering and design to ship high\-quality, scalable, and reliable product experiences.
* Work with analytics to define success metrics, identify pain points, and use data to drive prioritization and iteration.
* Collaborate with support, ops, and business teams to ensure what is built works in the real world and improves both experience and efficiency.
* Lead rollout planning, edge\-case reviews, and quality trade\-offs for high\-visibility launches.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Customers get clearer, faster, and more intuitive help in high\-stress post\-order moments.
* Track screen and communication surfaces become more proactive, contextual, and action\-oriented \- Managing consumer anxiety and building consumer trust.
* Product decisions balance user experience, operational feasibility, support behavior, and cost.
* Complex initiatives are broken down and shipped with strong milestone discipline and cross\-functional alignment.
* Support\-linked product journeys see measurable improvements in resolution quality, experience, and operational efficiency.
* High\-priority roadmap initiatives are executed with speed, quality, and clear business impact.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 2\-4 years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of consumer facing products, logistics, support, or operations\-heavy products.
* Strong product sense and execution ability: able to take ambiguous problems, define the right approach, and drive them through to launch.
* Experience working on high\-scale customer\-facing journeys with multiple stakeholders and operational dependencies.
* Ability to make clear trade\-offs across UX, business impact, technical complexity, support behavior, and cost.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across engineering, design, analytics, support, operations, and business teams.
* Comfort working across multiple product surfaces rather than optimizing only a single screen or workflow.
* Analytical thinking and familiarity with metrics, funnels, experimentation, and structured problem diagnosis.
* High ownership, bias for action, and comfort operating in fast\-moving environments.
* Prior experience in post\-order, support, chat, communication, or delivery/logistics journeys is a strong plus


**Additional Information**
**We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.**

title: Product Manager
description:
**Role: Product Manager** 




**Location: Bangalore, India** 




**Job type: Full Time, Permanent** 




  





**Why QS?** 




  





 At QS, we believe that work should empower you. That’s why we foster a flexible working environment that encourages every employee to own their career whilst flourishing personally and professionally. Our company values underpin everything we do – we collaborate, respect and support each other.
 



 It’s our mission to empower motivated people around the world to fulfil their potential through higher education, ensuring that everyone has access to opportunities that change lives.
 



 Our diversity makes us stronger. By sharing our experiences, we learn from one another and achieve more together, making progress across the sector.
 



  





 At QS, you’ll be responsible for implementing real changes in the international higher education landscape. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that see a positive impact across the business and the wider sector.
 



  





 We’re confident you’ll feel right at home here. QS was named as one of Newsweek’s Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® in the UK (October 2023\), recognizing the respect, trust and appreciation that drive our culture every day. And as a gold\-accredited Investors in People organization – putting us among the top 28% of workplaces globally – it’s official: QS is a place where everyone can thrive.
 



  





**As a Product Manager this is what you’ll be doing:** 




  





 QS is seeking a Product Manager, Digital Experience, to help shape how students discover, engage with and navigate the TopUniversities ecosystem.
 



 Reporting to the Senior Product Manager, Digital Experience, you will own and deliver product initiatives that improve discovery, engagement, identity and career intelligence experiences across the student journey. Working closely with Engineering, UX, Data, Marketing and Commercial teams, you will identify customer problems, validate opportunities and deliver solutions that increase engagement, profile growth, personalisation and progression.
 



 The Digital Product Team is leading the evolution of the QS TopUniversities ecosystem, transforming how students discover, evaluate and pursue higher education opportunities around the world.
 



 Historically, our platforms have helped millions of students access trusted rankings, university information and guidance. Today, we are building a more connected ecosystem that combines discovery, identity, personalisation, career intelligence and decision support to help students make more informed choices about their future.
 



 As part of this transformation, we are evolving from a collection of digital experiences into an integrated product ecosystem that creates value for students throughout their decision\-making journey while delivering stronger engagement, higher\-quality demand and improved outcomes for university partners.
 



 You will contribute to the evolution of QS TopUniversities, helping students move seamlessly from exploration and discovery through to informed decision\-making. Success is measured through engagement, known\-user growth, profile completion, journey progression and contribution to business outcomes.
 


* Deliver product initiatives that improve student discovery, engagement and progression across the TopUniversities ecosystem.
* Use experimentation, customer insight and data to identify opportunities and drive measurable improvements.
* Contribute to personalisation, recommendation and career intelligence experiences that improve decision confidence.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver connected experiences that create value for students and university partners



  





**Role responsibilities** 




  





**Product strategy and delivery** 



* Deliver product initiatives aligned to the Digital Experience roadmap and strategic objectives.
* Translate roadmap priorities into clear backlog items, user stories and delivery plans.
* Design and optimise experiences that help students discover relevant universities, programmes, content and opportunities.
* Improve registration, onboarding and profile completion journeys to increase engagement and known\-user growth.
* Support the development of connected experiences across the QS TopUniversities ecosystem.



**Discovery, engagement and career intelligence** 



* Treat discovery, relevance and student guidance as core product capabilities.
* Improve how students explore education pathways, university choices and future career opportunities.
* Contribute to personalisation, recommendation and career intelligence experiences that connect student interests, aspirations and behaviours with relevant opportunities.
* Use behavioural, profile and intent signals to improve relevance, engagement and decision confidence.
* Support initiatives that help students better understand the relationship between education choices and career outcomes.



**Experimentation and analytics** 



* Define and run experiments across anonymous and logged\-in experiences.
* Use behavioural, cohort and funnel data to identify opportunities and measure impact.
* Define success metrics and track performance against agreed objectives.
* Partner with Data and Engineering teams to ensure key journeys are correctly instrumented and measurable.
* Apply insights and learnings to continuously improve engagement and progression outcomes.



**Cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management** 



* Partner closely with Product, UX, Engineering, Data, CRM/Lifecycle, Content, SEO and Marketing teams.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders across global and regional teams.
* Communicate priorities, progress and outcomes clearly and effectively.
* Contribute to roadmap planning and product strategy discussions within the Digital Product Team.



**Other** 



* Support broader product initiatives across the TopUniversities ecosystem.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of product management practices.
* Any other duties that fall within the purpose and scope of the role
 **.**



  





**Success milestones** 



* *3 months:* 
 Build a strong understanding of students, products, key metrics and strategic priorities; identify opportunities and contribute to roadmap planning.
* *6 months:* 
 Deliver product improvements that increase engagement, profile growth or journey progression; establish a regular experimentation and learning cadence.
* *12 months* 
 : Deliver sustained improvements in engagement, known\-user growth and personalisation; contribute to career intelligence capabilities and demonstrate measurable impact on student and business outcomes



  





**Key skills and experience** 




  




* Proven experience delivering customer\-facing digital products within cross\-functional teams.
* Strong product discovery skills, including customer research, problem definition and opportunity validation.
* Experience using qualitative and quantitative data to inform product decisions and prioritisation.
* Experience managing product backlogs, defining requirements and working within Agile delivery environments.
* Understanding of engagement, activation, onboarding or customer journey optimisation.

title: Technical Product Manager (Japanese/English) - CS & Trust & Safety
description:
Introduction
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Technical Product Manager** 
 to own product strategy and measurable outcomes for the tools and workflows that power
 **Customer Support (CS) and Trust \& Safety (TnS)** 
 for
 **Mercari.**
 You will identify high\-impact problems, create the roadmap, write clear product requirements, manage delivery, and measure results. This role requires strong product judgment, practical use of data and AI, and the ability to bridge Japan\-based stakeholders and the India engineering team in
 **Japanese and English.**
**About Us**
 Mercari is a Japan\-based C2C marketplace company founded in 2013 with the mission to "Create value in a global marketplace where anyone can buy \& sell." From being the first tech unicorn from Japan before its IPO in 2018 we have come a long way towards becoming a global player and continuously and diligently work towards our transformation journey with a strong focus on our mission.
   

  

 Since its inception, Mercari Group has worked to grow its services, investing in both our people and technology. Over time Mercari has expanded from being the top player in the C2C marketplace in Japan to new geographies like the U.S. We have also successfully launched new businesses such as Merpay, which is a mobile payment service platform with a vision to create a society where anyone can realize their dreams through a new ecosystem centered not only on payment service but also on credit. Today, Mercari Group is made up of multiple subsidiary businesses including logistics, B2C platform, blockchain, and sports team management.
   

  

 For our services to be utilized by people worldwide; however, there is still a mountain of work ahead of us. This endeavor naturally requires the capability of the best talent and minds, and that is exactly the reason for us to launch the India Center of Excellence. With your help, we will continue to take on the world stage and strive to grow into a successful global tech company.
   

  

**About Mercari India**
 Established in Bengaluru in 2022, Mercari India serves as a crucial technology hub for the Mercari Group. Leveraging the rich and diverse tech talent in India, we primarily collaborate closely with our development hub in Japan to drive engineering development for Mercari's applications. Having grown to an organization of approximately 100\+ members over about Four years since its inception, Mercari India aims to evolve into an even stronger engineering organization that spearheads technological innovation for the entire group. This will be achieved by further enhancing our engineering capabilities and promoting AI initiatives that reflect India's cutting\-edge technology and knowledge.
   

  

**Our Culture**
 To achieve our mission at Mercari, our organisation and each of our employees share the same values and perspectives.
   

  

 Our individual guidelines for action are defined by our four values:
   

  

* Go Bold
* All for One
* Be a Pro
* Move Fast


 Our organisation is also shaped by our four foundations:
   

  

* Sustainability
* Diversity \& Inclusion
* Trust \& Openness
* Well\-being for Performance


 Regardless of how big Mercari gets, the culture will remain essential to achieving our mission and something we want to preserve throughout our organisation.
   

  

 We invite you to read the "Mercari Culture Doc," which summarizes the behaviours and mindset shared by Mercari and its employees. We continue to build an environment where all of our members of diverse backgrounds are accepted and recognised, and where they can thrive while holding dear to Mercari's culture.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Work Responsibilities
   

  

**Own Product Strategy and Outcomes**
* Define the product vision, roadmap, priorities, and measurable outcomes for CS and TnS
* Identify opportunities using customer feedback, operational insights, and data
* Define success metrics, baselines, guardrails, and post\-launch measurement plans
* Balance customer experience, operational efficiency, risk, and business priorities


**Lead Discovery and Delivery**
* Write clear PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and launch plans
* Translate operational and stakeholder needs into clear priorities for engineering
* Manage projects from discovery through development, rollout, adoption, and iteration
* Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and decisions across teams


**Improve CS and TnS Products**
* Build tools and workflows that improve support quality, resolution speed, and operational productivity
* Improve user reports, escalations, moderation, case management, and enforcement experiences
* Identify opportunities for workflow simplification and automation while preserving appropriate human judgment
* Partner with CS, TnS, engineering, data, ML, policy, and business teams to deliver measurable impact


**Use AI and Connect Japan and India**
* Use AI to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, prototyping, and product workflows
* Lead discussions and create clear product documentation in Japanese and English
* Build shared context and align Japan\-based stakeholders with the India engineering team


 Bold Challenges
   

  

 The role balances customer experience, operational efficiency, marketplace risk, and business priorities while improving the tools and workflows used by CS and TnS teams. Success requires identifying high\-impact problems, aligning Japan\-based stakeholders and the India engineering team, and turning ambiguous operational needs into measurable product outcomes.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* 3\+ years of professional experience in product management or a related field, with hands\-on experience delivering digital products
* Japanese proficiency equivalent to JLPT N3 or above, with strong conversational ability to lead discussions with Japan\-based stakeholders. Practical communication skills are more important than certification alone
* Experience owning product work from discovery and roadmap creation through launch and measurement
* Ability to define measurable outcomes and make decisions using qualitative and quantitative data
* Experience creating roadmaps and PRDs and managing cross\-functional projects
* Working knowledge of SQL or comparable analytical tools
* Practical experience using AI tools in product work
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and operations teams


**Preferred Requirements**

* Exposure to customer support, internal tools, operational workflows, Trust \& Safety, risk, or compliance
* Familiarity with experimentation, workflow automation, or AI\-enabled products
* Experience working in distributed or multicultural teams


**Benefits**
 Working Conditions
   

  

* Employment Status: Full\-time
* Office: Bengaluru
* Hybrid workstyle
+ We believe in high performance and professionalism. We work from the office for 2 days/week and work from home 3 days/week
+ To build a strong \& highly\-engaged organization in India, we highly encourage everyone to work from our Bengaluru office, especially during the initial office setup phase
+ We will continue to review and update the policy to address future organizational needs


 Media

title: Product Owner/Business Analyst (Hybrid)
description:
**About Team**
 RX Global aims to create unforgettable experiences for attendees and exhibitors through organizing events. Innovation, creativity, and collaboration drive the company to offer exceptional services to clients.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Product Owner/Business Analyst is a hands on, outcome focused product role within RX’s At Show Products group within the Digital Products portfolio.
   

  

 Working in close partnership with Senior Product Managers based in the UK, the Product Manager II operates within defined problem and solution spaces, contributing strong problem understanding, creative challenge, prioritisation support, and delivery phase judgement. The role focuses on execution quality, customer outcomes, implementation expertise, and facilitating learning.
   

  

 Success in this role comes from caring deeply about whether products actually work for customers in live environments — and acting decisively when they don’t.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Customer \& Problem Understanding**
* Build a deep, first‑hand understanding of customer needs, behaviours, and constraints in trade show usage contexts.
* Represent customer and business context within the delivery team.
* Frame problems clearly and test assumptions using both qualitative insight and quantitative data.


**Product Delivery \& Execution**
* Partner with engineering, design, delivery management and data analytics to enable effective delivery within agreed scope and constraints.
* Provide sufficient context, clarity, and specification to unblock teams and sustain momentum.
* Make pragmatic trade‑offs and decisions during delivery, balancing value, feasibility, reliability, and time.


**Partnership with Senior Product Managers**
* Work closely with UK‑based Senior Product Managers as an execution partner and an SME who can constructively challenge solutions.
* Carry delivery realities, technology options, customer insight, and learning into roadmap and prioritisation discussions.
* Support the successful execution and monitoring of agreed product and technology work.


**Validation, Learning \& Reliability**
* Validate product hypotheses through appropriate data, experimentation, and real‑world feedback.
* Monitor product behaviour in live show conditions, identifying reliability or adoption issues early.
* Feed learning back into iterative improvement and prioritisation cycles.


**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**
* Collaborate effectively with commercial, product success, marketing, and sales teams to support adoption and operability.
* Contribute to coordinated releases and dependency management where user journeys span multiple teams.
* Lead product demos or reviews at key milestones, clearly articulating outcomes, trade‑offs, and learning.


**This Role Is**
**What This Role Is — and Is Not**
* Strongly delivery‑ and outcome‑oriented — get stuff done
* Focused on idea validation, execution quality, local leadership, and reliable value creation
* A critical, high\-trust partnering role to senior product leadership
* Part of the core product team and integral to the RX India team creating impact
* Important to negotiating cross\-team dependencies at the delivery level


**This Role Is NOT**
* Responsible for “what and why” at the level of commissioning new products and features
* Responsible for product vision or product strategy
* Required to invest much time beyond in backlog administration


**Requirements**
**Requirements and Backlog**
* Define and prioritise a value\-based product backlog, including functional features and (with the Tech Lead) technical and compliance items
* Elicit and document business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Ensure stories are well\-defined, appropriately sized, and sprint\-ready
* Drive the solution within boundaries shaped by the PM — making active trade\-offs on what gets built
* Elicit and define specifications for implementation with enough detail for the team to move forward


**Business Analysis**
* Identify assumptions, dependencies, edge cases, and operational impacts
* Distinguish documented fact from assumption and inference
* Create process maps and requirements documentation that are testable and traceable
* Provide clarification and handle requirements changes during sprint execution


**Communication and Stakeholder Engagement**
* Act as the primary product point of contact for the delivery team
* Facilitate the team's understanding of business context — the what and why
* Engage stakeholders to understand needs and goals, and accurately relay that input
* Keep management updated on implementation progress via sprint demos and reports
* Tailor communication to different audiences (team, PM, business stakeholders)


**Agile Delivery**
* Participate actively in planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives
* Support the Delivery Manager in ensuring value delivery against requirements
* Support release readiness activities (pre\-release support for Product Partners)
* Support the PM in discovery activities where needed


**Analytics and Data Literacy**
* Using dashboards (Mixpanel, PowerBI) to generate simple insights and inform trade\-offs
* Assessing basic data quality; connecting product work to OKRs and outcomes


**Product and Domain Knowledge**
* Become the subject matter expert (SME) \- how the product works end\-to\-end, system connections, and business value
* Respond appropriately to live event issues with suitable urgency


**Technical Awareness**
* Broad awareness of the technical architecture and platform constraints
* Ability to speak credibly with engineers about implementation boundaries


**Nice\-to\-Have**
**Discovery and Research Support**
* Applying common discovery tools (interviews, jobs\-to\-be\-done, journey mapping) to directly support the PM's discovery responsibilities
* Understanding when to seek specialist data analytics support


**Go\-to\-Market Awareness**
* Understanding how product features contribute to revenue, retention, and commercial value

* Confluence

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Servify:** 




 Servify is a global product lifecycle management platform transforming the after\-sales service experience. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in India, Servify connects leading OEM brands with their sales and service ecosystems to deliver seamless customer support and service operations. Servify partners with leading brands, retailers, distributors, insurers, service providers, and carriers across Asia, North America, Europe, and the MENA region.
 



  





 Servify embraces and values diversity and is committed to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all members and will give equal consideration to all irrespective of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief.
 



  





**Why Join Servify?** 




 At Servify, you'll be part of a fast\-growing global technology company that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. We offer competitive compensation, ESOPs, employee\-friendly policies, modern collaboration tools, professional development opportunities, and benefits that help you do your best work.
 



  





**Position Summary:** 
 We are looking for a high\-impact individual to join the Product team. We thrive on the belief that ownership is paramount. We seek those who embody the ‘will to get it done or do it myself’ attitude, a genuine willingness to take initiative, and the ability to hustle and own the product lifecycle from conception to scale.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Define and pioneer the next generation of products by connecting core business objectives with complex consumer problems.
* Drive AI/ML integration: Identify, evaluate, and embed Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning models into product features to deliver highly personalized, predictive, and intelligent user experiences.
* Quantify market white space, conduct deep qualitative and quantitative analysis, and translate these findings into a compelling product vision and an execution\-focused roadmap
* Author clear, data\-driven product specifications and relentlessly manage product execution with finesse, ensuring product definition, goals, and requirements are backed by robust data and validation
* Maintain a relentless customer focus: Deeply engage with customers and partners, and dig into data to unearth insights and 'hidden gems' that inform innovative product development.
* Serve as a critical bridge, collaborating closely with Engineering, Design, Data Analytics, Marketing, and all relevant stakeholders to flawlessly execute the product roadmap.
* Navigate complex cross\-functional challenges, proactively managing bottlenecks, making strategic trade\-offs between technical constraints and business needs, and maximizing business value while building world\-class customer experiences.
* Prioritize initiatives based on market dynamics and business impact, continuously evaluate product and feature performance against goals, and develop data\-backed recommendations for iteration and mprovement.
* Set, own, and dramatically move key performance indicators (KPIs) and meaningful metrics for product success.
* Effectively communicate product strategy, progress, and key initiatives across all levels of the organization,including preparation and presentation of executive management updates.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 3–5 years of overall experience, including 2–4 years as a Product Manager, preferably in a high\-growth B2C/B2B startup or technology\-driven organization.
* Proven experience in building, launching, and scaling consumer products, with measurable impact on key business and growth metrics.
* Strong product and technology mindset with a solid understanding of modern technology stacks and the ability to drive product vision and strategy.
* Hands\-on experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, managing high\-velocity product development and iterative releases.
* Demonstrated ability to define and execute AI\-driven product strategies, leveraging Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or Generative AI capabilities.
* Good understanding of the ML product lifecycle, including data requirements, model development, deployment, experimentation, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Ability to effectively communicate complex technical and AI/ML concepts, trade\-offs, and limitations to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong outcome\-oriented product management approach, with the ability to define success metrics, prioritize initiatives, and align cross\-functional teams toward measurable business outcomes.
* Excellent analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills, using product metrics, user insights, and experimentation to drive product improvements.
* Demonstrated entrepreneurial mindset, leadership, and stakeholder management, with experience delivering intuitive, customer\-centric products through strong communication, collaboration, and negotiation skills. (Graduate/Postgraduate qualification preferred; relevant product experience is considered more valuable than academic credentials.)

description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are seeking an enthusiastic, analytical, and resourceful Product Manager to join the Analytics and Visualization (AnV) team, based in our Hyderabad or Gurugram offices. This position offers the opportunity to drive GAI percolation and adoption across FinOp, engage with senior stakeholders, and shape how AI is leveraged within a dynamic, evolving environment. The AnV team is FinOp’s embedded data science and AI team. We work closely with FinOp teams to understand their core processes and build analytics, data science, and Generative AI (GAI) solutions that aim to improve and transform workflows.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 Your primary focus will be on driving GAI percolation and adoption across FinOp. You will regularly engage with stakeholders to understand their core processes and problems, identify where GAI can add value, and articulate these into actionable GAI projects for AnV to build. You will collaborate actively with global stakeholders to align priorities, accelerate adoption goals, and help cross\-percolate GAI ideas and successful implementations across groups. Beyond GAI, you will serve as the primary point of contact between business teams and AnV for larger projects, refining incoming project specifications, collaborating with the business to understand processes, and helping identify opportunities to add value. You will maintain a regular reporting cadence with business stakeholders on project progress and new opportunities and create opportunities to showcase the team’s capabilities.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
 The ideal candidate should hold\-
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering and a post\-graduate degree in business or finance
* 4 to 7 years of total experience, with relevant experience in product management
* Experience working with data science or analytics teams, including familiarity with translating business problems into data\-driven or AI solutions
* Robust stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage senior business stakeholders and translate their requirements into well\-scoped projects
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical and business concepts to both technical and nontechnical audiences
* The ability to be self\-motivated, result\-oriented, and creative, with excellent problem\-solving skills, exceptional analytical skills, high attention to detail, and the ability to meet tight deadlines
* Exceptional project management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously


 Preferred qualifications:
   

  

* Prior product management experience on AI products
* Practical, hands\-on fluency with Generative AI tools as a daily productivity multiplier across research, analysis, and problem solving
* Familiarity with agentic AI workflows, including defining goals for AI agents and reviewing and improving their outputs


 Interested candidates can apply through our website:
   

  

 https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PMAnaVisualizationJune26
   

  

 We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender\-neutral return\-to\-work initiative.
