title: Product@Lenskart -  HRTech & AI-Native Platform
description:
**Product Manager : HRTech \& AI\-Native Platform** 




  





**What you’ll do** 




**Discover the real problem** 



* Work directly with employees, store managers, recruiters, HR teams, business leaders and engineers.
* Absorb inputs from multiple stakeholders without treating every suggestion as a requirement.
* Separate symptoms, preferences and edge cases from the underlying problem.
* Use workflow observation, data and root\-cause analysis to understand where work actually breaks.
* Convert ambiguous business problems into clear product hypotheses and measurable outcomes.



**Build products that work in the real world** 



* Own the journey from discovery and product definition through launch, adoption and iteration.
* Write clear product requirements, user stories, process flows, data contracts and acceptance criteria.
* Design for different workforce contexts—frontline, manufacturing, corporate, Tech/Product and new markets.
* Make thoughtful build, buy, integrate, extend and retire recommendations.
* Protect the global product core while accounting for legitimate country, policy and operational differences.



**Work deeply with technology and data** 



* Collaborate closely with engineering, architecture, data, security and enterprise IT teams.
* Understand APIs, system integrations, identity, data models, events, permissions and failure scenarios.
* Use SQL, analytics tools or structured data exploration to answer product questions independently.
* Define instrumentation before launch and use evidence not anecdotes to assess outcomes.
* Challenge point\-to\-point fixes that create long\-term complexity or operational risk.
* Consider reliability, privacy, security and scalability part of the product—not post\-launch checklists.



**Make AI useful, trusted and measurable** 



* Identify problems where AI can materially improve speed, quality or cost not simply add an AI label.
* Help develop grounded assistants, intelligent workflows and automation.
* Define evaluation datasets, quality thresholds, escalation paths and human accountability.
* Measure successful task completion, outcome quality, time saved, cost per successful task and user trust.
* Stop or redesign AI use cases that do not meet quality, fairness, security or economic thresholds.



**Drive decisions and execution** 



* Prioritise ruthlessly across user pain, business value, risk, effort and strategic fit.
* Align senior stakeholders without relying on endless meetings or consensus.
* Surface trade\-offs early and communicate decisions clearly.
* Work through dependencies and operational constraints to get products shipped.
* Stay close to adoption after launch and take ownership of business outcomes—not merely feature delivery.



  





**You’ll thrive here if you** 



* Have 3–5 years of Core product management experience
* Are street\-smart and resourceful: you can make progress even when the process, ownership or data is imperfect.
* Are intellectually curious and willing to go several layers deeper than the initial request.
* Can process conflicting inputs without becoming paralysed or turning the roadmap into a stakeholder wish list.
* Have strong product judgment and know when to use research, data, first principles or a fast experiment.
* Are technically fluent enough to have meaningful conversations about APIs, data flows, integrations, identity and system reliability \& can get your hands dirty when required to build.
* Can communicate equally well with an engineer, an HR operations specialist, a store manager and a senior executive.
* Prefer solving a meaningful problem over shipping a fashionable feature.



**Technical comfort we’re looking for** 




 You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable with several of the following:
 


* REST APIs, webhooks and system integrations
* Relational data models and basic SQL
* Identity, roles and permissions
* Event\-driven workflows and automation
* Product analytics and experimentation
* AI/LLM concepts such as retrieval, evaluation, grounding and Evals
* Security, privacy and data\-residency considerations
* Enterprise platforms such as HRMS, ATS, payroll, CRM or workflow systems



**What you can expect from this role** 



* Real ownership, not backlog administration.
* Problems that sit at the intersection of people, technology and global scale.
* Space to experiment with AI, with clear expectations around evidence and responsibility.
* A high\-learning environment where curiosity, speed and depth are valued.



**A note before you apply** 




 You do not need to match every bullet. We care more about how you think, learn and operate than whether your previous job title was perfect.

title: Product Manager – DEX & Automations
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
   

  

 We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a Product Manager to take ownership of the DEX Monitoring and Automations area within TeamViewer ONE. This is a high\-impact, highly visible role at the centre of TeamViewer's Autonomous Endpoint Management (AEM) strategy — the journey from reactive IT to fully autonomous endpoint operations.
   

  

 You will own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for two equally strategic pillars: proactive digital employee experience monitoring (real\-time telemetry, DEX scoring, AI\-driven insights) and IT workflow automation (the DEX Hub automation library, Tia Scripting, SCALE instructions, and remediation workflows). Working closely with Engineering, UX, Data, Customer Success, Sales, and GTM teams, you will define clear requirements, deliver iterative value, and create measurable outcomes for both IT administrators and the employees they support.
   

  

 DEX Monitoring \& Insights
   

  

* Define and execute the product roadmap for real\-time DEX telemetry, endpoint health monitoring, and experience scoring, evolving the DEX Score to reflect true user\-centric performance during live usage.
* Drive the development of AI\-powered insights that transform raw telemetry into normalized, actionable intelligence — enabling IT teams to detect, investigate, and remediate issues before employees are impacted.
* Own the Tia Reporting capability, enabling self\-service conversational reporting and dynamic dashboards that replace static analytics with real\-time, natural\-language\-driven insights.
* Expand DEX visibility beyond the desktop by leading the strategy for DEX for Mobile (Android and iOS), Exoprise integration for network and SaaS performance monitoring, and future endpoint architecture investments.
* Define and track key experience metrics (DEX Score, MTTR, proactive issue resolution rate) and use these to continuously improve platform effectiveness and customer outcomes.


**Automations \& Workflow Orchestration**
* Own the vision and roadmap for the TeamViewer DEX Hub automation library — the centralized, single source of truth for OOTB and custom SCALE instructions, automations, and remediation workflows across the organization.
* Lead the strategy for Tia Scripting, enabling IT admins to create automations and scripts through natural language — lowering the barrier to automation creation and eliminating dependence on deep PowerShell or Bash expertise.
* Define the end\-to\-end automation lifecycle: from discovery and creation to testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement — ensuring automation is both powerful and safe for enterprise\-scale operations.
* Collaborate with Engineering and UX to design automation creation workflows that are accessible to IT generalists while remaining expressive enough for advanced users and MSPs.
* Identify and prioritize automation use cases with the highest customer impact, grounded in field data, customer interviews, and win/loss analysis.


**Cross\-Functional \& Strategic**
* Act as the product domain authority for DEX \& Automations — representing roadmap priorities to senior stakeholders, customers, and field teams, and translating strategic goals into actionable, well\-scoped requirements.
* Partner with GTM, Customer Success, and Sales to develop positioning, enablement materials, and go\-to\-market strategies that communicate the business value of DEX and automation capabilities to economic buyers (CIOs, DEX Program Owners).
* Drive customer discovery through interviews, advisory councils, and field feedback loops — continuously synthesizing market signals into roadmap decisions.
* Ensure that all roadmap items ladder to TeamViewer's AEM strategic narrative: the journey from reactive support to proactive, predictive, and ultimately autonomous endpoint management.


**Requirements**
**Must Have**
* 4\+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, preferably in endpoint management, ITSM, IT operations, or adjacent enterprise software.
* Demonstrated experience owning complex, data\-intensive product areas with strong analytical ability — comfort with telemetry, metrics\-driven roadmapping, and outcome\-based KPIs.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into well\-defined product requirements and ship iterative value in an agile environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to influence without authority and align cross\-functional stakeholders from Engineering to Executive leadership.
* Experience working in or alongside GTM, Sales, or Customer Success functions, with the ability to create compelling product positioning and enablement content.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Hands\-on familiarity with DEX platforms (e.g. 1E, Nexthink, Riverbed Aternity) or IT automation tools (e.g. Ansible, PowerShell DSC, ServiceNow Orchestration).
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to IT operations — anomaly detection, predictive analytics, GenAI for scripting or remediation.
* Experience in or exposure to the Gartner DEX Management Tools, UEM, or AEM market categories.
* Scripting literacy in PowerShell, Bash, or Python — not a hard requirement, but enables faster domain depth and more productive engineering partnerships.
* Fluency in German is a plus given the Munich location and regional customer base.

title: AI Product Manager
job_function: Information Technology, Product Management, and Strategy/Planning
description:
**About BiteSpeed**




  





 Hey there! We are a
 **Sequoia\-backed SaaS startup** 
 building an AI\-native Marketing, Support \& Sales suite for
 **e\-commerce brands.** 




  





 We're currently working with
 **3000\+ e\-commerce brands** 
 globally across 50\+ countries and are fortunate to have
 **raised $5\.5M\+** 
 along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal \& more backing us.
 



  





 💡
 **Read more about our mission and the story of commerce here!** 




  





**Check out more about us here** 
 \- https://www.bitespeed.co/ and do read through our 200\+ odd 5\-star reviews to get a sense of what our customers say about us (we openly brag about this 😉).
 



  





 We've had some solid investors back us (making it easier for you to stalk us since you'd do this anyway).
 



  





**About the Role**




  





 Enterprise customers rarely come to us with neatly packaged problems. They come with a business goal, a messy process, a bunch of systems that don't talk to each other and a question:
 **"Can AI solve this?"** 




  





 We’re looking for an
 **AI Product Manager** 
 who can sit with our enterprise customers, understand these problems deeply and turn them into
 **AI\-powered solutions** 
 . You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, operations and customer conversations, working closely with our product and engineering teams to take solutions from an idea to something that actually works.
 



  





 This isn't a traditional PM role where you'll spend your days writing PRDs and moving tickets around. You'll be expected to get into the weeds, understand how things work, figure out what can be automated or solved with AI, and work backwards from the business outcome. You’ll have a front\-row seat to some of the most interesting AI use cases emerging in commerce.
 



  





**What you'll do**



* Work directly with
 **enterprise customers** 
 to understand their business processes, pain points and goals, and identify opportunities where AI can create meaningful impact.



  




* Translate ambiguous business problems into
 **AI\-led solution strategies** 
 , figuring out what should be automated, augmented or redesigned.



  




* Own the solutioning process from
 **problem discovery to implementation** 
 , working closely with engineering, product and customer\-facing teams.



  




* Design workflows and solutions using
 **LLMs, AI agents, automation and BiteSpeed's product capabilities** 
 to solve real customer problems.



  




* Work with enterprise stakeholders to build business cases, define success metrics and communicate the expected impact of proposed solutions.



  




* Get hands\-on with the details when required, whether that's understanding APIs, data flows, system architecture or experimenting with AI tools and prototypes.



  




* Identify patterns across customer problems and feed those insights back into the
 **product roadmap** 
 , helping us decide what should become a scalable product rather than a one\-off solution.



  




* Build repeatable
 **solutioning playbooks, processes and operating mechanisms** 
 that help us solve enterprise problems faster as we scale.



  




* Partner with Sales and Customer Success on strategic accounts, helping them win, onboard and grow enterprise customers through better technical and AI\-led solutioning.



  




* Stay close to the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem and continuously experiment with new models, tools and approaches that could unlock better solutions for our customers.



  





**What makes you a good fit**




  




* You enjoy sitting with a messy problem and figuring out
 **"how would we actually solve this?"** 
 rather than waiting for someone to hand you a requirements document.



  




* You have a
 **strong technical foundation** 
 and are comfortable understanding APIs, integrations, data flows and software systems. You don't necessarily need to be a full\-time engineer, but you should be technical enough to go deep when the problem demands it.



  




* You have
 **3\+ years of experience** 
 in product, solutions engineering, consulting, technology, strategy \& operations or a similar role where you've solved complex business problems.



  




* You are genuinely curious about
 **AI and LLMs** 
 and have experimented with AI tools, agents, workflows or applications beyond simply using ChatGPT to write emails.



  




* You are comfortable speaking to
 **enterprise customers and senior stakeholders** 
 , understanding their problems and explaining technical solutions in simple business language.



  




* You have strong business judgment and can distinguish between a problem that needs a fancy AI solution and one that just needs a better process.



  




* You are comfortable operating with
 **ambiguity and high ownership** 
 . There won't always be a playbook, and that's kind of the point.



  




* You care about outcomes more than job titles and enjoy moving between strategy, customer conversations and getting your hands dirty with execution.



  





**Salary and Location**




  





**Location:** 
 Bangalore
 



  





**Expected CTC:** 
 We pay top of market for the right folks and also offer generous equity (ESOP) to everyone in the team
 



  





**Our Way Of Life**
 \- https://www.notion.so/bitespeed/Way\-Of\-Life\-At\-BiteSpeed\-44d9b9614d9641419da910189b1e9f8e.
 



  





**Our Purpose**




  





 At BiteSpeed, work is personal. You could blame this on us being existential, but most of us are spending the best years of our lives doing this and we want to be purposeful about the kind of workplace we’re trying to create.
 



  





**Our purpose is about why we’re here and what we care about:\-** 




  




* Personal Transformation
* Wealth Creation
* Winning Together



  





**Our Values**




  





 Our values are about how we do what we do. Values define the right thing to do. We hire, reward and sometimes have to let go based on our values.
 



  





**We have 5 core values:\-** 



* Go Above And Beyond
* Making Things Happen
* Say It Like It Is
* Progress Over Perfection
* Don’t Take Yourself Seriously, Take Your Work Seriously



  





**Perks \& Benefits**




  





 Small things we’ve done to ensure we take care of our wellness, learning \& keep things fun:\-
 



  




* **Health Insurance \-** 
 Health insurance cover and accident coverage for extra cushion and mental peace when rainy days hit us.



  




* **Quarterly Off\-sites \-** 
 Quarterly off\-sites are a core part of the BiteSpeed culture. Our off\-sites range from intense quarter planning sessions to crazy mafia nights and competitive cricket matches (with a lot of trash talking).



  




* **Cult Fitness Membership \-** 
 All work and no play makes jack a dull boy. Cult Fit and Cult Play passes to make sure we hit the gym more often.



  




* **Personal Development \-** 
 We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.



  




* **Salary In Advance \-** 
 Trust first, by default. We pay out salaries in the first week of the month.



  





**How to apply?** 




  





 If this sounds interesting
 **drop a personal note** 
 with why you'd want to work with us and what makes you a good fit on
 **talent@bitespeed.co.** 




  





 Know someone who might be a great fit?
 **Refer them to us** 
 , if they end up joining we'll send you an
 **Apple Airpods Pro** 
 as a gesture of thanks!
 



  





 For any queries feel free to write to talent@bitespeed.co.

**Central Square Foundation**
 About the job Project Associate \- High Potential Students
   

  

 Founded in 2012, Central Square Foundation (CSF) is a non\-profit philanthropic organization working with the vision of ensuring quality school education for all children in India. We believe that effective foundational learning is essential for better learning outcomes for all children in school. The development of foundational literacy and numeracy skills by Class 3 can help children progress to higher levels of learning and is an essential building block in a child's life.
   

  

 We are driven by our mission to enable the school education system to adopt solutions that are scalable, sustainable, and effective so that all children get equal access to opportunities needed for leading a better life.
   

  

 Read more about our work here: www.centralsquarefoundation.org
   

  

**About High Potential Students Workstream At CSF**
 India’s school education system serves \~25 crore children. Many of these students come from underserved communities and face systemic gaps in identification and support. With most interventions beginning only after Grade 10, much of this potential remains untapped and underdeveloped.
   

  

 To bridge this gap, CSF introduced a new workstream in 2025, High Potential Students (HPS), to support India’s bright young minds from underprivileged backgrounds in becoming future innovators, researchers and leaders. By 2030, we aim to transform the learning journeys of 1 lakh students by equipping them with the skills, support and exposure needed to thrive in higher education and high\-growth careers. Through this work, we are committed to advancing equity and excellence, empowering young minds from every corner of India to realise their full potential.
   

  

 CSF is working with government model school systems to strengthen pathways for high\-potential students (HPS) from underserved communities. The work focuses on designing and implementing initiatives within government model schools to support students’ academic, socio\-emotional, and career development. Key areas include programme planning and implementation, partner and government coordination, field engagement, documentation, and evidence generation. The work also supports effective classroom practices, academic enrichment, structured advanced learning opportunities, career pathways, and overall student progression.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 CSF is seeking a Project Associate to join the High Potential Students workstream in Delhi and support the planning and implementation of HPS programme. The Project Associate will be responsible for supporting assigned programme priorities, managing day\-to\-day implementation, maintaining trackers and documentation, supporting review and reporting processes, conducting field visits, analysing implementation data, and identifying risks that require course correction. The role requires strong project management skills, comfort with data, clear written communication, field orientation, and the ability to work in a dynamic and evolving environment.
   

  

**The Core Areas Of Contribution Are**
**Programme Implementation and Coordination**
* Support the execution of key programme priorities under the High Potential Students workstream, especially across model schools.
* Build and manage working relationships with diverse stakeholders, including regional government teams, school leaders, programme partners, educational nonprofits, vendors and internal CSF teams.
* Coordinate with implementation partners to monitor and review programs across EdTech, assessments, academic enrichment, and career pathways, ensuring effective progress tracking, timely identification of gaps, and appropriate follow\-through on action items.
* Support stakeholder convenings, partner check\-ins, review meetings and government updates by collating data, preparing materials, documenting discussions and tracking next steps.


**Project Management, Reviews and Reporting**
* Maintain programme trackers, timelines, meeting notes, action\-item logs, data templates and other tools required for day\-to\-day monitoring and review.
* Manage timelines and deliverables for assigned workstreams to ensure that activities are on track and aligned with project objectives.
* Prepare clear written outputs, including field visit notes, meeting minutes, update emails, review notes, progress summaries, presentations, reports and internal briefing documents.
* Provide timely updates to internal teams and CSF leadership on implementation progress, key insights, risks, opportunities and areas for course correction.


**Data, Field Insights and Documentation**
* Support rigorous data cleaning, validation and analysis to identify trends, implementation gaps, inconsistencies and areas requiring follow\-up or course correction, while also supporting the development and maintenance of dashboards, trackers and other data platforms for programme monitoring and review.
* Conduct targeted field visits to schools and institutions to gather operational and academic insights, understand implementation realities and document observations.
* Document key learnings, field insights, implementation challenges and emerging practices to inform reviews, reporting, programme improvement and future scale\-up.


**Problem Solving and Agile Support**
* Identify, assess and escalate implementation risks and bottlenecks in partner delivery, school\-level execution, data availability or communication, while supporting proactive issue resolution.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth project delivery, timely communication of progress and follow\-through on agreed priorities.
* Support emerging priorities and time\-sensitive tasks that may arise from government stakeholders, programme partners or internal teams, with the ability to respond quickly, organise next steps and drive closure in a dynamic work environment.


**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Abilities**
 We are looking for a young professional who brings:
   

  

* 0 to 2 years of post\-qualification work experience for the Project Associate role, preferably in the education sector, development sector, programme management, EdTech implementation, assessments, school\-system reform, or government\-facing projects.
* Strong project management skills or demonstrated ability to manage timelines, trackers, follow\-ups, action items and multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Good writing and oral communication skills, with proficiency and fluency in English and Hindi.
* Good project delivery skills, including the ability to coordinate with partners, schools, government teams and internal colleagues to drive execution and ensure closure on deliverables.
* Ability to work with student\-level, school\-level, assessment, platform usage or programme monitoring data to derive implementation insights and support reviews.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills, including the ability to prepare meeting notes, progress updates, field visit reports, review materials and concise internal briefs.
* Strong growth and learning mindset, with attention to detail, ownership of assigned tasks, problem\-solving orientation, agility to take up emerging priorities, and willingness to travel across implementation schools within/outside of Delhi NCR.

title: Project Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Für zugehörige Kundenausstattungs\-, Einrichtungs\- oder Infrastrukturprojekte: verantwortlich für Projektabwicklung, Ergebnisverantwortung und Kundenzufriedenheit durch Verwaltung der projektbezogenen Aktivitäten und Ressourcen. Beeinflusst die Qualität der eigenen Arbeit und der Arbeit anderer im Team.Führt betriebliche/technische Standardaufgaben aus, die in der Regel Anweisungen und Arbeitsabläufen unterliegen.Möglicherweise besteht Spielraum, um die Reihenfolge zu ändern und Aufgaben/Pflichten basierend auf sich ändernden Arbeitssituationen zu erledigen.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Nicht schlüsselfertige Projekte oder Projekte nur für Produkte/Geräte. Verantwortlich für die Beaufsichtigung des Projekts und die direkte oder indirekte Leitung und/oder Verwaltung der Projektressourcen für kleine und mittlere Projekte (Größe in Bezug auf das GE\-Unternehmen), die nur Geräte, Produktsuiten oder nicht schlüsselfertige Projekte umfassen können.
* Erweiterung der Kenntnisse der eigenen technischen Disziplin zur Umsetzung von Richtlinien/Strategien.Kann Support\-Rollen mit spezialisiertem technischem Wissensgebiet beinhalten; laufender Erwerb von Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten auf höherem Niveau.
* Grundlegendes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Gute Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Kann eine gewisse Autonomie besitzen, um Entscheidungen innerhalb eines definierten Rahmens zu treffen.Löst Probleme in Situationen, in denen gute technische Kenntnisse und Urteilsvermögen im Rahmen festgelegter Verfahren erforderlich sind.Konsultiert hochrangigere Teammitglieder zu Problemen außerhalb definierter Anweisungen/Parameter.
* Eine Stelle auf diesem Niveau erfordert gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und kann notwendig sein, um ein Junior\-Team zu führen.Entwickelt für kundenorientierte Rollen starke Kundenbeziehungen und dient als Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und GE Vernova.Erklärt anderen technische Informationen.


**Grundqualifikationen**
* Diese Rolle erfordert grundlegende Erfahrung . Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit entsprechender Erfahrung).


**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**
* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten. Starke Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

 Working Days: Monday to Saturday

 Stipend: Up to ₹15,000\-₹20,000/month
 



  





 Junior Project Manager – Digital Marketing
 



 Role Details
 



 Designation: Junior Project Manager – Digital Marketing
 



 Department: Digital Marketing / Marketing
 



 Experience: 1–2 Years

 Industry: Digital Marketing / Marketing
 



  





 Aout the Role
 



 We are looking for a Junior Project Manager – Digital Marketing who can work closely with our marketing team and ensure smooth planning, coordination, execution, and tracking of digital marketing projects.
 



 The ideal candidate should have a strong overall understanding of digital marketing, excellent communication skills, a proactive and responsible approach, and the potential to grow into a leadership role.

 Website \& basic analytics

title: Senior/ Program Coordinator - Chhattisgarh
description:
**Overview**
 Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
   

  

 Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong implementation capacity, Jhpiego designs, pilots, evaluates, and scales innovative, evidence\-based solutions across multiple health domains, including Tuberculosis and Infectious Diseases, Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Nutrition, Immunization, Women's Cancers, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Global Health Security, Human Resources for Health, and Digital Health.
   

  

**About The Program**
 Jhpiego provides strategic technical assistance to the Government of India's National TB Elimination Program (NTEP) to accelerate TB elimination through health systems strengthening, implementation research, digital innovations, and evidence\-based interventions. Working closely with the Central TB Division (CTD), State TB Cells, the National Health Mission (NHM), and development partners, Jhpiego supports the delivery of high\-quality, people\-centered TB services across the continuum of care.
   

  

 The program implements several national and multi\-state initiatives, including the
 **Integrated TB–Tobacco Screening and Referral Program** 
 , an innovative initiative that integrates tuberculosis screening with tobacco control and cessation services across community and institutional platforms. The program strengthens collaboration between the National TB Elimination Program (NTEP), National Tobacco Control Program (NTCP), National Program for Prevention and Control of Non\-Communicable Diseases (NP\-NCD), National Oral Health Program (NOHP), and the National Health Mission (NHM) to establish an integrated screening, referral, and follow\-up system. Through digital health solutions, blended learning approaches, capacity building, supportive supervision, and strengthened referral pathways, the program aims to improve early TB detection among tobacco users and other high\-risk populations while generating scalable evidence to strengthen integrated service delivery within the public health system.
   

  

**About The Position**
 The
 **Senior/ Program Coordinator** 
 will lead the district\-level planning, coordination, implementation, and monitoring of the Integrated TB–Tobacco Screening and Referral Program in intervention districts in Chhattisgarh \- (Raigarh, Rajnanadgaon, Kanker, Gaurela Pendra Marwahi \- GPM, Manendragarh\-Chirmiri\-Bharatpur \- MCB). The position will work closely with the District TB Centre (DTC), District Health Society (DHS), National Tobacco Control Program (NTCP), National Program for Prevention and Control of Non\-Communicable Diseases (NP\-NCD), National Oral Health Program (NOHP), Ayushman Arogya Mandirs (AAMs), and other district stakeholders to ensure effective implementation of integrated TB and tobacco interventions.
   

  

 The incumbent will provide technical and operational support for capacity building, supportive supervision, implementation of digital platforms, monitoring of project performance, stakeholder engagement, documentation, and reporting. The position requires regular field travel to health facilities and community implementation sites to strengthen program quality, ensure timely achievement of project targets, and support the generation of implementation evidence for scale\-up.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Program Planning and Implementation**
* Lead district\-level implementation of the Integrated TB–Tobacco Screening and Referral Program in accordance with approved work plans, project timelines, and donor requirements.
* Develop district implementation plans, monthly activity calendars, and micro plans in coordination with district health authorities.
* Coordinate implementation of project activities across Ayushman Arogya Mandirs (AAMs), District Hospitals, Community Health Centres (CHCs), Primary Health Centres (PHCs), Tobacco Cessation Centres (TCCs), Public Dental Clinics, NCD Clinics, and other designated service delivery points.
* Ensure timely execution of project activities and achievement of district\-level targets and deliverables.


**Government and Stakeholder Coordination**
* Coordinate closely with the District TB Officer (DTO), Civil Surgeon, District Program Management Unit (DPMU), NTCP Nodal Officer, NP\-NCD Nodal Officer, NOHP teams, NHM officials, and other government stakeholders.
* Facilitate convergence between TB, Tobacco Control, NCD, Oral Health, and Primary Health Care program.
* Organize and facilitate district coordination meetings, review meetings, technical consultations, and joint supervisory visits.
* Develop and maintain effective working relationships with government departments, development partners, professional associations, and community organizations.


**Capacity Building and Supportive Supervision**
* Plan and coordinate district\-level orientations, trainings, refresher trainings, mentoring sessions, and supportive supervision visits.
* Support rollout and monitoring of Learning Management System (LMS)\-based capacity\-building activities.
* Mentor healthcare providers on integrated TB and tobacco screening, referral pathways, documentation, and digital reporting systems.
* Ensure availability and appropriate utilization of training materials, SOPs, job aids, and IEC resources.


**Implementation of Digital Platforms**
* Coordinate district implementation of the TB Mukt Bharat Application and other approved digital platforms.
* Monitor beneficiary registration, tobacco screening, TB screening, referral generation, referral completion, treatment linkage, and follow\-up through digital systems.
* Resolve operational issues and improve utilization of digital platforms.
* Monitor dashboard performance and support corrective actions based on program data.


**Monitoring, Reporting, and Quality Improvement**
* Conduct routine field monitoring visits to health facilities and community implementation sites.
* Review district performance against project indicators and identify implementation gaps.
* Ensure timely collection, validation, compilation, and submission of program reports.
* Support routine data quality assessments and verification of program data.
* Monitor key indicators related to tobacco screening, TB screening, referrals, diagnosis, treatment initiation, and treatment outcomes.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual progress reports, presentations, and implementation updates.


**Operational Coordination**
* Coordinate logistics for trainings, review meetings, workshops, supervisory visits, and other project activities.
* Coordinate with finance, procurement, administration, monitoring and evaluation, and communications teams for smooth implementation of project activities.
* Track implementation progress and ensure timely completion of planned activities.


**Required Qualifications**
* Master’s in Social Work/ MA/ M.Com/ PG Diploma/ MSc/ Statistics or related fields.
* 0–2 years of relevant experience in public health program implementation, coordination, monitoring, data management and analytics.
* Experience working with NTEP or another large\-scale government health program at state, district, or regional level is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder coordination, field implementation, supportive supervision, referral tracking, and preparation of program reports.
* Experience working with Government of India, National TB Elimination Program (NTEP), international NGOs, donor\-funded projects, or multilateral agencies will be highly desirable.


**Skills And Competencies**
* Strong field implementation, coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to work effectively with government health systems and multi\-program stakeholders.
* Excellent interpersonal, facilitation, counselling and communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making and action\-tracking abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel, and familiarity with digital reporting platforms.
* Ability to interpret program data and translate findings into practical corrective actions.
* Fluency in the relevant local language, Hindi and English.
* Willingness to travel extensively within assigned districts, approximately 70–80% of the time.


 Jhpiego is an equal opportunity employer and offers a highly dynamic and enabling work environment. Jhpiego offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive employee benefits package. Women candidates are encouraged to apply.
   

  

 Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will receive a response from Jhpiego.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
**Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires!**
 Kobie, a 35\-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi\-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India.  As a UX Designer at Heartstream, you will help shape the user experience of life\-saving medical technologies used by healthcare professionals, emergency responders, and patients worldwide. Your work will directly influence how users interact with critical medical devices and digital healthcare solutions, ensuring they are intuitive, accessible, and effective in high\-pressure environments.
 



 In this role, you will conduct user research, generate insights, and translate complex requirements into meaningful design solutions. Working across the full design lifecycle, you will create wireframes, prototypes, and user\-centered experiences that improve usability, safety, and customer satisfaction.
 



 You will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams including Product Management, Engineering, Clinical and Domain Experts, Marketing, Human Factors specialists, and other designers to develop innovative solutions that meet user needs while supporting business objectives.
 



 This position offers the opportunity to grow your expertise in healthcare technology, develop deep knowledge of user\-centered design in regulated environments, and contribute to products that make a tangible difference in people's lives. You will gain exposure to cutting\-edge medical technologies while building your skills in research, interaction design, usability testing, and stakeholder engagement.
 



  





**Key aspects of the role:** 



* Conduct user interviews, surveys, usability studies, and field research to understand customer needs and workflows.
* Design intuitive user experiences that consider the broader product ecosystem and interconnected user journeys.
* Create wireframes, prototypes, visual designs, and interaction concepts that effectively communicate design intent.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative, user\-centered solutions.
* Apply design thinking methodologies to solve complex healthcare challenges.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and collaboration across the organization.



  





**Our commitment to collaboration** 



* Your work will directly improve the quality of emergency medical services and enhance patient safety and survival rates by making high\-quality care accessible to more people around the world. As part of a number one provider of therapeutic care solutions, your contribution will help us continue to save more lives every year. With every project, you'll be making a world of difference.
* We believe collaboration is better together than apart. For this Bangalore office\-based role, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week.



  





**You'll thrive in the role if:** 



* You have a
 **Bachelor's or Master's degree in UX Design, Interaction Design, Visual Design, Product Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related design discipline.** 
 Core design education is essential.
* You've acquired
 **2\+ years of experience** 
 in User Experience Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, User Research, Information Architecture, Usability Testing, or a related field including evidence of taking at least one concept into development.
* Experience within MedTech, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or Pharma environments
* Your skills include:
* User Experience (UX) Research
* User\-Centered Design
* Wireframing and Prototyping Tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD)
* Usability Testing and Analysis
* Interaction Design
* Information Architecture
* Stakeholder Management
* Accessibility Standards
* Visual Design and Design Systems
* Technical Documentation and Design Articulation
* You're a collaborative, curious, and empathetic designer with strong communication and presentation skills, capable of influencing stakeholders, facilitating discussions, and translating complex user needs into meaningful design solutions. Experience working in cross\-functional teams and balancing multiple priorities is highly valued.
* ***Your application will need to be supported by a CV and a portfolio of your work.***



  





**If you find this role intriguing and possess several of the required experiences, we welcome your application. You might still be the ideal candidate for this position or other openings at Heartstream.**

* About iDream Education


**Vision:** 
 Unlimited Learning. Unlimited Growth. For Everyone.
   

  

**Belief:** 
 We believe that access to learning and growth is a fundamental right, and that learning in its truest sense is the joyful unfolding of a being's fullest potential — in all dimensions of life.
   

  

**Mission:** 
 To deliver solutions and experiences that facilitate access to learning and growth for everyone, irrespective of their languages, geographies, abilities, curricula, age groups, learning styles, and socio\-economic status.
   

  

**Education**
 iPrep by iDream Education is a Learning Platform that runs both offline \& online, is bilingual and works on all major hardware devices and operating systems. iPrep delivers curriculum\-aligned digital learning for classes 1st to 12th in English, Hindi, and Regional language mediums for universal reach and learning use as:
   

  

* iPrep Digital Class for Smart Classrooms
* iPrep Digital Library for Tablets/Notebooks based Smart ICT Labs
* iPrep PAL for Personalised Adaptive Learning
* iPrep Tablets for Preloaded Learning Devices with Monitoring
* iPrep App for a one\-stop learning platform across Android, iOS, and Web


 Through iPrep, iDream Education empowers teachers and students, both in schools and at home to
 **Learn Unlimited** 
 .
   

  

 Company website:
 **www.idreameducation.org** 
 \| iPrep website:
 **www.iprep.in**
* Role Summary


 We are looking for a Product Designer to join our Product team and help shape how millions of students and teachers experience iPrep. You will take product requirements from rough idea to polished, tested UI — designing for a genuinely diverse user base that spans smart classrooms in metro schools to low\-bandwidth devices in rural India. This is a role for someone who wants to grow across the full arc of product design: understanding the user, shaping the flow, and getting the pixels right — not just executing screens from a spec.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities \& Deliverables
* Product Design Execution
+ Translate product requirements and rough concepts into polished, high\-fidelity UI designs for iPrep across web, app, and device platforms.
+ Build and maintain consistent, reusable components within iPrep's design system.
+ Prototype key flows and interactions to pressure\-test design decisions before handoff.

* User Research \& Discovery
+ Support user research — plan and conduct interviews and usability tests with teachers, students, and field staff to ground design decisions in real user needs.
+ Translate research insights into concrete design changes and document key findings for the wider team.
+ Contribute to personas and journey maps that reflect iPrep's varied user contexts — from urban smart classrooms to low\-bandwidth, low\-literacy rural settings.

* Collaboration \& Handoff
+ Work closely with the Principal, Product Design and cross\-functional partners in product, engineering, and content to keep design intent intact through build.
+ Participate actively in design reviews and critiques, and incorporate feedback without losing sight of the user problem.
+ Prepare clear, implementation\-ready specs and documentation for engineering handoff.

* AI\-Augmented Design Workflow
+ Use AI\-powered design tools (Figma AI, and other emerging platforms) to speed up ideation, iteration, and production work.
+ Proactively pilot new AI\-assisted workflows and share learnings back with the design team.

* Qualifications \& Experience
* Experience: 1–3 years in product design, UX design, or UI design, ideally within a digital product, SaaS, or EdTech environment.
* Portfolio: Case studies that show your end\-to\-end process — problem framing, research input, iteration, and final high\-fidelity output — not just polished final screens.
* Tool Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Figma (components, auto layout, prototyping). Comfort with basic user research methods (interviews, usability testing).
* Sector Context: Exposure to designing for low\-bandwidth, bilingual, or varied\-literacy user contexts is a strong advantage.
* AI Fluency: You use AI tools as part of your daily design workflow, not as an occasional novelty.
* Communication: Able to clearly articulate design rationale to non\-designers and hold your own in a cross\-functional review.
* What Makes You a Great Fit?


 You care about designing for real users who don't look like the users in most portfolios — students and teachers working with patchy internet, shared devices, and multiple languages. You're equally comfortable digging into a research conversation and polishing a Figma file, and you're looking to grow under close mentorship rather than work in isolation.
   

  

* What We're Looking For — Values \& Culture Fit
* Integrity: Makes thoughtful, user\-first decisions and takes ownership.
* Impact: Creates meaningful experiences that drive user and business value.
* Excellence: Sets high standards for design quality and user experience.
* Collaboration: Influences and works effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* Why Join Us


 We are on a mission to take the best of digital learning to every corner of rural Bharat. At iDream, you'll design for one of India's largest last\-mile EdTech platforms, working closely with a Principal Product Design and a small, tight product design team where your decisions visibly shape how millions of students learn.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**About Neo** 




 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia**
 — Co\-Founder of
 **Zeta**
 ,
 **Radix**
 , and
 **Titan**
 —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 


* Tasket — A radically reimagined, AI\-native work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* Friday — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* Studio — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* Drive — AI\-native repository, where humans and agents can co\-work on files.
* Scribe — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**About the Role** 




 We want someone whose job is turning PRDs and product context into documentation — and building the automation that makes that scale.
 



 You are someone who reads a spec closely, understands what a user or engineer actually needs to know, and writes it clearly. But you don't stop at writing docs one at a time: you build repeatable workflows — skill files, prompt templates, structured inputs — that let AI tools generate consistent first drafts from PRDs, tickets, and changelogs, which you then refine and own.
 



 This is a hands\-on, build\-the\-system role. It's not a pure writing job where you manually draft every page, and it's not a pure engineering job either — it's the combination: strong writing judgment paired with an automation mindset.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 • Read PRDs and engineering specs, and translate them into clear technical documentation — user guides, release notes, API docs, internal runbooks
 



 • Design and build documentation automations: skill files, prompt templates, and scripts that let AI tools generate consistent first\-draft docs from structured inputs
 



 • Maintain and improve those automations over time as our product and doc formats evolve
 



 • Edit and fact\-check AI\-generated drafts against source material — you're accountable for accuracy, not just fluency
 



 • Organize documentation in our workspace tools and keep information architecture clean and findable
 



 • Partner closely with PMs and engineers to fill documentation gaps and flag when a PRD lacks the detail needed to write accurate docs
 



 • Continuously push on documentation methodology and tooling as our products evolve
 



  





**Skills** 




 • Strong written communication — this is a writing\-first role; verbal fluency alone won't cut it
 



 • Technical fluency: able to read a PRD or API spec and understand it well enough to explain it accurately
 



 • Hands\-on use of AI: real experience using AI assistants for actual work, with a clear sense of what "skills"/prompts/context files are and how to build with them
 



 • Working understanding of project management and workspace tools (Confluence, Jira, Notion, or similar)
 



 • Genuine curiosity about systems and process — an instinct to automate the repeatable parts of a workflow
 



 • Comfortable with ambiguity and moving quickly
 



  





**Experience and Qualifications** 




 • Around 1–2 years of experience in technical writing, content engineering, developer relations, QA, or a similar technical\-adjacent role. Strong internship experience counts.
 



 • Exposure to product development or working alongside a product/engineering team
 



 • A background in computer science/engineering, or another field (journalism, English, technical support) paired with demonstrated technical comprehension — no specific degree required
 



  





**Equal Opportunity** 




 Neo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

description:
**Job Description Public Affairs \- Team Member** 




  





 Role: Public Affairs Entry Level
 



 Location: Delhi
 



 Organisation: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 The Public Affairs team is looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented professional to support the Banks engagement with the Government, Regulators, Policymakers, Industry Associations, and other key external stakeholders.
 



 The role will involve policy and regulatory research, stakeholder mapping, maintenance of institutional databases and intelligence repositories, monitoring of relevant government and regulatory developments, preparation of briefing materials, and coordination of stakeholder engagements.
 



 The position offers an opportunity to develop a strong understanding of the public policy environment, government institutions, regulatory frameworks, and their implications for the banking and financial services sector.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Monitor and track policy, legislative, regulatory developments relevant to the Bank and the broader financial services sector.
* Conduct research and prepare concise notes, background papers, policy briefs, stakeholder profiles, and briefing materials.
* Maintain and regularly update structured databases and institutional knowledge repositories covering relevant government officials, regulators, policymakers, ministries, departments, regulatory institutions and other key stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain stakeholder profiles capturing publicly available professional information such as current responsibilities, career history, institutional affiliations, areas of responsibility, and other relevant professional insights.
* Track appointments, transfers, promotions, changes in responsibilities, committee memberships, and other institutional developments involving relevant government and regulatory officials.
* Build institutional intelligence repositories on ministries, departments, regulators, government agencies, parliamentary committees, industry bodies, and other institutions relevant to the Bank.
* Ensure that databases and intelligence repositories are accurate, current, structured, searchable, and maintained in accordance with applicable data privacy requirements and the Banks internal policies.
* Prepare stakeholder maps, institutional maps, engagement histories, meeting records, and briefing notes to support effective stakeholder engagement.
* Support the preparation of senior management meetings with government officials, regulators, policymakers, industry associations, and other external stakeholders.
* Maintain records of stakeholder engagements, key discussion points, commitments, follow\-up actions, and relevant institutional developments to strengthen organisational memory and continuity.
* Monitor government notifications, regulatory consultations, policy announcements, speeches, reports, and other developments relevant to the Bank.
* Analyse developments in the political economy and public policy environment and identify emerging issues, risks, and opportunities relevant to the Bank.
* Support the preparation of presentations, dashboards, periodic reports, and updates for senior management.
* Assist the team in organising meetings, roundtables, conferences, stakeholder engagements, and other Public Affairs initiatives.



  





**Desired Qualifications :** 



* Bachelors or Master’s degree in Public Policy, Political Science, Economics, Law, International Relations, Public Administration, or a related discipline.
* 0–2 years of relevant experience in public affairs, public policy, government relations, regulatory affairs, consulting, research organisations, industry associations, financial services, or related fields.
* Fresh graduates with strong research, analytical, and writing capabilities are also welcome to apply.



  





**Key skills and attributes :** 




 \- Interest in government, public policy, regulations, economy etc.
 



 \- Strong research and analytical capabilities,
 



 \- Good written and verbal communication skills,
 



 \- Ability to synthesize large volumes of information into concise and decision useful briefs

title: Junior Oracle SCM Functional Consultant
description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY** 




 Medovate Pvt Ltd is building a Technology and Operations Centre in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, to deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud services for a multi\-entity international group operating manufacturing and distribution businesses across the United States, United Kingdom, Mexico, China, and India. The group runs Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and SCM across multiple legal entities, inventory organizations, and business units, with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) connecting Fusion to intercompany order flows, warehouse operations, e\-commerce platforms, and third\-party logistics partners.
 



**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We are seeking a Junior Oracle SCM Functional Consultant to join the Supply Chain practice at Medovate's Ahmedabad center. This is a hands\-on functional role suited to someone early in their Oracle Fusion career who wants to build real module depth rather than remain in a single support queue. You will work under the direction of the SCM Functional Lead and alongside senior consultants, supporting configuration, testing, data preparation, and day to day functional support across Inventory Management, Product Management, Procurement, Order Management, and Cost Management. You will be given structured work, clear design decisions to execute against, and progressively broader exposure as you demonstrate capability.
 



**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Configuration and Delivery Support** 



* Perform configuration tasks across Oracle Fusion SCM modules in line with design decisions agreed by the SCM Functional Lead.
* Participate in requirements and discovery sessions with supply chain, warehouse, and procurement stakeholders, taking accurate notes and preparing follow up questions.
* Prepare configuration workbooks, setup checklists, and functional documentation for review by senior consultants.
* Assist with the setup of inventory organizations, sub inventories, locators, and item organization assignments across multiple legal entities.
* Support environment refresh activities by re applying and validating configuration in test and development pods.



**Inventory Management** 



* Support configuration of transaction types, reservations, lot and serial control, and inter organization transfer setups.
* Assist with cycle count and physical inventory setup, count sequence generation, and adjustment processing.
* Investigate inventory balance and transaction discrepancies, escalating root cause findings to senior consultants.
* Support min max planning, replenishment, and reorder setup for stocked items.



**Product Management** 



* Assist with item class structures, item templates, attribute groups, and catalogue setup.
* Prepare and validate item master data loads using FBDI and spreadsheet templates.
* Support item lifecycle phase transitions and item organization assignment across group entities.
* Maintain item level attribute accuracy including units of measure, category assignments, and cross references.



**Procurement** 



* Support configuration of purchasing document styles, approval hierarchies, and supplier setup.
* Assist with blanket purchase agreement and price list maintenance, including validation of pricing against agreed terms.
* Support requisition to purchase order flow testing, including self service procurement scenarios.
* Prepare supplier and supplier site data for load and validate results after import.



**Order Management** 



* Support order orchestration process testing, including hold, change order, and fulfilment line scenarios.
* Assist with pricing, shipping, and transaction type setup for domestic and export order flows.
* Support intercompany purchase order and sales order flows between group entities, including validation of generated documents.
* Investigate stuck or errored orders and prepare findings for resolution by senior consultants.



**Cost Management and Shipping** 



* Support cost organization, cost book, and valuation unit setup activities.
* Assist with receipt accounting and cost accounting period close tasks, including exception review.
* Support pick, pack, and ship transaction testing, including shipping document generation and receipt confirmation.



**Testing and Data** 



* Execute test scripts during SIT and UAT cycles, log defects with clear reproduction steps, and retest fixes.
* Prepare test data sets and support data conversion activities, including reconciliation of loaded records against source extracts.
* Validate reports and BI queries against transactional data and flag inconsistencies.



**Support and Documentation** 



* Provide first and second line functional support for SCM users across group entities, working within agreed service levels.
* Maintain configuration logs, issue trackers, and knowledge base articles.
* Prepare user guides and quick reference material for warehouse, procurement, and order management users.
* Raise and track service requests with Oracle Support under the guidance of senior team members.



**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS** 




**Required** 



* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Commerce, Operations, or a related discipline.
* One to three years of experience working with Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM in a functional, support, or implementation capacity.
* Working exposure to at least two of Inventory Management, Product Management, Procurement, Order Management, or Cost Management.
* Understanding of core supply chain processes including procure to pay, order to cash, and inventory transaction flows.
* Practical experience preparing and loading data using FBDI templates or spreadsheet loaders.
* Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and data validation for reconciliation work.
* Clear written English and the ability to document configuration and issues precisely.
* Willingness to work on site in Ahmedabad and to overlap with UK and US business hours when required.



**Preferred** 



* Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM certification in one or more modules.
* Exposure to multi entity, multi organization, or multi currency Oracle environments.
* Experience supporting intercompany order flows between related legal entities.
* Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud delivered interfaces from a functional testing perspective.
* Exposure to manufacturing, discrete assembly, or distribution operations.
* Awareness of BI Publisher or OTBI report structures.
* Experience working alongside warehouse teams on receiving, putaway, picking, or cycle count processes.



**WHAT WE OFFER** 



* Structured mentoring from senior Oracle Fusion consultants and functional leads.
* Exposure to a full multi entity Oracle Fusion footprint across five countries rather than a single narrow support scope.
* A clear progression path into a mid level functional consultant role based on demonstrated capability.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Full Stack Developer
 



  





 📍 Gurgaon
 



 · Full\-time
 



 · Level: Open, we hire the right person first, then decide the level
 



  





**About Enrich Labs** 




  





 We're a venture studio, and we build the products that sales, marketing, and GTM teams run their outreach and operations on. Everything we ship is our own. Three products are live and growing: InboxKit for email infrastructure, Enrich.so for lead data, and our sending platform for running campaigns at volume. More than thousands of customers across the globe use them to find the right people, reach them, and keep the whole machine running.
 



  





 It looks simple on the outside, but it's a hard problem underneath. The infrastructure has to be right the first time, at scale, against systems we don't control, and a single mistake can take weeks to undo. Agencies and outbound teams trust us with infrastructure their business depends on.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 You'll own features from start to finish, both the backend and the frontend. We're a small team, so if you build something, you're also the one who fixes it when it breaks.
 



  





 You'll also have a real say in what gets built. Not just picking up tickets, but helping plan what we ship next across the studio, testing it properly before it goes out, pushing it to production for 10,000\+ customers, and then staying with it long enough to know whether they actually got value from it. A feature that ships and nobody uses is a feature that failed.
 



  





 We're open on experience level. Someone junior who thinks clearly is more valuable to us than someone senior who's coasting.
 



  





**What You'll Work On** 




  




* New features across our products, from a rough idea to something live in front of 10,000\+ customers, including the judgement call about whether it's worth building at all.
* 
* Automation that runs at scale, the systems that do in seconds what would otherwise take a customer days of manual setup.
* 
* Monitoring and reliability, catching problems before a customer notices, and sending alerts that are actually useful rather than noise.
* 
* The interfaces customers live in, dashboards and flows that make something genuinely complicated feel obvious.
* 
* Our public API and integrations, the webhooks and 24\+ tool connections customers build their workflows on.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* You understand how the internet actually works. This is the most important part of the job. You know how DNS, HTTP, proxies, and TLS work, and you understand why things load slowly. You can look at a network trace and figure out what happened, and you've fixed problems that needed this kind of knowledge, not just worked at a level above it.



  




* You're curious about how things break. You think about how a feature could be misused while you're still building it. Maybe you've done CTFs, bug bounties, or authorised security testing, or you just enjoy reading about how things went wrong elsewhere. If you've ever found a bug in someone else's product, you reported it the right way. That matters to us as much as the curiosity itself.



  




* You can build a full feature, start to finish. You've taken something from a blank file to a live product, and kept it running afterward. You're equally comfortable with backend and frontend work, and you don't need someone else to hand things off to you.



  




* You ask why before how. You talk about your work in terms of what it did for users, not just tasks you finished. You've said no to building something before, and you know how to cut scope to ship on time.



  




* You have good taste. You can look at a screen and say exactly what's wrong with it. You think about the boring parts too, the loading, the empty states, the errors, the slow connections, because that's where real products are tested.



  




* You build things on your own, just because you're curious. This isn't about how much free time you have. Plenty of great engineers have full lives outside work. We just want to see that curiosity somewhere.



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node), a good part of our product surface is built on it.
* 
* Next.js or similar modern frontend tools, actually built with them, not just read about them.
* 
* Better Auth, or real work with logins, sessions, and tokens.
* 
* Golang, helpful for our backend, and easy to learn if you think clearly.
* 
* Browser automation like Playwright or Puppeteer, useful for a lot of our setup work.
* 
* None of these are dealbreakers. We'd rather hire someone with strong networking instincts and no Go experience than the other way around.



  





**What We Don't Care About** 




  





 Your degree, or not having one. Where you worked before. How many years you've used a specific tool. GitHub stars. Gaps in your resume. How smoothly you interview, we care about how clearly you think, not how polished you sound.
 



  





**To Apply** 




  





 Share something you've built, and one line on why you built it. A cover letter is optional. That one line isn't.
 



 Send it to
 **hiring@inboxkit.com**

**About the Guild** 




  





 Founded in 2022, Ethereal Exploration Guild (The Guild) is building the World’s First Fully Reusable Medium\-Lift Launch Vehicle/Rocket, Razor Crest Mk\-1(RCM1\).
 



  





 Based in India, the team has a combined flight heritage of over 75 launches from the PSLV and GSLV fleets, and more than 300 years of collective experience in the space industry. The Guild is also developing a 700,000 sq ft facility dedicated to Upper Stage Engine Testing, which is going to be India’s largest privately developed Engine Testing Facility.
 



  





 The Guild has also built and manufactured India’s First Reusable Rocket Engine.
 



  





 We are looking for a self\-motivated individual to join the Hands of the Guild as a Avionics Software Engineer.
 



  





 Please apply to the job using the link provided below:
 



**https://zfrmz.in/Hhn4BCujodntT8QgcYb2** 




  





**Location: Hebbal, Bengaluru** 




**Job\-Type: On\-site, Monday \- Saturday** 




  





**Role Summary:** 
 We are seeking a highly skilled Avionics Software Engineer with over 3 years of hands\-on experience in embedded systems, real\-time software, and mission\-critical aerospace applications to join our avionics and flight software team. The engineer will be responsible for the design, development, integration, debugging, and verification of high\-reliability software for advanced aerospace and launch vehicle systems. The role involves developing C/C\+\+ application software, embedded software, Linux and RT\-Linux applications, device drivers, hardware abstraction layers, communication interfaces, real\-time sequencing and control logic, health monitoring, fault detection and handling, and mission\-critical software infrastructure. The candidate will work closely with GNC, avionics hardware, propulsion, systems engineering, and vehicle integration teams to develop robust, deterministic, and fault\-tolerant software capable of operating reliably in demanding aerospace environments.
 



 Strong practical experience with real\-time operating systems such as FreeRTOS and RT\-Linux, embedded Linux, multi\-threaded applications, interrupt\-driven systems, inter\-process communication, hardware interfaces, and deterministic execution is expected. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working close to the hardware and debugging complex hardware\-software interactions across a range of microprocessors, microcontrollers, embedded computing platforms, and custom avionics systems, with a strong focus on software reliability, verification, performance, and operational robustness.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities:** 



* Embedded \& Real\-Time Software: Develop reliable C/C\+\+ software, BSPs, device drivers, HALs and real\-time applications for avionics and launch vehicle systems.
* Flight Software \& System Architecture: Design deterministic software architectures, communication interfaces, fault management, redundancy, health monitoring and fail\-safe mechanisms.
* Integration, Verification \& Testing: Develop SIL/PIL/HIL environments and automated test systems. Lead software integration, hardware bring\-up, debugging, hot\-fire and vehicle testing.
* Ground \& Test Systems: Develop software for test sequencing, DAQ, telemetry, command execution, interlocks, permissives, safing and emergency shutdown.
* Software Engineering \& Reliability: Maintain requirements traceability, version control, code reviews, CI/CD, documentation and controlled releases for mission\-critical software.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer, Electrical/Electronics, ECE, Aerospace, Computer Science, or related field.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in embedded, real\-time, or systems software development.
* Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ and low\-level embedded programming.
* Experience with Linux, FreeRTOS, BSPs, HALs and device drivers.
* Strong understanding of real\-time systems, scheduling, interrupts, concurrency, memory and hardware interfaces.
* Experience with ARM, RISC\-V or equivalent processor architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with SPI, I²C, UART, RS\-422/RS\-485, CAN/CAN\-FD and Ethernet.
* Experience with bootloaders, board bring\-up, cross\-compilation and embedded build systems.
* Experience with JTAG/SWD, GDB, oscilloscopes, logic analysers and protocol analysers.
* Experience with unit, integration, SIL/PIL/HIL and regression testing.
* Strong Git, debugging, code review and software configuration management practices.
* Strong analytical and root\-cause troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work effectively with hardware, avionics, GNC, propulsion, systems and test teams.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Master's degree in Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, Avionics, Aerospace, or related field.
